other.summary: Hugging Face | Launch Blog | Documentation | Technical Report License: Apache 2.0 | Authors: Google DeepMind > This model card is for the Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) drafters for the Gemma 4 models. MTP is implemented by extending the base model with a smaller, faster draft model. When used in a Speculative Decoding pipeline, the draft model predicts several tokens ahead, which the target model then verifies in parallel. This results in significant decoding speedups (up to 3x) while guaranteeing the exact same quality as standard generation, making these checkpoints perfect for low-latency and on-device applications. Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on E2B, E4B, and 12B) and...
other.summary_zh: 這份 Hugging Face 模型卡介紹 Google DeepMind 為 Gemma 4 系列開放模型所釋出的 Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）草稿模型（drafter）檢查點，gemma-4-12B-it-assistant 即為其中之一。其欲解決的問題是：大型語言模型推論時須逐一生成 token，解碼速度常成為低延遲應用的瓶頸。方法上，團隊在基礎模型之外延伸出更小、更快的草稿模型；在 Speculative Decoding（推測解碼）流程中，草稿模型先預測數個後續 token，目標模型再並行驗證並接受正確者，一次即可推進多個 token。主要證據為官方宣稱最高可達 3 倍解碼加速，且因輸出仍經目標模型驗證，可保證與標準生成完全相同的品質，屬於無損加速。Gemma 為 Google DeepMind 打造的開放模型家族，Gemma 4 具多模態能力，支援文字與影像輸入，E2B、E4B 與 12B 版本另支援音訊，模型以 Apache 2.0 授權釋出。限制方面：本頁僅為摘要層級內容，詳細的基準測試、速度量測條件與硬體配置須參考其技術報告，實際加速幅度亦會依應用場景與部署環境而異，且草稿模型須與對應目標模型搭配使用方能發揮效益。整體而言，這類 MTP 草稿模型對低延遲與裝置端（on-device）應用極具價值，讓開發者在完全不犧牲輸出品質的前提下顯著提升生成反應速度。

links.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

evidence: Abstract: 'Over 78,000 measurements, no model's report discriminates a real intervention from a sham beyond chance (AUROC ≈ 0.5007)', with an equivalence bound below 0.15 percentage points of AUROC

Section 7.2: linear probes reach 0.958 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) and 0.750 (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3) held-out accuracy with 200-refit label-shuffled permutation controls; probes at downstream layers 20/24/31 show no held-out error
Section 7.2: known-positive LoRA fine-tune scores d'=5.1517 and AUROC≈1.0 on 100 held-out directions with zero parse failures over 200 trials, validating instrument sensitivity

Section 7.3: 'Only Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct carries an impact-matched random-direction control; Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 does not' and the remaining six models carry unit-norm controls, limiting control strength for most of the roster
Section 7.4: the leakage decomposition (m0, λ) is explicitly not reported because the aggregate margin denominator is 0.0014 and the causal-relevance stratification has not scored the dose battery

Section 7.7: confidence-channel selective-prediction AUROC of 0.647 [0.577, 0.719] for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, with the caveat that the two models were 'selected as the largest of eight estimates without a multiplicity correction'

Appendix B, Table 4: component-status table distinguishes Scored/Executed/Validated/Implemented; Track C executed 1,344 measurements with no complete intervention-sham pair, and reconstruction was never scored

Section 9: limitations state the null covers 'immediate probes at one residual-stream site across twelve benchmarks, with one dose level for seven of the eight models' and does not extend to larger or closed-weight systems
Section 6.1: roster and Table 1 pin model revisions and decoding (temperature 0, 128 new tokens); Appendix A documents exclusion of Qwen3-14B due to 5 of 384 scorable trials
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric interpretability/safety paper squarely in scope: it tests whether eight open-weight LLMs (0.5B-14.8B, seven families) can verbally report controlled interventions on their own computation, with direct implications for chain-of-thought monitoring and self-report oversight. Rigor is unusually high: paired sham design, impact-matched random controls, a text-only observer bound, equivalence (TOST) testing that bounds the pooled effect below 0.15 AUROC percentage points over 11,216 pairs, item-pair clustered bootstraps, permutation controls on probes, dual codings for parse failure, and explicit outcome-to-claim rules. Evidence strength is solid because the null is anchored by two sensitivity checks: a linear probe recovering interventions at 95.8%/75.0% held-out accuracy (Section 7.2) and a fine-tuned known positive clearing the same pipeline at d'=5.15. Novelty is moderate-to-good: individual controls exist in the Lindsey-inspired literature the paper itself maps (Section 2), but the assembled design, impact-matched (divergence-matched) control, equivalence bound, and the report/probe and report/confidence dissociations (AUROC 0.647 for verbalized confidence in Qwen2.5-7B) are genuine contributions. Deductions: the primary detection battery uses one residual site (layer 16) and one dose for most models; only Qwen2.5-7B gets a truly impact-matched control while six models use the weakest unit-norm control (Section 7.3); the observer bound uses only the weakest same-model tier; the leakage decomposition and Track C/delayed-track analyses are specified but not executed (Sections 7.4, 7.6, Appendix B); the confidence finding was post-hoc selected from eight estimates without multiplicity correction (Section 7.7); conclusions do not extend to closed-weight frontier models; and there are minor inconsistencies (e.g., Section 6.1 says 'Nine models from seven laboratories' against eight roster models plus a LoRA row). Reproducibility is good via a released library, pinned revisions, released LoRA adapter, and a candid component-status table (Table 4), though the release implements only part of the stated design.

primary_link.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

papers.summary: Are frontier models able to introspect about their internal states? Recent work suggests that under certain conditions a complex enough model can audit its own internals, call out what changed, and report back confidently about it. We tested that claim on eight open-weight models from seven families and found no such ability: asked whether their own computation had been altered, none answered better than chance. To test it we built Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), a framework that interv
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型能否內省自身內部運算？近年研究暗示大型模型有時能察覺被注入的概念向量，但 chain-of-thought 監控、自我批評等 oversight 機制皆假設模型能如實自述自身計算。本文提出 Open-Weight Masked Introspection（OWMI）框架：在殘差流位置、注意力頭或 SAE 特徵上施加可控干預後詢問模型是否察覺改動，並以三種對照設下基準——未改動的 sham 執行、影響匹配的隨機擾動，以及只見輸出文字的觀察者；框架直接掛載 MMLU、GSM8K 等既有評測。在來自七個實驗室家族、0.5B 至 15B 的八個模型上累計逾 78,000 次量測，無任何模型的報告能超越機率地區分真實干預與 sham（AUROC 約 0.5007），等價性檢定更將優勢上界壓至 0.15 個 AUROC 百分點內；且七個模型在隨機擾動下反而更常回報「有變化」，顯示報告只反映擾動本身而非被改對象。但儀器靈敏：經 fine-tuning 學會報告此類干預的模型在同一管線下達 d′=5.15、AUROC≈1.0；線性探針自相同激活辨識干預的 held-out 準確率達 75% 至 95.8%，至輸出前最後幾層更無任何錯誤，證明資訊存在於內部狀態、卻未抵達語言報告。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的離散答案雖恆定，其信心分數仍以 AUROC 0.647 區分干預與否。限制含主實驗僅測單一殘差流位置與劑量、延遲與自發軌跡未完成、重建探針缺 ground truth，規模上限 15B。此結果攸關 AI 安全：仰賴模型自述的監控須以內部參照驗證，讀取激活的 oversight 才掌握真正含訊號的通道。

links.title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null

evidence: Abstract: audits three rounds of rank-32 LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, identifying seven measurement failures each of which inverts a reported finding

Section 4.1: a frozen model under a single greedy decode shows clr=1.5 (9 corruptions vs 6 learnings) on MATH-500; serializing requests cuts verdict flips from 16/200 to 4/200 (Fisher p=0.005), leaving a 2% residual
Section 4.2: the ER1 expansion statistic assigns the frozen control 0.280 on AIME; pooled over 110 frozen comparisons the ER2 null is 0.058 [0.038,0.078], and no threshold below m=5 reaches zero

Section 5, Table 2: matched AIME ladder with stream/volume/evaluation matched — distillation detects 8-11 of 22 low-base problems per seed vs 0-2 for self-training arms; logistic interaction beta=1.91 [1.25,2.56], p<10^-8; on the 10 base-0 problems the union is 5 vs 2, p=0.35 (not significant)
Section 4.3/F5, Table 13: majority-vote SFT clr spans 0.55-1.53 across three seeds scored on the same 175 problems while STaR stays 0.45-0.74
Appendix D.1, Table 18: the ER2 null re-estimated from every subset ranges 0.022-0.098 at G=4 replicates and only stabilizes within +/-0.02 at G=9
Appendix A.4, Table 6: 48 runs, 3.44M sampled generations, 5.30B tokens, $3,171 itemized; measurement infrastructure 13% of spend and key controls cost $0

Appendix D.4, Table 24: refusal probe gives -0.015, -0.115, -0.005 across three replicates; authors report a bound (~11 points) rather than a safety claim, with cluster-robust SEs and design effect 1.8-2.8x

Appendix E.3: limitations — one backbone family carries all claims, 3 rounds/~270 optimizer steps, expansion rests on 22 low-base problems on one benchmark, corruption band built from MATH training problems

Reproducibility Statement: per-problem counts, noise-floor runs, evaluation subsets, and recomputation code released at github.com/chengxuphd/phantom-gains; every reported number computed by released code rather than transcribed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically rigorous audit of transition-level self-improvement claims for LLMs (Qwen3-8B, STaR/TTRL-style self-training, distillation control) that lands squarely in high-weight preference areas: LLM reasoning (AIME/MATH), RL/SFT training, and evaluation methodology, with a secondary safety probe. Preference relevance is high though not maximal (no Japanese NLP, no agents, no new LLM method). Novelty is solid but partly incremental: the paper candidly frames its headline consolidation finding as a replication of concurrent work (Strozzi 2026) and concedes the analytic null nearly matches its measured floor for the recommended estimator; the genuinely new contributions are the seven demonstrated failure modes, the demonstration that no expansion threshold repairs the statistic (measured ER2 null 0.058 over 110 frozen comparisons), and the replicate-count guidance (G>=9). Rigor is exceptional: frozen controls pushed through identical pipelines, design-matched floors, multiple-testing robustness checks, seed replication on matched problem sets, a tested mechanism for batching non-determinism, a logistic control for the teacher's larger gain, cluster-robust refusal analysis, and a reported falsified pre-registered prediction. Evidence strength is high: 48 runs, 3.44M generations, itemized costs, per-problem itemization of all 29 base-unreached AIME items, effect-size envelopes, and transcripts. Generalizability is the weak point and the paper says so: one backbone family, one domain (math), only 3 rounds/~270 LoRA steps, expansion resting on 22 low-base problems (10 truly base-0, non-significant), corruption measured on a constructed band that is not a natural forgetting rate. Reproducibility is strong: released per-problem records and recomputation code, full configuration and grading rules, compute accounting; minor deductions for the Tinker-service dependency and 15GB raw records available only on request.
topics: statistical power, seeds, and multiple testing

primary_link.title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null

papers.summary: Whether a language model has improved itself is increasingly judged not by mean accuracy but by which individual problems it gains and loses. Tracking these transitions means differencing two noisy estimates, leaving them vulnerable to measurement artifacts. Auditing three rounds of rank-$32$ LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, we identify seven measurement failures, each of which inverts a reported finding when its control is absent. papers.summary_zh: 模型「自我改進」是否屬實，不能只看平均準確率，而須追蹤個別題目能力的獲得與失去。但這種轉變層級審計是兩個含雜訊估計值的差值，極易被測量假象誤導。本文以 Qwen3-8B 執行三輪 rank-32 LoRA 自我訓練（STaR、多數決 SFT、政策梯度），讓凍結的未訓練對照模型走過完全相同的評估管線，並以蒸餾自 gpt-oss-120b 的外部教師作為正向對照，在 MATH-500、AIME 與 1,163 題難度帶上審計。作者識別出七種測量失敗模式：單次貪婪解碼會為未訓練模型製造破壞與學習比 1.5 的假象（主因為推論批次處理的非決定性）；現行擴展統計量給同一模型 0.280 的擴展率；以兩次成功為門檻的自然修正也不成立，實測虛無值為 0.058 而非零。作者改以對合併基線的逐題精確檢定並控制錯誤發現率，在所有保留的獨立重複上皆未偵測到任何事件。在資料流、樣本數與評估皆匹配的比較中，外部蒸餾能改善基礎模型鮮少觸及的 22 題中的 8–11 題，三種自我訓練僅 0–2 題，且邏輯斯迴歸否定此不對稱僅源自教師整體提升較大（p<10⁻⁸）；但對基礎模型從未觸及的題目證據未達顯著，而自我訓練破壞已解題目的數量遠超實測底線（88–106 對 8）。限制包括僅三輪訓練、擴展結論依賴單一基準、以及所有主張僅由單一族系骨幹模型支撐。本文核心訊息：轉變層級審計須為每個統計量實測虛無基準，而多臂研究其實已免費擁有這些重複評估。

links.title: Auditing and Decomposing Feedback-Driven Evolution in LLM Test Generation under the Oracle Problem

evidence: Abstract: 'On external inputs where three accepted implementations agree, generated outputs match the panel only 27.79% and 50.12% of the time. A single reference inflates the apparent evolutionary gain by 9.46–14.85 percentage points; after audit, equal-budget independent resampling is 6.01–18.83 points better.'

Section 3.1 / Table 1: 'The external cohort was hash-locked before fresh generation from TestCase-Eval: 114 non-interactive tasks'; models are 'Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Instruct' and 'the released Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint with thinking disabled'.

Section 3.5 (Inference and integrity): 'External programs run in bubblewrap namespaces with time, memory, process, and output limits... Model artifacts, cohorts, folds, generated rows, analyses, and paper summaries are linked by SHA-256 locks.'

Table 5 / Section 4.2: gain inflation intervals '9.46–14.85 pp across all four conditions... with every 95% interval strictly above zero'; Table 6: 'Matched exceeds Evolve by 18.83 and 9.72 pp on development and by 10.91 and 6.01 pp externally'.

Table 10 / Section 4.6: 'Real–Placebo is much smaller: +1.99 pp [+0.08, +3.88] and +0.28 pp [−1.41, +2.03]... Both model-specific decisions are inconclusive'; Table 11: yield-matched replay gives '−0.30 and +0.78 pp, both with zero-crossing intervals'.

Section 4.5 / Table 8: blinded audit with '91.67% exact agreement and Cohen's κ=.823'; 'Overall, 94.41% (95% CI [91.85, 96.51]) are jointly judged invalid, while 3.60% [2.23, 5.14] are jointly judged valid.'
Section 7 (External validity): 'Both model conditions are from the Qwen family... they neither establish cross-family generality nor identify a scale effect'; all tasks algorithmic and Python-family.

Data Availability: 'An anonymized replication package containing protocol locks, task-level derived metrics, analysis code... is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-test-evolution-audit-8CF5/.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology audit study (not a pure domain application): it uses Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Qwen3.5-9B for test generation and rigorously dissects whether feedback-driven self-evolution gains are oracle artifacts. Strongly aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, code/programming, agents/self-evolution, evaluation). The freeze-then-audit protocol, candidate-budget matching, density-matched feedback placebo, cross-fitted real faults, and blinded human semantic audit (κ=.823) constitute an unusually rigorous, honestly-scoped design: pre-specified gates, disclosed protocol amendments, explicit 'qualification-amended' labeling, and refusal to overclaim (feedback effect left 'unresolved'). Quantitative results are consistent across seeds, metrics, and cohorts (gain inflation 9.46–14.85 pp; resampling beats mutation-based evolution by 6.01–18.83 pp in all 12 cells). Main weaknesses: generalizability limited to one model family and Python exact-output algorithmic tasks (acknowledged in Section 7), the flagship RQ6 feedback contrast is inconclusive/post-hoc/amended, and development cohorts were exposed. Reproducibility is strong via an anonymized replication package with SHA-256-locked artifacts. Novelty is solid but incremental in that it is a diagnostic protocol rather than a new capability or method.

However, when generated inputs are executed on a single accepted program and its outputs are used as ground truth, invalid or underspecified inputs can create spurious fault detections and apparent evolutionary gains. papers.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型（LLM）自動產生測試時的「測試預言」問題進行系統性稽核。常見捷徑是把產生的輸入交給一個通過測試的參考程式，並將其輸出視為真值，這會把超出規格的行為偽裝成錯誤偵測與演化進展。作者提出「先凍結後稽核」協定：先以單一參考程式選出測試，再由其他獨立通過的實作差異覆核，並比較真實的三輪執行回饋迴圈與密度匹配的安慰劑對照。實驗涵蓋142個開發、114個程序鎖定的外部，以及138個保留（held-out）但資格經修訂的任務，使用Qwen2.5-Coder-7B與Qwen3.5-9B兩個模型、三個種子。結果顯示：外部任務上模型預期輸出與多實作面板一致率僅27.79%與50.12%；單一參考會膨脹表面演化增益9.46至14.85個百分點；稽核後，等預算的獨立重抽樣比突變式演化好6.01至18.83個百分點。真實回饋與安慰劑差異僅+0.13與−0.50個百分點，保留群體上為+1.99與+0.28，皆未達預設等效或優越門檻；配對可用產量後對比轉為−0.30與+0.78且信賴區間跨零。雙盲語意審查判定94.41%遭面板否決的輸入無效，但3.60%有效，顯示面板不一致是證據而非語意定論。限制包括安慰劑屬事後設計、保留群體資格檢核經修訂，且兩模型同屬Qwen家族，整體屬診斷性證據而非乾淨的確證實驗。本文貢獻在於提供一套分離驗證器假象、互動鷹架與真實回饋貢獻的稽核協定，可作為未來回饋驅動測試演化研究的評估準則。

links.title: Stopping and Routing LLM Judge Panels

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: formulates judge-panel design as role-conditioned allocation producing a calling policy pi(x) with validation-based stopping across reasoning, code, safety, preference, reward-model, and summarization audits.

Section 2, Lemma 1: projection gain identity showing conditional gain g_P(j|S) is nonnegative with no independence assumption; Section 2 'Construction rule' adds judges only if cost-adjusted validation gain exceeds tau, with final-test-only reporting.

Section 3: baselines include single best, flat panels, matched-K top-k/correlation/quality-diversity panels, full-call ridge/logistic stacking, Dawid-Skene reliability juries, and FrugalGPT/RouteLLM cascades; results averaged over 10 random splits with Appendix E confidence intervals.

Table 4: matched non-role panel achieves 0.2114 risk at cost 2.90 on hard GSM8K vs role policy 0.2137, and Table 13 shows MBPP role risk 0.0097±0.0096 and JBB role 0.1094±0.0106 vs full-call stack 0.1069±0.0034 — several key advantages fall within interval overlap.

Table 9: copy stress test shows four exact DeepSeek copies leave role risk/cost unchanged (LLMBar 0.1884/3.46) while reliability jury risk degrades to 0.2860 at 11 calls; Table 20 reports pair-addition audits with 0 pair-only moves on LLMBar/MBPP but 3 on JBB.
Appendix C (Table 11) and Appendix D disclose judge pools, normalized costs, route keys, and baseline implementations; no code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document.

Section 7 and Appendix G acknowledge pattern-table sparsity (LLMBar 4.4% test fallback), unstable low-frequency routes, and calibrator scaling limits, supporting a self-critical limitations treatment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM evaluation methodology paper: role-conditioned allocation of LLM-as-a-judge panels (copies/complements/specialists) with cost-aware stopping and routing, evaluated across reasoning (GSM8K/MATH-500), code (MBPP), safety (JailbreakBench), preference (LLMBar/RewardBench/Arena100K), and summarization audits using DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Prometheus judges. Strongly matches LLM, evaluation/red-teaming, safety, reasoning, code, and reward-model preferences. Novelty is moderate: it recombines conditional feature selection, active feature acquisition, cascades (FrugalGPT/RouteLLM), and stacking for the judge-call setting; the copy/complement/specialist policy framing and auditable stopping reports are the main new elements. Rigor is solid (validation-selected vs held-out test split, 10 splits with CIs, threshold/cost sweeps, sparsity and pair-addition audits, copy stress test), but several headline routing wins have overlapping confidence intervals and small audit sets (JBB 149 test rows; MBPP role risk 0.0097±0.0096), and the matched non-role panel slightly beats the role policy on hard GSM8K at equal budget. Evidence supports the stop/drop-copy claims cleanly; routing gains are weaker statistically. The paper is honest about boundary regimes where full-call stacking wins. Generalizability is decent across tasks but requires a labeled audit set, pre-declared slices, and finite pattern calibrators whose scaling limits are acknowledged. No code/artifact release is stated; judge outputs depend on reproducible API/local models, though pools, costs, thresholds, and baseline implementations are documented in appendices.

primary_link.title: Stopping and Routing LLM Judge Panels

The deployment question is not only which judge is best, but which judges should be called, on which examples, and when panel construction should stop. We formulate judge-panel design as a role-conditioned allocation problem. From a small labeled audit set, declared slices, and judge costs, the method estimates target-rela
papers.summary_zh: LLM 評估管線常有多個候選評審：通用 LLM-as-a-judge 提示、獎勵模型、安全分類器等。部署時的關鍵問題不只是哪個評審最好，而是該呼叫哪些評審、在哪些樣本上呼叫、以及何時停止建構面板。本文將評審面板設計形式化為角色條件化分配問題：從小型標註稽核集、宣告的切片與評審成本，估計每位候選相對於目標的角色——複製者不帶來條件資訊應捨棄、互補者改善全域面板應加入、專家僅在特定切片有價值應條件路由，並在驗證增益低於門檻時停止。方法以貪婪驗證增益建構，產出附停止報告的可稽核呼叫計畫。實驗涵蓋推理、程式碼、安全、偏好、獎勵模型、摘要與數學稽核，並與單一評審、平坦面板、全呼叫堆疊、可靠性陪審團與節儉級聯等基線比較。結果顯示角色策略在 LLMBar 以約 3.46 次呼叫將準確率提升至 0.7334，在 MBPP 以低成本達到最佳準確率；複製壓力測試證明條件增益可辨識冗餘訊號。限制包括有限模式表的稀疏回退，以及路由訊號必須在部署前可取得。本文的價值在於提供風險成本權衡的 regime map：何時路由專家、何時提前停止、何時支付完整面板，讓下一批評估的呼叫決策可重複且可稽核。

links.title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract & Sec. III-A: MCB has 140 primary scenarios (70 dev / 70 held-out) plus a 70-item contrast set; two non-authors independently labeled held-out items with 97.1% agreement (Cohen's kappa=0.962), and a blind third resolved four disagreements, replacing eight author labels.

Table III: bare Qwen3.5-9B accuracy .557 with OM .243, clarification recall .000, verification recall .667; few-shot reaches .771 accuracy with clarification recall .333; all invalid-output rates zero.
Table IV: Qwen few-shot–bare delta=+.214 [114,.329], pH=.002; Qwen policy–bare (OM) delta=-.143, pH=.038; Holm correction families defined in Sec. III-B.

Sec. V-D: label-to-tool-call agreement is 0.571 for both Claude models and 0.229 for Qwen; Qwen act accuracy drops to .343 (pH=.047) with verification recall collapsing to .056; every emitted argument passes deterministic well-formedness rules.

Sec. V-C: contrast-set labels reproduced with kappa=1.000; authors explicitly retain it as a 'controlled sensitivity check rather than claim naturalistic external validity' due to rule–template alignment.

Sec. VI: limitations state scenarios are synthetic and English-only, Qwen is one 9B quantized checkpoint, and act mode uses only the bare intervention; the artifact includes prompts, runners, frozen annotations, item-level outputs, and scripts that regenerate every table and paired test.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference work on LLM agent memory commitment, tool-call selection, and prompting interventions (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Long Context & Memory, Evaluation, Prompting all strongly matched). Novelty is solid but incremental: it composes known ideas (storage gating from PerMemBench, clarification from CLAMBER, tool-mediated eval from tau-bench) into a four-way persist/ephemeral/verify/clarify decision with a source-of-truth distinction. Rigor is unusually strong for a benchmark paper: blind non-author labels with kappa=0.962, documented label changes, exact paired McNemar tests with Holm correction, bootstrap CIs, leakage baselines, and an honest 'what this does not establish' section. Evidence is internally consistent (e.g., Qwen few-shot +0.214, pH=0.002; OM 0.243->0.100, pH=0.038; act-mode drops), though the n=70 primary test yields wide CIs, only one checkpoint per family is tested, the contrast set's kappa=1.000 is acknowledged as possibly tautological, and MCB-Act records rather than executes tool calls. Generalizability is limited by synthetic English-only scenarios, a single quantized 9B Qwen checkpoint, model-dependent error policies, and act mode restricted to the bare condition. Reproducibility claims are strong: digests, seeds, temperature, prompts, item-level outputs, and scripts regenerating all tables and tests, though no external artifact URL is verifiable in the text.

primary_link.title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents

papers.summary: Persistent memory can personalize an LLM agent, but an incorrect durable update can silently distort future behavior. We study the memory-clarification boundary: whether interaction-derived information should be persisted, used only in the current context, re-verified, or clarified with the user. MCB contains 140 primary scenarios, split into 70 development and 70 held-out items, plus a separate 70-item contrast set. It evaluates both action labels and structured tool-call selection. Two non-aut
papers.summary_zh: 具持久記憶的 LLM agent 能個人化行為，但錯誤的持久更新可能悄悄扭曲未來表現。本文研究記憶—澄清邊界：互動中取得的資訊應持久儲存（persist）、僅限當前脈絡（ephemeral）、對世界重新驗證（verify），還是向使用者澄清（clarify）。作者提出 MCB 基準，含 140 個主要情境（70 開發、70 留出）與 70 個對照集，同時評估動作標籤與結構化工具呼叫選擇；由兩位非作者獨立標註留出集（一致率 97.1%，Cohen's κ=0.962）。實驗涵蓋 Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6 與本地 Qwen3.5-9B，在裸提示、五條規則政策提示與 few-shot 示範下測試。主要發現為跨家族的低提問（under-asking）不對稱：模型驗證變動事實比向使用者澄清更可靠，裸 Qwen 在 12 個澄清項上 0 次提問。Few-shot 將 Qwen 準確率由 0.557 提升至 0.771，政策提示將錯誤持久化由 0.243 降至 0.100，但兩者皆未消除低提問。工具呼叫模式下準確率顯著下降，Qwen 的標籤與工具選擇一致率僅 23%。限制為留出集僅 70 項、信賴區間寬、情境皆為合成英文。本文顯示記憶評估應同時檢驗聲明決策與實際工具行為，對降低隱私與個人化失敗具有實務意義。

links.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents

evidence: Table 2: task-level +Text averages 20.9 vs 22.1 None while subtask-level +Text averages 26.7 vs 24.8 None, with 95% task-bootstrap CIs
Sec 5.1: task-level skills lower average success by 1.2 (Text) and 4.1 (Code) points; subtask-level raises 1.9 (Text) and 0.5 (Code)
Sec 3: both induction levels share the same induction prompt and the no-memory comparison cancels agent differences
App E.2 Fig 25: subtask-level skills replayed into the task-level agent beat its own skills on every benchmark (+9.9 average, up to 17.2 on AppWorld)
App E.4 Table 4: high-utility half beats low-utility half by only 1.1-1.4 points with overlapping bootstrap CIs (44.0 vs 42.9; 48.4 vs 47.0)
App E.6 Table 6: self-retrieval rates 75.6-88.1% across conditions; code self-retrieves better yet helps less, ruling out retrieval quality
App E.5: code skills retrieved as often as text on five of six benchmark-format pairs, decoupling reuse frequency from utility
Footnote 1 and Table 7: code, data, and induced skill libraries to be released at github.com/Zesearch/skill-transfer-llm-agents under MIT
Limitations: computer use, agentic coding, and web search settings excluded due to Docker root-access constraints; no step-level grading without a judge model
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-preference: LLM agents, skill memory, tool use, and task decomposition match Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), Long Context & Memory (1.8), and Code & Programming (2.0); not in any out-of-scope category. Novelty is moderate: the controlled task-vs-subtask and text-vs-code factorial comparison across 3 benchmarks and 11 models is a genuine systematic contribution, but subtask-level induction and skill libraries exist in prior work (SSO, MUSE, AWM), and the skill utility score is a simple product of two embedding-based measures formalizing an already-hypothesized tension. Rigor is strong: shared induction prompt isolating one axis (Sec 3), bootstrap CIs (Table 2), prompt-level ablations L1-L3 (Sec 4, Fig 26), source-outcome confound check (App E.3), cross-agent skill replay (App E.2), retrieval validation (App E.6), and cost-matched efficiency analysis (Fig 3). Evidence supports the headline claims but with modest effect sizes (Text +1.9 points at subtask level) and the causal utility split shows only 1.1-1.4 point differences with overlapping CIs (Table 4), and per-model variation is large (e.g., GPT-OSS-120B task-level None 27.3 vs +Code 1.0). Generalizability is good across domains and model families but limited to simulated English benchmarks; authors honestly flag exclusion of computer use, agentic coding, and web search (Limitations). Reproducibility is high: full prompts in App A, code/data released, models and licenses tabulated (Table 7).

primary_link.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induc
papers.summary_zh: LLM agent 可從完成的任務歸納技能存入技能記憶並重複使用，但實務上技能轉移不可靠，甚至可能傷害檢索到它的 agent。本文探討核心問題：何時 agent 自行歸納的技能能可靠跨任務轉移？作者進行受控研究，比較兩個軸線：技能歸納層級（整條軌跡的任務層級 vs 逐個子任務的子任務層級）與技能格式（文字筆記 vs Python 程式碼），涵蓋 AppWorld、OfficeBench、KramaBench 三個長程基準與 11 個開放權重及專有模型。結果顯示：任務層級技能多半使表現低於無記憶基線，子任務層級技能則平均拉高表現；文字技能在兩種層級下都比程式碼技能轉移更好。為解釋原因，作者定義技能效用分數為特異性（技能貼近真實任務的程度）與抽象性（相關性均勻分布於多任務的程度）之乘積：單一維度無法預測成功，乘積則與任務成功一致相關，且子任務層級與文字技能得分較高；實際的重複使用密度也支持此分數。效用分數僅需技能與任務描述即可計算，不需執行任務，可作為技能記憶的輕量診斷工具。限制包括僅涵蓋三個基準、固定歸納與檢索規則，以及電腦使用等環境需要 root Docker 難以擴展驗證。此研究為 agent 技能記憶設計提供明確的實務指引。

links.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments across three domains—a standard multi-LLM benchmark, retrieval-augmented specialists, and LLMs with variable inference-time reasoning—show that Pandora's Router matches the routing quality of exhaustive estimation, while querying the expensive estimator far less often.'
§1 Core contributions: 'To our knowledge, this is the first paper to explicitly connect model routing with the classical Pandora's Box problem from economics and operations research.'
§4 Table 2: Pandora's Router achieves total regret+cost of 0.105 (MATH), 0.118 (RAG), 0.386 (EmbedLLM), vs. Margin-Npr at 0.105, 0.128, 0.389 and g-only at 0.128, 0.141, 2.356.

§4 Results: 'Pandora minimizes regret plus inspection cost at nearly all cost levels c_g, in all settings'; also notes 'the aggregate results for Pandora's Router and Margin-Npr are nearly identical' in MATH.

§D.4: asterisk marks significance at p<.05 via paired bootstrap, but the text concedes that at intermediate costs the difference 'is usually not statistically significant with respect to all alternatives.'
Appendix A, Proposition 1 with proof: 'E[R_{M̂}−C_O] = E[G*_{M̂}−C_O]' justifying routing on posterior decision values under conditional independence.

§7 Limitations: 'The Gaussian signal model, while tractable, may not capture the heavy tails or multimodality present in some domains'; 'the myopic VoI computation in the leave-one-out auction does not account for strategic anticipation of future bids.'
§D.6 Table 6: KNN non-Gaussian signal model improves calibration coverage (e.g., 63.0%-74.8% for ±1σ) but 'we did not see a significant improvement in regret + cost.'

Appendix C: implementation details include Gemini Embedding 2 with k=3 KNN, S=100 Monte Carlo samples, fine-tuning 'Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite as the base model'; Appendix C.3 reports compute (e.g., 64 TPUs, up to 6 hours for MATH estimators); no code release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on LLM routing with costly value estimation, instantiated in three in-scope domains (multi-LLM selection, RAG specialists, inference-time chain-of-thought scaling), so preference relevance is high. Novelty is solid: the claimed first connection of model routing to the Pandora's Box problem with a closed-form Gaussian VoI policy, plus a decentralized auction extension. Rigor is good: formal propositions with proofs (Appendix A), matched-budget ablations (Random-Npr, Margin-Npr), cost sweeps, and paired bootstrap significance tests, though the Gaussian signal model is an acknowledged approximation and the main gains over the strongest baseline (Margin-Npr) are small and often not statistically significant. Evidence is quantitative and per-domain (Table 2; Tables 3-5), but headline improvements in MATH are near-ties and significance is sparse at intermediate costs. Generalizability is moderate: requires a two-tier estimator hierarchy and calibration data; tested on only three settings with two to ~100 specialists. Reproducibility is partial: public datasets, detailed prompts, hyperparameters (k=3, S=100), fine-tuning base model, and cost derivations are given, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation

papers.summary: Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most effectively at the lowest cost. Routing requires estimating each specialist's expected return, but this value estimation has a cost. Cheap estimators (e.g., embedding-based predictors) are fast but noisy, while accurate estimators (e.g., fine-tuned models with access to retrieval results or partial r
papers.summary_zh: 將查詢路由到最合適的專家模型需要估計各專家的期望回報，但價值估計本身有成本：便宜估計器（如嵌入相似度 KNN）快但雜訊多，準確估計器（如 fine-tuned 模型搭配檢索結果或部分推理軌跡）昂貴。本文首次將此權衡形式化為經濟學與作業研究中的 Pandora's Box 問題（非義務檢視變體）：每位專家視為一個盒子，路由器可付費開啟以取得更準的價值估計。在高斯訊號模型下，保留價格與資訊價值具有封閉形式解，據此提出集中式 Pandora's Router，依保留價格順序檢視、在增益低於成本時停止；並延伸出去中心化 Pandora's Bidder，專家在定價拍賣中自行決定是否投資自我評估後接受或拒絕價格。實驗涵蓋三領域：EmbedLLM 多模型路由基準、檢索增強問答，以及可變推理時間的數學任務。結果顯示 Pandora's Router 在各估計成本水準幾乎達到最低的 regret 加檢查成本，同時大幅減少昂貴估計器的查詢次數；去中心化設定中，資訊價值推理在競爭者估計準確時改善配置效率，但競爭者估計雜訊大時可能提高策略專家自身效用而損及整體效率。限制包括高斯模型難以捕捉重尾分布、僅考慮兩層估計器，以及拍賣僅為單輪。本文為模型選擇的經濟學提供原則性且可實作的框架。

links.title: PRAXIS: Graph-Grounded Tacit Knowledge for Domain Code Generation

evidence: Section IV-B, Table I: PRAXIS achieves 32.06 avg Pass@1 vs 27.48 for best baseline (OpenCollab), reported as 16.7% relative improvement
Section IV-B, Table II: ablation removing development practice drops Pass@1 32.06->27.48; w/o Graph Organization 28.25; w/o Proactive Injection 28.24
Section IV-C, Table III: consistent gains across OpenHands/SWE-Agent with DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3.6-Plus, and GPT-5.5-20260424 (e.g., 16.03->42.75 on GPT-5.5)
Section IV-E, Table V: 75 sampled knowledge units rated by two engineers; content truthfulness 4.28/5 and confidence-rating Spearman rho=0.75 (p<0.001)
Footnote 2 (Section IV-B): paired t-test shows significant differences on AvgPassRatio at p<0.05
Section III-C: practice tasks filtered to >80% line coverage and evaluated via differential testing against ground-truth implementations
Section VI (Threats to Validity): authors concede no exhaustive hyperparameter search due to LLM API cost and possible gap between agent practice and real human development
Abstract/Section VII: source code and data claimed available at https://github.com/jiangxxxue/PRAXIS
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent framework for domain-specific code generation, directly hitting Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM preferences. The core idea—extracting undocumented 'tacit' knowledge via in-codebase practice with differential testing, anchoring units on a dependency graph, and proactively injecting them—is a meaningful but incremental advance over experience/skill-memory methods (SWE-Exp, Trace2Skill, AgentKB); the distributed, graph-grounded, proactive delivery is the main novelty. Rigor is solid: four ablations, cross-framework and cross-model generalization (Table III), a second benchmark/task type (Table IV), scaling curves, cost analysis, a paired t-test (footnote 2, Section IV-B), and human quality assessment of 75 knowledge units with Spearman rho=0.75 (Table V). Weaknesses: no exhaustive hyperparameter search (Section VI), LLM-based extraction/adjudication steps are hard to verify, the near-catastrophic SWE-Exp baseline (7.83 Pass@1, below the base model) suggests baseline tuning concerns, and evaluation is limited to two AI/scientific-domain benchmarks. Reproducibility is supported by released code/data (Abstract, Section VII) and specified hyperparameters (R_max=3, depth 4, theta=0.7, beta=0.8, temperature 0), though reliance on proprietary LLM APIs and LLM-judged filtering reduces determinism.

primary_link.title: PRAXIS: Graph-Grounded Tacit Knowledge for Domain Code Generation

papers.summary: LLM agents have achieved strong performance on general software engineering tasks, yet struggle with domain-specific code generation. We identify the root cause as the agent's lack of tacit knowledge, including domain-specific business rules, interface contracts, and operational conventions that developers internalize through practice but never document. This knowledge is deeply buried beneath the domain code, dispersed across code entities and their dependency relations, and invisible to the ag
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理在一般軟體工程任務上表現優異，但在領域程式碼生成時效能大幅滑落。作者指出根因在於代理缺乏隱性知識：領域業務規則、介面契約與操作慣例等開發者長期內化卻從未記載的知識；此類知識深埋於程式碼之下、分散在程式實體與依賴關係中，且缺乏者不自知，因此難以擷取與學習。PRAXIS 分四階段處理：先讓代理在目標程式碼庫中模擬人類開發流程，透過差異測試讓隱性知識浮現；再將行為差異蒸餾為含 trigger、content、evidence、confidence 的結構化知識單元；接著把知識錨定在靜態分析建出的依賴圖上，沿邊傳播並進行去重與衝突裁決；最後於任務初始化與程式互動時主動注入相關知識。在 KoCo-Bench 上，PRAXIS 搭配 DeepSeek-V3.2 達 Pass@1 32.06%，較最佳基線相對提升 16.7%，並超越經驗式與技能式演化方法；增益跨 OpenHands、SWE-Agent 等框架與多種 LLM 一致，也能遷移至 AInsteinBench 的儲存庫層級除錯任務，效能更隨練習量與線上知識演化穩定成長。限制包括超參數未窮盡搜尋、代理練習與真人開發仍有落差。整體而言，此方法免訓練、可疊加於既有代理，直指領域知識是部署 AI 代理於真實開發的最後一道關卡。

Table 2 (Ablation Study): removing parametric memory raises Add Health KL from 4.0635 to 5.3517 and removing structured memory to 6.2815 (Llama-8B), supporting complementarity of both components.

Appendix J, Tables 12-15: hyperparameter sweeps over temporal decay (alpha_ret=0.9), replay weight (eta=0.5), and LoRA rank (r=32 best, r=8 chosen for cost), plus Table 14 showing LifeMem gains persist across retriever choices.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper with strong overlap to top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/memory, RAG, LoRA training, and bias mitigation). LifeMem pairs structured life-event retrieval with per-agent LoRA parametric memory for longitudinal social simulation, a credible and reasonably novel dual-memory design grounded in complementary learning systems. Evaluation is unusually thorough: two longitudinal survey datasets, three backbones, eight baselines including a Random Event control, four formally defined metrics, paired t-test significance, three-seed robustness (best mean in 16/18 settings), component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps (decay, replay weight, LoRA rank, retriever choice), and efficiency/storage analysis. Limitations: only 100 respondents per dataset, purely distribution-level gap metrics with no qualitative/behavioral validation, deterministic decoding, GPT-3.5-turbo used for statement conversion as a potential confound, and per-agent adapters whose scalability beyond small populations is untested; generalizability beyond survey-response simulation is not demonstrated. Code link, prompts, seeds, and hyperparameters are provided, supporting good reproducibility, though respondent-level adapters are withheld. Claims are appropriately hedged ('pattern consistent with identity essentialism').

primary_link.title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories

Existing methods can partially reproduce population-level patterns, yet often fail to capture human-like diversity. Our analysis shows that static-profile agents exhibit stronger demographic separation and within-group compression than humans, a pattern consistent with identity essentialism: demographic labels can encourage models to treat group-average tenden
papers.summary_zh: 以靜態人口屬性檔案建構的 LLM 社會模擬代理，常呈現「身分本質主義」：同一人口群體內的回應被壓縮而趨於同質，群體間差異則被誇大，與人類資料的分布不符。作者歸因於兩點：代理表徵稀疏且靜態，以及僅靠提示詞的記憶無法持續整合經驗。受互補學習系統理論啟發，LifeMem 採雙記憶架構：一是海馬式的結構化生命事件記憶，以語意相似度結合時間衰減擷取相關事件；二是皮質式的參數記憶，為每位代理維護獨立的 LoRA adapter，逐波次以含重播機制的序列更新，把累積經驗固化為持久的參數狀態。在 Add Health 與 Understanding Society 兩個縱貫調查，以及 Llama-3.1-8B、Ministral-3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B 三種模型上，LifeMem 在 KL 散度、組內成對距離差距、正規化熵差距與轉移分布 JS 散度等指標，皆顯著優於靜態條件化、多樣性提示與 Event RAG 等基線；消融實驗證實兩元件互補，PCA 視覺化亦顯示代理參數狀態隨生命史逐漸分化。限制在於問卷涵蓋與粒度無法完整刻畫人生經驗，自陳資料亦帶有回憶偏差。此研究為建構更忠實、動態演化的社會模擬代理提供可行路徑，並有助於避免刻板印象在模擬中被放大。
papers.title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories
papers.title_zh: 以縱貫生命軌跡緩解 LLM 代理的身分本質主義

links.title: LiLiCorr: Lightweight Likelihood Correlation of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding

evidence: Abstract & Contributions: LiLiCorr raises acceptance length over vanilla DFlash by 9-19% on every benchmark and leads throughput in 70 of 72 settings (nine benchmarks x two targets x two decoding regimes, plus a 36-point concurrency sweep).

§4.1 Baselines/Implementation: Domino and DSpark are retrained on the same ~1.4M-example Nemotron Post-Training Dataset V2 corpus for the same six epochs and ported onto a common SGLang stack; per-block head cost 0.28 ms (LiLiCorr) vs 0.67 ms (Domino), ~2.8% of per-block wall, corroborated by Table 3 stage decomposition.

§4.2 Table 1: under greedy decoding LiLiCorr is fastest in all 18 benchmark settings, leading the strongest baseline by up to 4.9% on the benchmark average; at T=1 (exact rejection sampling) fastest in 17 of 18.
Appendix C Table 11: removing the target-weighted distractor penalty lowers acceptance length on all nine benchmarks (1.5-8.9%), isolating the loss term under a fixed reranker budget.
Appendix E Table 12: exact Viterbi path selection lowers acceptance length on all nine benchmarks versus greedy (mean -2.44%), supporting the prefix-acceptance argument of §3.3/§3.5.

§4.3.1 + Appendix F/G: lead persists on 8K-32K inputs beyond the 3,072-token training range with YaRN positional extension and a hinge margin regularizer; memory-limited rows honestly marked with daggers.
Appendix A Table 4: full hyperparameters given (block 16, K=8, d_e=1024, sigma=8, 36.76M/32.04M head params, AdamW, lr 6e-4/1.5e-4, 6 epochs, batch 64, seq 3072).
§5 Limitation: the method reranks only top-K drafter candidates, so acceptance is bounded by drafter coverage; non-adjacent slot couplings left open.
Document contains no code or model release URL/availability statement; §4.1 notes DSpark leaves no separate head stage to measure, so its comparison rests on end-to-end throughput only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference-acceleration methodology (speculative decoding on Qwen3-8B/4B targets), squarely matching the LLM, inference/serving, scaling/efficiency, and transformer preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is real but sits in a crowded concurrent space (Domino, DSpark): the contribution is a learned in/out-vector factorization that scores the whole candidate lattice in one pass, plus the useful finding that greedy beats exact Viterbi path selection under prefix acceptance. Rigor is strong: matched-training baselines on a common SGLang stack, exact rejection sampling at T=1, three-seed variance reporting, loss ablation (App. C), decode-rule ablation (App. E), and honest memory-bound caveats (App. F). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, though self-reported on the authors' own stack, and all comparisons are confined to the DFlash drafter family with no EAGLE-family or other drafter baseline, so 'state-of-the-art' is scoped to draft-time correlation. Gains over the strongest baseline are modest (up to ~4.9-7.2% throughput). Hyperparameters, data recipe, and baseline configs are detailed, but no code or checkpoint release is stated, limiting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: LiLiCorr: Lightweight Likelihood Correlation of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding

papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by drafting future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. A diffusion-style block head such as DFlash is an attractive drafter, predicting an entire block of future tokens in one forward pass. However, it is trained on per-position marginals rather than the joint block distribution, so the tokens it emits are individually plausible yet jointly incoherent. We introduce LiLiCorr, a Lightweight Likelihood-based model that Correla
papers.summary_zh: 在投機解碼中，DFlash 這類擴散式平行區塊起草器能以單次前向傳播預測整個區塊，成本極低，但其訓練只監督各槽位的邊際分布，導致選出的詞元個體合理、整體卻不連貫。LiLiCorr 提出輕量概似模型：保留每個槽位的前 K 個候選詞元，以一次雙向 Transformer 同時處理全部候選，為每個候選產生 in 與 out 兩個向量，相鄰槽位的配對分數即為前一候選 out 與後一候選 in 的餘弦相似度，使相關性計算化為可平行化的批次矩陣運算，最後僅以不觸及網路權重的貪婪走查依序選詞。訓練採前綴接受導向的局部正規化、oracle 前綴監督，以及依目標模型 logits 施加的干擾項懲罰，並與 DFlash 起草器共同訓練。實驗顯示，相較原始 DFlash，各基準接受長度提升 9% 至 19%；在相同服務堆疊與訓練預算下與同期方法 Domino、DSpark 比較，LiLiCorr 於 72 個設定中的 70 個取得最高吞吐量，其評分頭僅占每區塊延遲約 2.8%，成本約為 Domino 的 2.4 分之 1，搭配 YaRN 位置延伸還能外推至遠超訓練長度的輸入。主要限制是只重排前 K 個候選，接受長度受限於起草器的覆蓋率。此工作為草稿階段的連貫性重建確立了新的技術水準。

links.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 29 configurations of 6 systems on all 10 tasks the mean score is 0.166, and the best system reaches 0.250'; learning-touching submissions average 0.226 vs 0.126
Section 3.1 Setup: six systems (GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna under Codex at six efforts; Claude Opus 5/Sonnet 5 under Claude Code; Kimi K3), 29 configurations, 290 cells
Section 2.4 Baselines: baseline is the repository's committed code 'executed under the identical procedure and the same twelve-hour budget' with the same fixed evaluator and asset
Section 2.5 Scoring: progress coordinate with sigma=0.1 at shipped algorithm and 1.0 at task optimum; -log transform justified for perplexity (53.4->16.2 = 30% not 71%)
Section 4.1 Table 4: 141 of 263 classified submissions stay run-side only; learning-side gap 0.100 (SE 0.022), holds without RAGEN (0.182 vs 0.128); paper concedes 'not a randomized comparison'
Section 4.2: reasoning effort raises learning-touching share 8%->64% and mean 0.094->0.196 (SE 0.027); median evaluations 4->16; total exploration cost $5,334
Section 2.3 Protocol: 'The separation is one of access and timing rather than of sample disjointness' on some tasks, acknowledged limitation
Abstract and Conclusion: 'We release the task suite, the evaluators and every scored submission'; homepage link provided in metadata
Appendix A: task details (e.g., BTRM proxy is 512 of 2,985 pairs; OWL sparsity gate [0.699,0.701]) are specific and checkable
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: a benchmark evaluating frontier LLM coding agents (GPT-5.6, Claude 5, Kimi K3 under Codex/Claude Code) on editing real training-algorithm code, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Reasoning-effort, LLM, and Evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid if not maximal: agent benchmarks for ML research exist (MLE-Bench, MLGym, RE-Bench, MLS-Bench, autoresearch), but the isolation of 'algorithmic design' changes plus a run-side vs learning-side taxonomy of submitted diffs is a genuine new measurement. Rigor is good but imperfect: 290 cells with strict baseline-parity protocol and careful score mapping (-log for perplexity), yet single 12h runs per cell with no seed variance reported for stochastic training, an LLM-assigned diff classification, effort levels confounded with harness, and a harsh scale anchoring (optimum = best attainable, e.g. perplexity 1) that partly constructs the headline 'lowest fifth' finding. Evidence is strong: full result grids (Tables 2-3), costs, token counts, failure analysis of 19 zero cells, and concrete case studies traceable to tables; key gaps reported with standard errors (0.100 SE 0.022; 0.102 SE 0.027). Generalizability is moderate (10 diverse algorithm families, 6 systems, but 4h/12h budgets and current-generation agents make conclusions time-sensitive). Reproducibility is reasonable: task contracts reproduced verbatim and release of suite/evaluators/submissions promised, though replication requires large GPU spend and proprietary models.

primary_link.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

papers.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a better objective or update rule improves the compute\mbox{-}capability exchange rate for every subsequent run, including the one that produces the next agent. Whether RSI is feasible therefore turns on whether an agent can design training algorithms. No benchmark isolates that ability: existing sui
papers.summary_zh: 遞迴自我改進（RSI）能否成立，取決於 AI 系統能否改進「產生下一個系統的過程」，亦即訓練演算法本身；但現有基準多由資料工程或超參數調校取勝，無法區分「改變執行方式」與「改變學習方式」。AI4AI-Bench 凍結十個研究程式碼庫，涵蓋監督式 fine-tuning、多回合代理式 RL、on-policy 蒸餾、Bradley–Terry 獎勵模型、偏好最佳化、擴散 RL、機器遺忘、離散圖擴散、權重平均與一次性剪枝十族演算法。代理在單張 B300 上有四小時改寫訓練演算法，提交後的程式碼從乾淨狀態重跑至多十二小時，由預先固定且代理無法存取的評測器計分，並映射到 0（無資訊模型）、0.1（原版演算法）、1.0（最佳值）的統一量表。29 個組態、六個系統的平均分數僅 0.166，最佳系統 Claude Opus 5 達 0.250；263 份提交中有 141 份完全未改動模型如何學習，觸及學習機制者平均 0.226 對其餘的 0.126；提高推理努力主要提升「敢於觸及」的比例，從 8% 升至 64%，平均分數由 0.094 升至 0.196。限制包括任務僅十項、指標不可共量需依賴映射，且探索成本未計入 GPU 時數與評測運算。此基準為 RSI 的演算法層能力提供了可重複的測量工具。

links.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract & §4.2 Table 4: best model Claude-Opus-5 reaches 11.5 on NC2FT (autoformalization) vs 28.6 Pass@8 on FT2FP; no model exceeds 11.5 on NC2FT, supporting the autoformalization-bottleneck claim.

§3.1 & Appendix G: black-box leakage audit querying GPT-5.6-sol and Claude-Opus-5 without retrieval reports completion similarity below 9.6%, with explicit caveat that this indicates low rather than zero contamination risk.
Appendix E Table 22: inter-expert agreement of 86% (core claim), 90% (NL claim), 93% (formal proof); LLM-assisted annotations required 13-31% substantive expert revision.
Appendix F Table 23: LLM-rubric vs human agreement computed on only 16 randomly sampled examples; discrepancies 3.17-10.67% and identical model rankings.

§5.2 & Figure 4: of 64 agent-generated claims, 39 rejected for lack of novelty, 17 for lack of value, 2 had no proof, and 6 passed expert evaluation and proof verification; framework uses only GPT-5.6-sol.
Abstract footnote 1: code released at github.com/zirui-HIT/FormalTCS; Appendix D Table 21 pins model snapshots and harness versions (e.g., Codex v0.146.0, Claude Code v2.1.220).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM research: a 175-instance expert-validated benchmark evaluating frontier LLMs (GPT-5.6 family, Claude 4.5/5, DeepSeek-V4) on an end-to-end TCS research pipeline (claim elicitation, autoformalization, proof elicitation, Lean proving), plus a planner/formalizer/judger multi-agent framework for autonomous claim generation. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents/tool use, evaluation). Novelty is solid but incremental over TCS-Bench and Lean-based benchmarks: the differentiators are frontier 2025-2026 STOC/FOCS/SODA/COLT sources, preserved paper-specific dependencies, contamination auditing, and the research-taste finding. Rigor is good: five PhD annotators, inter-expert agreement 86-93% (Appendix E), verification-based metrics (BEq+ bidirectional proving, Pass@8 with sorry/axiom linters), and a leakage audit with honestly stated limits. Weaknesses: LLM-rubric human agreement is validated on only 16 sampled examples (Appendix F), the auto-research conclusion rests on 64 claims from a single model configuration with two-expert novelty judgment lacking reported inter-rater stats, and no significance testing. Evidence is quantitative and traceable but small-scale in Section 5; generalizability is bounded by TCS-specificity and proprietary models. Reproducibility is aided by released code, full prompts (Appendix B), and pinned model/harness versions (Table 21).

We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains $175$ instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 FormalTCS，一個由專家驗證、評測大型語言模型（LLM）端對端理論電腦科學（TCS）研究能力的基準。有別於既有著重孤立能力的評測，FormalTCS 涵蓋 175 個取自 STOC、FOCS、SODA 與 COLT 2025–2026 年論文的實例，保留論文特定的定義、假設與證明依賴，並附專家核驗的 Lean 形式化陳述與證明，同時以黑箱稽核降低資料污染風險。研究將研究流程拆解為核心主張理解、自動形式化（NC2FT）、證明策略生成（C2NP）與定理證明（FT2FP）四項任務，評測 GPT、Claude 與 DeepSeek 等主流模型。結果顯示自動形式化是最尖銳的瓶頸：最佳模型僅得 11.5 分，遠低於證明人類提供之形式化定理的 28.6 Pass@8。作者另建立自動化 TCS 研究框架，在 64 個生成主張中僅 6 個經專家評估與證明驗證留存，顯示研究品味不足是另一主要障礙。此基準為衡量自主 TCS 研究進展提供寫實的測試場，雖然標註仍仰賴 LLM 輔助且規模有限。

evidence: §3.4: 'All pipeline stages use gpt-5.4 at temperature 1.0'; gpt-5.5 and claude-sonnet-5 serve as judges; gpt-5-mini generates skills and executes held-out tasks
§4.1 Table 1: latent task induction achieves ARI 0.974 ± 0.028 and MAE 0.48 overall across K∈{2..15}, d∈{2..4}
§4.3 Table 4: step description accuracy 74.9% vs 30.3% for strongest workflow-induction baseline (gpt-5.5 judge); operator correctness 88.5% vs 52.7% for direct generation

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM-centric agentic methodology paper where every pipeline stage (grounding, segmentation, latent task induction, model reconciliation, skill generation) runs on GPT-5.4-family and Claude models (§3.4), evaluated on computer-use agents and coding-agent trajectories (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI; Appendix C). Novelty is solid: the task-model formalization pairing hierarchical objective decomposition with structured-programming control-flow operators, plus non-contiguous latent task discovery from interleaved traces, goes beyond prior workflow induction and plan recognition (§2, §6). Rigor is good: ARI/MAE robustness sweeps (Table 1, 126 synthetic trajectories), dual-judge identity checks across model families (Table 2), ablations of objective/procedure/reconciliation (Table 4), rubric-based human annotation with κ=0.48/AC1=0.79 (Appendix D.1), and error-propagation analysis (Appendix D.3). Evidence is decent but tempered: core fidelity metrics lean on LLM judges of LLM outputs (mitigated but not eliminated), the interleaving evaluation is synthetic segment shuffling, and the extrinsic gain is small in absolute terms (held-out accuracy 14.29→18.57, Table 5). Generalizability claims rest on 38 human sessions plus one benchmark; single-model-temperature implementation may limit transfer. Reproducibility is aided by a public codebase (§1 footnote), full prompt templates (Appendix F), and public datasets, though reliance on proprietary frontier models tempers exact replication.

primary_link.title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces

papers.summary: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks are actually performed, and organizations need to audit and reuse that knowledge. However, inducing such task models is challenging, as activity is observed only as low-level events and real-world wor
papers.summary_zh: 自然錄製的電腦使用軌跡（螢幕截圖與滑鼠、鍵盤事件）蘊含日常工作的隱性知識，但從低階事件還原結構化任務模型極具挑戰：訊號語義稀薄、真實工作多執行緒交錯，且軌跡僅記錄執行路徑而非目標層級與控制流。本文提出 Task Model Induction（TMI），分三階段運作：事件接地與活動分段將原始事件轉為語義動作與活動；潛在任務歸納利用任務摘要與參照識別符，將交錯活動分配至離散任務；任務模型建構則分別歸納目標模型（遞迴分解的目標層級）與流程模型（序列、for-each、while 控制流），再調和解併為統一模型。在合成與真實人類及代理軌跡上，TMI 以 0.974 的 ARI 還原交錯任務分組，任務身分匹配率逾 93%，步驟描述準確率達 74.9%，遠勝最強工作流基線的 30.3%；衍生技能使留出任務準確率相較最強基線提升 30%。局限包括依賴 LLM 推理與隱私遮蔽需求。此方法將日常數位工作轉為可稽核、可重用的知識，對人類文件化與代理技能學習皆具價值。
