links.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees

evidence: Abstract: 'BPS outperforms all the baselines, reaching 0.73 measured task success versus 0.20–0.52 for released skill routers, text retrievers, and the executor's own selection, on 28% fewer tokens than the strongest released router.'
§4.2, Theorem 1: BPS output satisfies bicriteria guarantee F-hat(S_BPS) >= (1-1/e)G-hat(T) - kappa-hat*ell(T) for all feasible T; tightness argued via Feige (1998) NP-hardness.

§5.1: contamination-controlled testbed forks BigCodeBench with 16 private modules over d=5 capability families, L=31 skill documents, '63,596 executions ... against real test suites'; task admission requires private-module solution to pass and one-capability hybrids to fail.
§5.3: 'BPS attains the exact optimum of (10) on all 80 instances'; singleton-scoring rules reach optimum on under a tenth of instances, set-scoring heuristics on 45%/44%.
§3.3, Proposition 1: selection regret bounded by 2*epsilon + delta under Assumption 1 (uniform fitting error); fitted supplies recover hidden coverage matrix with AUC 0.996 (Fig. 2).

§5.4: neural capability encoder (frozen text-embedding-v4, 64 dims) reaches 0.68 measured success on 716 tokens, '0.05 below the lookup-table instantiation' — indicating a generalization gap for deployment beyond the benchmark.
§6 Conclusion: acknowledges 'degradation models beyond a linear per-token charge' as future work; no code or data release statement anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core Agents & Tool Use / LLM paper: formalizes skill selection under a hard token budget as regularized submodular maximization and gives the first claimed bicriteria (1-1/e,1) guarantee (Theorem 1, §4.2), proved in full in Appendix A with a new budget-aligned interpolation step. Theory is genuinely new as a combination (regularized objective + heterogeneous knapsack + integral output + zero additive loss) but assembles known machinery (Sviridenko 2004, Kulik et al. 2021, ParetoGreedy prefix recording, distorted greedy), so novelty is good rather than exceptional. Rigor is strong: explicit assumptions, error-transfer proposition, ablations (linear-response model), value-model and deployed-selector baselines, exhaustive-search ground truth. Evidence is solid within a self-built, contamination-controlled fork of BigCodeBench (63,596 executions, §5.1), but single executor (Qwen3-32B), 31-skill library, and tasks gated to require injected skills limit external validity; the deployable neural-encoder variant drops to 0.68 from 0.73 (§5.4). No stated code/data release. Preference relevance to LLM agents, context budgeting, and tool/skill orchestration is very high.

primary_link.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees

papers.summary: Loading reusable skill documents into a bounded context window is now the primary way large language model (LLM) agents acquire task-specific capabilities, which makes skill selection a first-order determinant of task performance and token cost. Yet current agents score skills independently by semantic relevance and assemble the set by top-$k$ or greedy packing, with no quality guarantee or cost awareness on the selected set. As a result, redundant or poorly chosen skills waste scarce context to
papers.summary_zh: 技能文件已成為 LLM 代理取得任務能力的主要途徑，但既有技能選擇多以語義相關性逐一評分，再以 top-k 或貪婪裝箱組合，忽略能力互補、冗餘與上下文成本，可能浪費稀缺的 token 預算甚至損害表現。本文首度將技能選擇形式化為正規化次模最大化問題：在硬性 token 預算下，最大化單調次模的能力效益並扣除線性上下文懲罰。由於目標可能為負、無法進行常數倍近似，作者提出 Best Prefix Selection（BPS）——種子規模為二的部分枚舉密度貪婪演算法，記錄每條鏈的所有前綴並回傳最佳者，並以新穎的預算對齊插值論證證得雙準則 (1−1/e, 1) 近似保證，其效益係數在多項式時間內最優。在污染受控的 BigCodeBench 變體上，僅由執行成功與否的記錄擬合的結構化目標可準確預測未見技能組合，BPS 於全部 80 個選擇實例達到精確最佳值，量測任務成功率 0.73，勝過已發布的技能路由器、檢索器與執行者自選（0.20–0.52），且 token 用量較最強路由器少 28%。此工作為技能選擇提供首個理論保證與實證基準。
papers.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees
papers.title_zh: 具可證明雙準則保證的 LLM 代理最佳技能選擇

links.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy

evidence: Section 4.1: 121 LLMs evaluated via 5,000+ black-box examinations across 46 tests and 9 services, with 221,882 total samples and 215 categories enumerated in Appendix 0.A Table 5.

Section 4.3: Over Refusal negatively correlates with Jailbreak Robustness (r=-0.39, 95% CI [-0.54,-0.20]) and Safety Alignment (r=-0.22); Model & Data Privacy shows mean |r|=0.13 with six of eight pairwise correlations non-significant.
Section 4.4 and Table 7: R1-Llama3.1-8B adversarial robustness is 2.6 vs 56.9 for the Llama3.1-8B base, internally consistent with the claimed distillation-induced robustness collapse.

Section 4.4: mechanism corroboration uses only 50 AdvGLUE-SST2 prompts (mean cosine 0.094±0.161 for R1 vs 0.834±0.013 for IDA on Llama), a small-n diagnostic for the entropy-collapse hypothesis in Appendix 0.D.

Section 4.5 Table 2: GPT-4o to GPT-5 shows overall +3.84 with privacy -21.73, while Grok 3 to 4 improves both (+2.62/+1.04), properly qualifying the privacy-regression claim as non-universal (5 of 7 families).

Appendix 0.B: judge cross-validation between GPT-oss-120B and Gemma3-27B yields Pearson 0.985 (95% CI [0.983,0.987]) across service-level scores; but each test prompt is executed once at temperature=0, limiting sample-level variance estimation.

Appendix 0.C: ranking sensitivity validated with six stakeholder profiles (mean pairwise Kendall's τ=0.455) plus 10,000 Dirichlet-sampled weight vectors (coarse τ=0.775, within-tier ordering sensitive).
Section 4.6 Table 3: Jailbreak Robustness is the most fragmented service (avg category std 17.8, gap 47.0) versus OOD Robustness (4.4, 13.6) with non-overlapping CIs.
Section 6 Limitations: authors acknowledge English-only tests, black-box-only access, binary safe/unsafe judge framing, and edge-case adjudication difficulty.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely on high-weight preferences (LLM evaluation, AI safety, red teaming, alignment, code security). It unifies 46 mostly pre-existing tests across 9 services and evaluates 121 models, with the main novel contributions being cross-dimensional trade-off analysis (safety tax, privacy orthogonality) and a characterization of distillation-induced robustness collapse. Rigor is solid: standardized inference, multi-judge ensembles with cross-judge validation (Pearson 0.985), confidence intervals on correlations, stakeholder/Dirichlet ranking-robustness checks, and internally consistent tables (Table 1 matches Table 7). However, headline claims rest on observational correlations rather than interventions, each prompt is run once (temperature=0, Appendix 0.B), the representational diagnostic uses only 50 prompts, and generation comparisons carry uncontrolled confounds. Generalizability is bounded by English-only tests and black-box access (Section 6). Reproducibility is strong: public portal, released scripts/datasets, recorded proprietary model identifiers and evaluation dates. Well above the out-of-scope ceiling since this is genuine LLM methodology, but novelty of individual components is moderate because most tests are adapted benchmarks.

primary_link.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy

papers.summary: The critical failure modes in deployed large language models (LLMs) are cross-dimensional: a model can score 99.3 in safety alignment while refusing one in three benign queries, or improve across every capability metric while losing 21 points in privacy. Existing evaluation frameworks that assess safety, security, and privacy independently cannot detect these patterns. We introduce aiXamine, a unified black-box platform that evaluates LLM trustworthiness across safety, security, and privacy as i
papers.summary_zh: 部署後的 LLM 失效模式常為跨維度的，但既有評測框架將安全、資安與隱私各自獨立衡量，無法偵測其交互作用。本文提出 aiXamine，一個統一黑箱評測平台，整合 9 項服務、46 項測試與自動化紅隊管線，在相同條件下評測逾 120 個專有與開放權重模型，產出階層式風險輪廓並支援利害關係人加權。逾 5,000 次測試揭示單軸評測無法察覺的三大現象：其一，安全執法帶來可量測的安全稅——對齊越強則過度拒絕越嚴重（與越獄魯棒性相關係數 −0.39）；其二，隱私與其他可信度維度近乎正交（平均 |r|=0.13），不受標準對齊影響，且七個模型世代中有五個出現隱私退步，如 GPT-4o 至 GPT-5 整體提升 3.84 分但隱私下滑 21.73 分；其三，作者正式刻劃蒸餾誘發的魯棒性崩潰：缺乏 on-policy 修正的離線策略蒸餾造成熵崩潰，使同架構模型的對抗魯棒性由 56.9 跌至 2.6。安全行為亦呈類別依賴性，越獄魯棒性組內差距達 47 分。這些發現顯示可信度本質上是多維度的，推動未來走向模組化、維度感知的安全架構。
papers.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy
papers.title_zh: aiXamine：LLM 安全、資安與隱私跨維度權衡的統一黑箱評測

links.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows

evidence: Abstract: 'the strongest achieves 65.36% pass@1, but only 25.25% pass^20'; 'many failed trials show clean termination and valid state-changing actions, showing that response or tool-call-level signals are not clear proxies for end-to-end task completion.'
Section 3 (Task world and induced POMDP): task specified as x=(b0,g,T,U,C) with hidden executable checks; verdict V(x,rho)=prod c_i over final state, side effects, and dialogue (Eq. 4).
Section 5.1: 12 proprietary/open-weight models (GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Qwen3.5-9B, etc.), N=20 trials per task; Appendix C.2 reports 10,140 trials per model over M=507 tasks.
Table 4 (Section 5.2): GPT-5.4 average pass@1 65.36% with domain spread 76.33 (retail) to 54.60 (consulting); Claude Opus 4.6 drops to 14.65% on auto insurance.
Table 11 (Appendix D.1): GPT-5.4 pass@20 91.12% vs pass^20 25.25%, pass@1 95% task-cluster bootstrap CI [62.23%, 68.51%]; MiniMax-M2.5 and Qwen3-8B near 0%.

Table 12 (Appendix D.2): among 79,853 failed trials, 80.88% terminate cleanly with a state-changing tool call and 67.24% add no explicit terminal tool error, motivating executable state/side-effect checks (98.95% database hash mismatch).
Table 5 (Section 5.4): Tool Usage failures dominate at 77.5% average (89.6% for GPT-5.4); Wrong State Update largest for o3-pro (27.8%).

Appendix A (Limitations): 477 of 507 tasks judged only on terminal backend state/side effects; simulated user and judge are a fixed GPT-5.4-mini deployment and 'we cannot rule out interaction-style effects that favor same-family agents'; tasks admit a single golden terminal state.
Appendix B.1/B.3: tasks are synthetic reconstructions from a confidential private collection; 477 backend-only plus 30 backend+rubric cases (Table 6).

Appendix C.4: full simulated-user grounding contract reproduced verbatim with copy-only entity, missing-info, and role-guardrail clauses; Appendix C.1 gives agent/user/judge sampling parameters (Table 9) and vLLM settings (Table 10).
Availability claim (Abstract, Section 6): 'We release both Thinkingbox and Thinkingbox-Bench: https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A sandbox (Thinkingbox) and 507-task benchmark (Thinkingbox-bench) for LLM agents in stateful, policy-conditioned business workflows with MCP tools, terminal-state/side-effect checks, and repeated-trial reliability metrics. Preference relevance is very high: it directly targets the Agents & Tool Use and LLM evaluation clusters (tool calling, MCP, business workflows, leaderboard across frontier and open-weight LLMs). Novelty is moderate: the core ideas (on-policy user simulator, terminal database-state grading, pass@k vs pass^k reliability, collateral-effect detection) are inherited from tau-bench, tau2-bench, ToolSandbox, and AppWorld; the contribution is their consolidation into one reusable runtime plus two new enterprise domains (neobank internal IT, consulting IT/HR). Rigor is solid: 10,140 trials per model across 12-14 models, task-cluster bootstrap CIs, a deterministic failure-signature taxonomy (Table 5), a retrospective evaluator ablation on 79,853 failed trials (Table 12), and an unusually candid limitations section. Evidence strength is good because headline claims (65.36% pass@1 vs 25.25% pass^20 for GPT-5.4; 67-85% of failed trials look complete under weak proxies) are backed by concrete tables and verbatim trajectories, though all results are on the authors' own benchmark. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged constraints: tasks are synthetic reconstructions from a non-public source collection, a single golden terminal state excludes multi-resolution workflows, one fixed GPT-5.4-mini simulator/judge shared with the strongest agent's family, and 477/507 verdicts ignore the final response. Reproducibility is aided by a public GitHub release, verbatim simulator/agent prompts, and full inference parameters, but unverifiable provenance caps confidence.

primary_link.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows

papers.summary: Recent agent benchmarks increasingly ground evaluation in executable environments, from code repair to web navigation, app APIs, and function calling. Yet completing consequential work beyond code requires more than producing a plausible response or valid tool call: agents must gather missing information over multiple turns, follow domain policies, coordinate dependent tools, and realize the correct persistent state transition without collateral effects. In this paper, we introduce Thinkingbox,
papers.summary_zh: 現有代理評測多聚焦程式修復、工具呼叫正確性或網頁導航，難以檢驗有狀態、多輪且承擔後果的商務工作。本文提出 Thinkingbox，一個工具—代理—使用者互動的沙盒，提供隔離的 MCP 相容工具工作階段、完整執行軌跡與以終端後端狀態為準的結果評測；並在其上建構 Thinkingbox-bench，涵蓋零售、旅宿、汽車保險、新創銀行內部 IT 與顧問 IT/HR 支援共 507 個政策制約工作流。每項任務由任務特定可執行檢查評分，接受有效軌跡的同時拒絕錯誤、遺漏或額外的持久效應，其中 30 項另檢查最終回覆的必要屬性。評測 12 個專有與開放權重模型、每任務 20 次嘗試後，最強的 GPT-5.4 達 65.36% pass@1 與 91.12% pass@20，但僅 25.25% 的任務在全部 20 次皆成功，呈現巨大的探索—可靠度落差。軌跡分析顯示 77.5% 的失敗源自工具使用錯誤且未能修復；回顧性消融更指出 67.2% 的失敗在弱觀測評測下看似完成，證明回覆或工具呼叫層級訊號並非端對端完成的可靠代理。局限包括模擬使用者行為受限與部分任務僅檢查後端狀態。
papers.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows
papers.title_zh: 單次成功不等於可靠：Thinkingbox——面向有狀態商務工作流的代理沙盒與基準

links.title: Large reasoning models for abnormal situation management in safety-critical industrial processes

evidence: Table 1: Sonnet-5 high effort in-constraint 39/39 vs baseline 24/39 (15 safety-gap trips), paired difference +0.385, Newcombe CI [+0.22,+0.54], McNemar p=6e-5; four configurations span ~30x cost (US$0.07-2.32/episode) with diagnosis accuracy 0.744-0.846.

Results, 'The process-state summary determines which conditions...': reporting operating-target deviation reduces mean grade offset 4.8 to 0.3 mol% on all 9 quality-gap episodes (Table 2), isolating state-summary content as the limiting factor.

Results, verification ablation paragraph: no-shadow and no-validator configurations both maintain 39/39; audit shows the shadow veto never fired and static checks rejected 3 proposals, with the qualification noted that the bounded interface still constrains all actions.

Results, 'Diagnosis distinguishes the model from a rule table': model identifies ground-truth tag on 15/15 safety-gap episodes vs 2/15 for a scripted rule table given identical summary, interface and validator (Supplementary Note 5).

Methods, 'Models': four configurations (claude-sonnet-5 high/low effort, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash via OpenRouter), zero-shot, no task-specific training; 'Independent re-sampling was not performed'; three paired noise seeds, cached byte-identical replay.

Methods, 'Statistics': exact binomial McNemar, Newcombe paired-proportion CIs, cluster bootstrap (10,000 replicates) on continuous endpoints; all 156 model-supervised, 78 ablation, and 117 non-model episodes reported, none excluded.

Results, reasoning-effort case (Fig. 3): low vs high effort differ on one S4 episode (stiction misdiagnosis trip vs composition-imbalance stabilization), one discordant pair, McNemar p=1.0, explicitly reported as a single case without effect size.

Discussion, limitations: evaluation in simulation only, single process, nominal forward simulator cannot predict disturbance-induced trips (Fig. 5 failure), no human-operator comparison, no formal safety guarantee; safety-gap class solvable by rule table, so reasoning contribution is confined to diagnosis.

Data and code availability: harness, benchmark definition, prompts (Parts A/B), validator bounds and analysis at github.com/khalidlabs/safetep-core; TEP kernel at github.com/khalidlabs/tep-studio; scenarios and prompts frozen by content hash.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM/LRM agent paper with language methodology at its core, not a pure domain application: zero-shot prompting of large reasoning models (Claude Sonnet-5 high/low effort, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) as a closed-loop decision layer with a bounded tool/action interface, a what-if simulator tool, propose-validate-execute verification, and inference-time compute (reasoning effort) as the key variable. This maps strongly onto the LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Agents & Tool Use, and Prompting preferences. Rigor is high: paired (scenario, seed) design with n=39 per configuration, exact McNemar and Newcombe paired-proportion CIs, cluster bootstrap, pre-calibrated and hash-frozen scenarios, a verification ablation (no-shadow and no-validator both 39/39) quantifying model-vs-check contribution, a scripted rule-table comparator isolating diagnosis (15/15 vs 2/15), and honest failure taxonomy. Evidence is solid but bounded: all simulation on a single process (Tennessee Eastman), diagnosis scored best-of-n, single sample per episode with 'independent re-sampling not performed', saturating primary endpoint that cannot separate configurations, and the headline reasoning-effort effect rests on one discordant pair (McNemar p=1.0), which the authors correctly decline to size. Novelty is moderate: components (LLM agent, validator, simulator tool) are known; the contribution is the integration, quantified delegation of authority, and a reusable benchmark. Generalizability is limited by single-process evaluation and acknowledged untested sim-to-real gap. Reproducibility is supported by cached byte-replayable transcripts, hash-frozen prompts/benchmark, released harness repos, and listed API parameters, but supplementary material and repo contents are unverifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: Large reasoning models for abnormal situation management in safety-critical industrial processes

papers.summary: Automation operates safety-critical processes inside their design envelope and leaves abnormal situations to human operators. Mismanagement of these situations is a leading contributor to process-safety incidents and a hindrance to achieving autonomy. Here we show that a general-purpose large reasoning model, with no task-specific training and only the information available to an operator, manages abnormal situations at run time through a bounded, programmatically verified action interface. Acro
papers.summary_zh: 異常狀況管理（ASM）長期仰賴控制室操作員，誤處置是製程安全事故的主因之一，也是邁向自主工廠的關鍵障礙。本文探問大型推理模型（LRM）能否在執行期對整廠製程執行 ASM。作者在 Tennessee Eastman 製程上，將 Claude Sonnet-5 等推理模型置於基礎調節控制層之上，限制於有界且經程式化驗證的動作介面：模型僅能調整經驗證範圍內的設定點、啟用預工程保護元件、執行預審程序、不採取行動或下令有序停機，每項提案皆經靜態檢查與標稱模型影子模擬審查。模型僅接收操作員可得之資訊，零樣本提示且無任務特定訓練。在 39 個異常與操作點變更情境中，高推理力配置於全部 39 集保持所有硬約束，而基準調節控制有 15 集跳機；在全部 15 個安全差距情境正確診斷根因；跨 30 倍成本的三款模型結論一致，消融亦顯示成果並非仰賴驗證層。局限在於僅於模擬環境評測，且標稱模擬器無法涵蓋真實擾動。此工作量化了語言模型於安全關鍵控制中可安全委授的權限條件。
papers.title: Large reasoning models for abnormal situation management in safety-critical industrial processes
papers.title_zh: 大型推理模型應用於安全關鍵工業製程的異常狀況管理

links.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps; consistent with Table 2 ALFWorld OOD +9.0 and Table 3 SWE-verified steps 55.01 to 49.61 (9.8% vs Original Envs).

Section 4.1: EnvRigger and policy share the same model backbone per benchmark (Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite for ALFWorld/WebArena, Gemini-3.5-Flash elsewhere) to rule out distillation from a stronger model; baselines share seed instances, environment count, extraction pipeline, and policy model.

Table 2: ALFWorld OOD 70.4 vs 61.4 (Original Envs), WebArena avg 41.6 vs 38.5, reported as means over three independent runs with standard deviations; WebArena GitLab gain (+2.3) is within reported std devs.
Section 5 / Table 4: GRPO on Qwen3-8B-base; ALFWorld In-Dist 87.9 vs 81.4 but OOD 88.8 vs 89.6, with the slight regression explicitly disclosed; WebShop 79.2 vs 75.6 score.

Table 9 (Appendix F.4): cross-model gains over Original Envs of 2.7-3.7 absolute points across Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Qwen3.6 27B, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, spanning open-weight and proprietary backbones.

Appendix H (Limitations): admits design-loop compute cost, the resettable reset/step interface requirement excluding live services and robots, and sequential-only Chain composition without semantic composition.

Appendix A and Table 8: full EnvRigger designer system prompt and hyperparameters (K=5 rollouts, revision budget 5) are provided; Appendix C details the ActionableEnv bridge/decorator protocol; code release claimed at github.com/google-research/envharness.

Appendix G Table 11: token accounting shows EnvHarness matches the real-execution baseline VeriEnv (137.3M vs 137.8M total tokens) while GenEnv is 3.5x cheaper but uses LLM-simulated rollouts, contextualizing the cost of grounding.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper (agent environment customization, RL with GRPO, SWE/web/office agents) that squarely matches the highest-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Code 2.0, RL 1.5); it is in-scope language-methodology work, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: interface-level wrapping (Stage/Contract/Chain) that preserves human-built verifiers is a clean reframing against domain-specific environment generation (GenEnv, VeriEnv, SWE-smith), though curriculum/UED and env-generation prior work makes the conceptual distance incremental. Rigor is solid: five benchmarks in four domains, three-run means with standard deviations (Table 2), shared seed/model/budget controls (Section 4.1, Appendix E.2), ablations (Table 5), scaling curves (Figure 5), four-model cross-backbone study (Table 9), token-cost analysis (Table 11), and an explicit limitations appendix. Deductions: several gains are small relative to variance (OfficeQA EM +1.80 with overlapping std devs; ALFWorld RL OOD regresses 88.8 vs 89.6), no statistical significance testing, single evaluation attempt per instance, and headline results depend on proprietary Gemini/Claude models, which limits exact reproduction despite released code, full designer prompt (Appendix A), hyperparameters (Table 8), and RL training details (Appendix F.1).

primary_link.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning

papers.summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理透過與環境互動學習，但既有環境多為人工建置且靜態：無法針對代理弱點提供訊號，代理進步後亦失去教學價值；自動環境生成則受限於特定領域管線與昂貴或不可靠的驗證器。本文提出 EnvHarness，一層可程式化的外掛元件，在不改動底層環境邏輯的前提下，透過標準 reset/step 介面重塑靜態環境：Stage 修改初始狀態、Contract 重寫動作、轉移與觀察空間、Chain 串接多個環境以延長任務時程，且每個重塑環境皆保留原有人工建置的驗證器。為自動化客製化，作者提出 EnvRigger，將目標策略視為黑箱，觀測成功與失敗軌跡以診斷缺陷，合成候選元件並以全新 rollout 迭代驗證與修訂。橫跨四領域五基準（ALFWorld、WebArena、SWE-bench Verified、OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench），以 EnvHarness 環境萃取的技能在留出任務最高提升 9.0 分、執行步驟減少 9.8%，勝過特定領域生成管線；在強化學習設定下亦提升政策效能至多 6.5 分，且效能隨環境規模持續成長，促成策略與環境共演化。
papers.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
papers.title_zh: EnvHarness：喚醒靜態環境以促進代理學習

links.title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling

evidence: Abstract: TempJail is a black-box video jailbreak optimizing subtitle temporal scheduling; outperforms strongest baseline by 53 and 18 percentage points dataset-averaged ASR on GPT-5 and Gemini 3.5-Flash (consistent with Table II averages).
Section V-A, Evaluation metric: GPT-5 used as automated judge; a sample counts as attacked if at least one of five responses succeeds — judge reliability and best-of-5 inflation are not validated.

Section V-B / Table II: TempJail reaches 89.0% avg ASR on VLJailbreakBench and 90.0% on HADES; TJ-W (78) exceeds full TempJail (70) on GPT-5/VLJailbreakBench, acknowledged as model-dependent scene-generation effect.

Section V-C / Table III: ablation isolates background, subtitle content, and timing; dialogue subtitles under uniform timing raise average ASR from 33.0% to 74.5%, CMA-ES timing to 92.5% (white) and 97.5% (video).
Section III vs Section V-A inconsistency: motivation experiments render/sample at 10 FPS, while implementation details specify 24 FPS rendering and 4 FPS uniform sampling.
Section V-A: CMA-ES runs at most three generations with population 10; datasets are 50 randomly sampled examples each with no seed or variance reporting.
Section V-A, Implementation details: substitute model Qwen3-VL-Flash, planner Qwen3.6-Flash, Runway Gen-4.5 for background video; no code or artifact availability statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-security work: a black-box temporal jailbreak against LVLMs, squarely matching AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Multimodal AI, and LLM preferences; it is not pure video diffusion since the contribution is language/safety methodology (subtitle semantics + timing optimization). The temporal-scheduling angle is genuinely new relative to VideoJail/MCV/SPTV, but the pipeline is assembled from known pieces (multi-turn dialogue decomposition from text jailbreaks, CMA-ES black-box search). Empirical coverage is broad (4 LVLMs, 2 datasets, 4 baselines, ablations, FPS/iteration/temperature sensitivity). However, evaluation has weaknesses: GPT-5 is simultaneously target model and automated judge with no human validation, a best-of-5 sample-level success rule inflates ASR, only 50 samples per dataset, no significance testing, no defense evaluation, and internal inconsistencies (Section III states 10 FPS rendering/sampling while Section V-A reports 24 FPS rendering and 4 FPS sampling). Ablations only cover Qwen models, not GPT-5, despite a GPT-5 claim in the contributions. No code release statement and reliance on proprietary, versioned APIs (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Qwen3.6-Flash, Runway Gen-4.5) hurt reproducibility. Query-based optimization (30+ target queries per sample) also limits practical threat realism.

primary_link.title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling

papers.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding and reasoning. Despite extensive studies on text- and image-based jailbreaks, video jailbreaks against LVLMs remain largely unexplored. Existing video jailbreak methods mainly manipulate textual content embedded in videos, while overlooking how such information is organized over time. Our analysis reveals that jailbreak effectiveness depends not only on the semantics of textual information but also on i
papers.summary_zh: 針對大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）的越獄研究多聚焦文字與靜態圖像，影片攻擊則以內容組成為主，忽略資訊在時間軸上的組織方式。本文的受控實驗顯示，基於字幕的影片越獄成效不僅取決於語義內容，也取決於顯示時長與時段配置。據此作者提出 TempJail，一個黑箱影片越獄框架：先將有害查詢改寫為語義相連的多輪對話並與原查詢串接為對話式字幕序列，再以文字生成影片模型產生語義一致的背景影片，最後以協變矩陣自適應演化策略（CMA-ES）最佳化各字幕段落的顯示時長，控制有害語義的時序暴露。在 HADES 與 VLJailbreakBench 兩資料集、四款 LVLM 上，TempJail 於所有模型—資料集組合取得最高攻擊成功率，平均達 89–90%，在 GPT-5 上較最強基線高出 53 個百分點；消融顯示僅時序排程即可將 GPT-5 平均 ASR 由 11% 提升至 71%，字幕對話建構亦屬關鍵。此工作揭示影片輸入的時序脆弱性，凸顯多模態安全防護須明確考量文字與視覺資訊的時間動態。
papers.title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling
papers.title_zh: TempJail：透過字幕排程對大型視覺語言模型發動的時序越獄攻擊

links.title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification

evidence: Section 4, Tables 1–3: TUP compared against DPO, REBEL, QRPO, BoNBoN on Llama-8B Tülu 3 SFT (UltraFeedback, Magpie Air) and Mistral-7B SFT, evaluated by ArmoRM, Skywork-v2-Llama, Skywork-v2-Qwen, and a gpt-4o judge.

Section 3.2 and Appendix A.2: Theorem 3.2/A.3 (hard truncation matches best monotone reweighting) and Proposition 3.3/A.5 (finite β improves over pure truncation under positive covariance), with proofs in A.2.1–A.2.2; authors concede the results are 'idealized theoretical support' (Sec. 3.2).
Section 5 (Discussion): limitation that both λ and β must be tuned on validation, unlike baselines tuning only β, increasing compute cost.

Section 4 and Appendix B.2 Table 7: length-matched pairwise win rates for TUP average 57.6% (ArmoRM), 56.5% (Skywork-Llama), 52.7% (Skywork-Qwen), but matching retains only a fraction of pairs (e.g., 276 of 2415 vs DPO) and is 'complementary evidence'.
Table 2 (UltraFeedback GPT Judge LC Win): QRPO (random) 42.44±0.15 and REBEL (random) 42.44±0.15 slightly exceed TUP aggressive 42.36±0.14, showing TUP is not uniformly best under the LLM judge.

Appendix C.3–C.9: implementation changes only 'the scalar training label, the known intercept, and the loss', 4 H200 GPUs, mpmath-based normalizer evaluation, hyperparameter tables 9–11, and code release claimed at github.com/yarinbar/truncate-bad-upweight-good (Sec. 1, Contributions).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM post-training/alignment methodology paper (BoN-style distillation with reward models, DPO/QRPO/REBEL baselines, Llama-8B/Mistral-7B experiments), scoring high on the heavily weighted LLM and Alignment/RLHF preferences; it is not an out-of-scope domain application. Novelty is moderate: the core change relative to QRPO/BoNBoN is decoupling lower-tail truncation (hard support removal) from upper-tail sharpness via a shifted-truncated win-rate with an incomplete-Beta closed-form normalizer; the motivating observation (reward models agree more on the pool bottom than top, Sec. 3.1/Fig. 2) is interesting but the contribution is an incremental refinement of existing rank-based policies. Rigor is solid: Proposition 3.1 and Theorem A.3/Proposition A.5 are proved (App. A.2), assumptions (continuity, uniform win-rates) are stated, and the authors honestly note the theory is prompt-specific and 'does not directly explain how a training model can benefit' (Sec. 3.2), plus the extra λ/β tuning cost (Sec. 5). Evidence is decent but mixed at the margins: TUP is clearly best under held-out Skywork evaluators in-dataset (Table 1, e.g., 21.24 vs DPO 16.33 Skywork-Llama on Magpie Air) yet on AlpacaEval GPT-judge LC win QRPO(random) reaches 42.44 vs TUP 42.36/40.27 (Table 2), and improvements over REBEL(random) are often small; length-matched analysis (App. B.2, Table 7, averages 57.6%/56.5%/52.7%) partly addresses verbosity but uses small, per-baseline subsets. No significance testing; TUP/BoNBoN receive dedicated hyperparameter searches while baselines reuse prior best configs (App. C.1/C.4), a mild tuning asymmetry. Generalizability is bounded: two model families, two instruction-following datasets, chat-style evaluation only, no reasoning/code tasks, though the plug-in nature (only labels/intercept/loss change, App. C.3) suggests transfer within offline alignment. Reproducibility is strong: full hyperparameter grids (Tables 9–11), training settings (App. C.5), 4xH200 compute disclosure (C.8), public QRPO code/data reuse, mpmath normalizer details (C.3), license table (C.9), and a claimed full code release (Sec. 1, Contributions item 3).

primary_link.title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification

papers.summary: Inference-time selection methods, such as Best-of-N, improve generation by sampling a pool of candidates and selecting the top-ranked completion according to a reward model. Distillation seeks to amortize this procedure into a single policy by replacing raw rewards with in-pool ranks and learning a policy that upweights higher-ranked completions. However, existing rank-based policies typically use smooth full-support reweighting, so low-ranked completions receive less mass but remain in the targ
papers.summary_zh: 推論時選擇方法(如 Best-of-N)能提升語言模型生成品質,但每次推論都需要多次取樣與獎勵評估。BoN 式蒸餾旨在把這套程序內化到單一策略,但現有排名式策略多採平滑的全支撐集重加權,低排名回覆仍留在目標分布中;若過度銳化,又會過度信賴單一獎勵模型對頂部排名的脆弱判斷,增加 reward hacking 風險。本文提出 TUP(Truncate-bad, Upweight-good Policy),以勝率門檻 λ 把低排名回覆直接移出支撐集,再以銳度參數 β 對保留的上尾做軟性重加權。TUP 具有封閉式、與提示無關的正規化常數(以不完全 Beta 函數表示),並以二元交叉熵搭配位移截斷勝率軟標籤,可完全離線訓練。理論上,在特定假設下,最佳單調排名重加權可由下尾截斷規則匹配;固定門檻後,當保留區間內代理勝率與神諭勝率正相關時,有限 β 能再進一步改善。實驗在 QRPO 基準上訓練 Llama-8B Tülu 3 SFT 與 Mistral-7B,與 DPO、REBEL、QRPO、BoNBoN 等離線對齊基線比較,以三個獎勵模型與 GPT 評審在留出資料及 AlpacaEval 上評估:TUP 在兩個 Skywork 評估模型下多半取得最佳成績,顯示良好的跨獎勵模型泛化。限制在於 λ 與 β 皆需依驗證集調校而增加成本,且方法仍可能受 reward hacking 影響。其價值在於把「截除壞樣本」與「加權好樣本」兩個決策明確分離,並提供理論與實證支持。
papers.title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification
papers.title_zh: 截壞揚好:透過排名式分類實現 BoN 風格蒸餾

links.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection

evidence: Abstract: claims Task-CoEvolve outperforms subset baselines, matches full-set search, reduces evaluations by 80%, and promises code release at a GitHub URL
Section 4.2/Table 1: held-out test accuracy 49.3±0.8 (ρ=20%) vs 48.6±0.8 for Meta-Harness full search; 47.6±0.9 at ρ=7%, n=3 runs per cell
Section 4.4/Table 2: Terminal-Bench 2.1 pass rates 61.8 (GPT-5.6 Luna) and 41.6 (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) at ρ=20% vs full search 62.9/42.7
Section 4.5/Table 3: input tokens 2,888M→579M (−80%) and time 22.2h→11.5h for GPT-5.6 Luna; −67% tokens and 38.0h→20.5h for Qwen3.6
Section 5.1/Table 4: component ablation 47.2 (Naive)→48.2 (+resampling)→48.8 (+estimation)→49.3 (+variance-weighted selection) at ρ=20%
Section 5.3/Table 6: Spearman correlation of estimated vs true score is 0.13 at ρ=7% and 0.62 at ρ=20%; Ŝ-max winner ranks 10/60 and 12/60 by true score
Section 3.3/Eqs. 2-4: variance-weighted sampling weight, Hájek estimator, and anchored difference estimator with Monte Carlo inclusion probabilities
Appendix A/Table A: swapping estimators degrades text-classification accuracy by 3.3-3.6 points, supporting the benchmark-dependent estimator rule
Appendix C/Table E: negative control—DeepSeek-V4-Flash full search yields 70.8→70.8 (no gain), attributed to lack of harness-optimization headroom
Section 6: acknowledged limitation—fixed per-candidate task count; cannot early-stop clearly worse candidates or extend ambiguous comparisons
Appendix E.2/Table D: hyperparameters listed (ℓ=0.125, λ=0.025, 4,000 Monte Carlo repetitions, sampling rates 7%/20%)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to top-weighted preferences: LLM harness/agent optimization (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs) plus evaluation-efficiency methodology, clearly in scope. The problem framing—co-evolving the validation task set with an evolving harness using variance-weighted sampling and design-based (Hájek/anchored-difference) estimators—is a fresh combination; individual pieces (Bernoulli-variance weighting, importance weighting) are simple and adjacent to active testing/tinyBenchmarks, but the application to evolving-candidate selection is novel. Rigor is above average: formal problem statement, component ablations (Table 4), estimator-swap and tie-break sensitivity analyses (Appendices A/B), cost accounting (Table 3), and ground-truth verification of estimated scores (Table 6), with honest negative results (Appendix C) and stated limitations. Evidence is solid but effect sizes are small (~1 pt vs full search) with only n=3 runs, no significance tests, and the ρ=7% ranking signal is weak (Spearman 0.13), so 'surpasses full-set search' at 20% is within noise. Generalizability is moderate: two benchmarks, three models, but the estimator-choice rule is a heuristic tied to pool statistics, outcomes are assumed binary, and only two budget levels are tested. Reproducibility is decent: detailed hyperparameters (Table D), protocols, and a promised code release, though dependent on proprietary frontier models and code availability is unverified.

primary_link.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection

papers.summary: We present a novel approach to efficient LLM harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights. Existing approaches, however, evaluate a fixed validation set in full at every iteration, incurring substantial evaluation costs even on tasks that become less discriminative as the harness evolves. We propose $\
papers.summary_zh: 自動化 harness(環繞模型的外圍控制程式)最佳化,通常每次迭代都以完整固定的驗證集評估所有候選者,既昂貴又僵化:所有候選都能解或都解不了的任務,持續消耗評估預算卻幾乎不提供訊號。本文提出 Task-CoEvolve,讓驗證任務與 harness 共同演化,核心有二:(1) 變異數加權任務選擇,以各任務歷史成功率的 Bernoulli 變異數衡量鑑別力,把預算集中在能力邊界附近、候選者結果分歧的任務上,並對觀察次數少的任務給予探索加成;(2) 取樣感知的完整集分數估計,依任務納入機率選用 Hájek 估計量或以歷史成功率為錨點的差異估計量,使不同迭代、不同子集的評分能在同一尺度公平比較。實驗在線上文字分類(LawBench、Symptom2Disease、USPTO-50k)與 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上進行:7% 評估預算即接近完整搜尋,20% 時甚至超越(平均 49.3%);Terminal-Bench 2.1 上僅用 20% 評估便與完整搜尋相差約一個任務,搜尋成本降低 67–80%、時間約減半。消融顯示隨機重抽樣、估計量與加權選擇各有貢獻。限制是每個候選者被評估的任務數固定,無法提前中止或加碼,且模型愈強、可最佳化空間愈小。此工作指出「用哪些任務來評估」本身就是值得最佳化的對象。
papers.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
papers.title_zh: Task-CoEvolve:透過自適應驗證任務選擇達成高效的 Harness 最佳化

links.title: Testing and Evaluation of Agentic AI Systems In Military Command and Control

evidence: Abstract: 'structured review of 240 documented Testing and Evaluation (T&E) practices, spanning eight evaluation dimensions and three lifecycle stages' establishes corpus scale and the paper's evidentiary basis.

§3 Methodology: two review strands plus 'a dozen expert interviews, each lasting 30 to 60 minutes' with participants 'selected... based on the authors' personal relationships' - disclosed convenience sampling.

§3 Limitations: 'the strain that agentic properties place on established methods is primarily inferred from the properties and methods... no empirical testing has been conducted' - caps evidence strength.
Footnote 2 (Key contributions): 'The dataset is available from the corresponding author on reasonable request' - 240-practice dataset not publicly released, limiting reproducibility.

§5.1.2: cites that 'none performed well across all task types' for agent trajectory judges (Lù et al.) and that trace alteration can raise false-positive rates 'by up to 90%' (Khalifa et al.) - cited quantitative support for the judge-validation claim, not the authors' own experiments.
§5.3.1: composed-system red-teaming is described as 'immature, coverage is scenario-bounded, and no unified protocol is publicly reported' - honest assessment of method maturity.

§6 Conclusion: reiterates that 'many of the candidate approaches discussed in §5 remain at the preprint stage and have not been validated under command-and-control conditions', bounding generalizability claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Position/framework paper on testing and evaluation of LLM-based agentic AI in military C2. Direct hit on Agents & Tool Use (agent properties, orchestration, delegation, runtime constraints) and Red Teaming & Evaluation (T&E dimensions, LLM-as-judge limits, composed-system red-teaming), with substantial AI-safety (prompt injection, unsafe trajectories, governance) and memory/state content. The contribution is a structured qualitative gap analysis - eight assumptions elicited from 240 documented practices, ten assurance claims, method-to-claim mapping - rather than a new method or empirical result; constituent ideas (trajectory oracles, drift monitoring, runtime enforcement) are drawn from cited prior work, so novelty is aggregation-level. Rigor is reasonable for a qualitative study (clear 4-step method, explicit scope exclusions, candid limitations) but findings are explicitly inferred, not empirically demonstrated, and interview sampling was convenience-based via authors' relationships. Evidence strength is capped by absence of primary data; quantitative support comes only from cited studies. Dataset is on-request only and analysis is qualitative, limiting reproducibility. Framework is intended to generalize to high-stakes agentic domains beyond C2, though transferability is acknowledged as conditional.

primary_link.title: Testing and Evaluation of Agentic AI Systems In Military Command and Control

papers.summary: Agentic AI systems are being procured for military command and control (C2) under public commitments to rigorous testing and human oversight. Whether such commitments can be discharged depends on their supporting assurance case, which requires three elements: claims specifying the conditions for acceptability, evidence bearing on those claims, and an argument connecting the two. Through a structured review of 240 documented Testing and Evaluation (T&E) practices, spanning eight evaluation dimens
papers.summary_zh: 代理式 AI 系統正被採購用於軍事指揮與管制(C2),並伴隨嚴謹測試與人類監督的公開承諾;承諾能否兌現,取決於由主張、證據與論證組成的保證案例。本文對 240 項文件化的測試與評估(T&E)實務做結構化審查,涵蓋八個評估維度與三個生命週期階段,歸納出既有方法對受測系統的八項假設,分屬四個群組:可規格化、穩定性、可組合性與可監督性。作者對應持久記憶、目標彈性、擴張整合面、開放式行動空間等七項代理特性,指出這些特性同時削弱全部八項假設,侵蝕的正是連結證據與主張的論證環節,使測試結果雖符合程序要求,卻不足以支撐從受測行為推論到部署行為。論文為前三群組提出十項保證主張,並評估現行與新興方法,搭配五個 C2 情境說明操作後果。結論:廣泛的系統層級主張不受支援,但較窄的主張仍可復原,包括有界任務包絡、以軌跡為基礎的正確性、可執行的執行期約束,以及經刻畫的跨執行變異;部分舉證責任移入部署階段,部署決定因此成為持續性行為,需以到期條件與責任歸屬治理剩餘不確定性。限制在於僅依公開文件(以美、英、北約為主)、分析以推論為主而非實證,且可監督性僅部分處理。

evidence: Abstract/§1: defines state tracking vs recall, introduces StateMemBench (234 multi-session scenarios, closed-pool grading) and StateMem with claimed 1.8x (0.205→0.363) improvement on DeepSeek-V4-Flash
Table 3/§6.2: StateMem 0.363 beats Dense 0.205 and long-context 0.149 on DeepSeek substrate, McNemar p<0.001; GraphRAG statistically level on Qwen (p=0.82)
§6.4/Table 6: StateMemWrapper lifts six backends +31.7 to +66.6 points on StateMemBench, with length/cost-matched control attributing +15.0 to +31.7 to state structure
Appendix A/Table 7: cross-family judge agreement κ=0.37; human annotators assign less drift than the judge, so drift rates are labeled upper bounds

Appendix H (Limitations): synthetic data, traps from the same lazy-reader policy family as StateMem (margins read as upper bound), contexts of ~3k-15k tokens, single runs, judge shares family with one substrate
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent memory paper: squarely matches LLM (DeepSeek/Qwen/GPT substrates), agents, RAG (BM25/dense/graph-RAG baselines), and long-context/memory preferences; no Japanese content. Novelty is solid but bounded: state tracking is explicitly positioned against concurrent STALE and LongMemEval-v2 dynamic state tracking, and the differentiation (deterministic LLM-free dependency propagation, drift-as-scored-outcome closed-pool grading, matched-control wrapper) is incremental engineering on a recognized problem. Rigor is above average: ordered failure taxonomy with adversarial filter, cross-family judge confirmation, human anchoring, McNemar tests, and a length/cost-matched control isolating structure from context volume; honesty about LightMem/MemoryOS integration failures and self-acknowledged circularity (traps generated from the same lazy-reader policy family StateMem targets, Appendix H) raise credibility. Evidence is limited by single runs, judge family overlap with the DeepSeek substrate, low absolute gold rates (0.15-0.36), and synthetic 3k-15k token contexts well below modern context windows; the paper itself reads benchmark margins as an upper bound. Generalizability is moderate (two substrates, three domains, two external recall benchmarks, six wrapper backends, but frontier models untested and scenarios synthetic). Reproducibility is decent: full prompts, package/clone details, frozen manifests, cost accounting, and a stated benchmark/annotation-kit release, though StateMem code release is not explicitly evidenced.

primary_link.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?

papers.summary: As LLM-based agents are deployed for longer and higher-stakes tasks, their memory systems continue to have crucial gaps. While existing memory benchmarks focus largely on recall-shaped tasks, we argue an effective memory system must track the evolving state of the world; as facts, constraints, and decisions are revised over a long interaction, answers must reflect the current state and not a superseded one. We define this capability as state tracking and instantiate it in StateMemBench, a benchm
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理的長期記憶系統多半聚焦於事實回想,本文主張一個被忽略的關鍵能力是狀態追蹤:當事實、約束與決定在長互動中不斷被修訂,答案必須反映當前有效的狀態,而非已被取代的舊值。作者把「相關事實明明在上下文中、代理卻依過期版本行動」的失敗稱為狀態漂移,並指出即使在完美檢索(LongMemEval oracle)下,44.4% 的確認失敗仍屬此類。為隔離此現象,作者建立 StateMemBench:234 個多會話情境、兩種長度設定,由符號事件程式產生,涵蓋五種失敗模式,並以封閉選項池把漂移與其他錯誤分開計分。接著提出 StateMem,以狀態單元結構表示記憶:擷取階段把每輪對話解析為帶依賴連結的單元,更新階段執行取代標記與確定性的依賴重查,答題時組裝有效狀態供模型重新計算。在 StateMemBench 上,StateMem 於 DeepSeek 較最強同底座基線提升 1.8 倍(0.205→0.363),於 Qwen 較最強記憶系統提升 1.6 倍(0.149→0.233),並在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo 等回想型基準上與長上下文基線相當。輕量答題時包裝器可為六種記憶與檢索後端帶來 +32 至 +67 點,對照組顯示其中 +15 至 +32 點來自狀態結構本身。限制包括合成資料、情境長度遠短於真實上下文、單次執行與評審偏誤。此工作確立狀態追蹤是可與回想分離的記憶能力軸線。
papers.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
