Section 1 (contributions): 'Top-rate admission and LPT are established techniques; we do not claim a new scheduling primitive. The contribution lies in the routing design, its large-scale measurements, and the conditions under which operators should leave the ordinary load balancer in place.'
Section 4 (Policies): Preble/DualMap/CHWBL 'are reimplemented in our harness under a common interface; our absolute results should not be read as reproductions of their original systems.'

Section 2.1: workload is semi-synthetic from de-identified operational telemetry; 'No raw requests, conversation content, user data, or business identifiers are used'; per-business reusable segment is ~180 tokens (~15%).
Table 5 / Appendix G: negative regimes — Aggregate A-32B capacity falls to 0.50x (3.5s) and 0.67x (5s) of Flat-LB; Aggregate B-32B ties; motivates the shadow-replay deployment gate.
Appendix B Table 7: study matrix with seeds 2-6 (n=5) for the flagship, n=8 wide-active-set confirmation, and evidence-class labels (HW/core, HW/mechanism, sim/supporting).
Table 4 (8B ablation): affinity raises KV hit 56%→88% but imbalance to 3.46x with capacity unchanged; only LPT placement (1.24x imbalance) moves the knee 240→500 QPS (right-censored).
Appendix H: analytic residency model 'misses served hit rate by 14.3 percentage points at the median and 44.7 points at p90', supporting measurement-over-prediction deployment.
Section 1/Appendix: no explicit public code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document; only indirect reference to 'its artifacts' in Appendix A.2.

Section 6 (Limitations): 'Equal-slot admission assumes roughly uniform stable-prefix sizes' and 'Cold-tail traffic shares the native cache and can evict admitted prefixes'; 'two distributions cannot represent every market or application.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM serving/efficiency work (LLM, KV cache, vLLM/SGLang context, inference optimization), squarely on-topic with high preference weight but not touching Japanese NLP or agentic language methodology. Novelty is modest and self-acknowledged: the planner combines established top-rate admission and LPT list scheduling into a periodic prefix-affinity routing table, positioned against Preble/DualMap/CHWBL-style reactive policies (Section 1, Section 7). Rigor is unusually strong: paired seeds with Student-t CIs, explicit right/left-censoring of SLO knees, a six-policy comparison, an 8B component ablation separating affinity from placement (Table 4), burst/drift sensitivity studies, a documented non-reproduced anomaly (Appendix C.2), and a negative analytic-residency result (Appendix H). Evidence strength is high but tempered: the flagship 176±11 vs 76±11 QPS result (Table 1) is real 70B fp8 hardware on 60 H100s, yet workloads are semi-synthetic aggregates from de-identified telemetry rather than exact request replay, and three baselines are common-harness reimplementations rather than original systems (Section 4). Generalizability is honestly bounded: equal-slot admission assumes uniform prefix sizes, cold-tail traffic can evict admitted prefixes, and two 32B regimes show affinity losing (0.50-0.67x) or tying Flat-LB (Table 5, Appendix G), motivating a shadow-replay deployment gate. Reproducibility is aided by the full algorithm, seed lists, load ladders, and provenance matrix (Appendix B), but no explicit public code or artifact release is stated. Overall a strong, well-bounded systems contribution whose headline multiplier is properly conditioned on workload regime.

primary_link.title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving

papers.summary: Prefix caching avoids prefill only when a repeated request returns to a server that still holds the prefix KV. Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server. CacheRoute resolves this tradeoff with a periodic routing plan. It admits high-rate keys to a stable warm set and places their assignments by expected load. Hot keys may use more than one destination, although every key in our primary semi-synthetic aggregate uses exactly one. On Llama-3.3
papers.summary_zh: 前綴快取只有在重複請求回到仍保留該前綴 KV 的伺服器時才能省去 prefill：無快取感知的負載平衡會把重複前綴打散到各處，固定親和性雖保留局部性卻可能讓單一伺服器過載。CacheRoute 以週期性路由表同時規劃快取局部性與預期負載：依各金鑰的請求率做 top-rate 准入納入暖前綴集合，以 k_b=max(1, ⌈λ_b/q_cap⌉) 決定目的地數量，再用 LPT（最長處理時間優先）清單排程平衡放置，未准入的冷尾流量退回 power-of-two choices，表格在一個控制區間內保持穩定。在 Llama-3.3-70B fp8、60 張 H100 的測試中，CacheRoute 於 3.5 秒 p99 SLO 下維持 176±11 QPS，是最強基線 Preble 的 2.3 倍，伺服端 KV 命中率從 64.1% 升至 93.2%，100 QPS 時 p99 僅 1.8 秒。8B 消融實驗分離機制：親和性把 KV 命中由 56% 提到 88% 卻造成 3.46 倍負載不均，加入 LPT 後降至 1.24 倍，SLO 容量才由 240 提升至 500 QPS。論文也給出兩個 32B 反例：當可回收的前綴工作太少時，親和性反而使容量降至 0.50–0.67 倍或持平，因此建議部署前先以 shadow replay 驗證。限制包括等額槽位准入假設前綴大小相近、基線為重新實作、部分三種子實驗信賴區間較寬。
papers.title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
papers.title_zh: CacheRoute：為大規模 LLM 服務規劃前綴親和性路由

links.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation

evidence: Abstract: coverage-based diagnosis is 0.91 at hop 1 and 0.00 at hops 2 and 3 (n=43,36,21 failed trajectories) in the strict dense Claude Haiku 4.5 sweep
Section 5 (Metrics): exact-hop accuracy with bootstrap 95% CIs using B=1,000 resamples; cells with fewer than 10 failed traces reported as descriptive only

Section 6 (Backbones and retrieval): headline structural result uses Claude Haiku 4.5 with dense retrieval on three-hop MuSiQue; BM25/GPT-4o-mini/local conditions incomplete and excluded from main comparison
Table 3: hop-2 LLM-Judge 0.89 [0.72, 1.00] includes a positional prior and is flagged unsuitable as standalone localization evidence; n=18 pooled failed cases
Section 9 (Limitations): HotpotQA strict dense sweep has only 9 and 2 failed trajectories; depth-2 content comparison exploratory, depth-3 has n=3 with no method comparison made
Section 4 (Certified content corruption): corruption is seeded per trace and hop so replacements are reproducible; deterministic absorbed/resisted/derailed labels avoid LLM-judge dependence
Appendix C: discordant-pair comparison contains 1 versus 6 pairs, too small for McNemar test
Section 6 (Backbones and retrieval): 'The repository also contains BM25, GPT-4o-mini, and local-model conditions'—repository referenced but no URL or code-availability statement provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic: an interventional benchmark for causal failure attribution in agentic RAG, touching agent diagnosis (Agents 2.5), RAG grounding (1.8), multi-hop reasoning (2.5), LLM-judge evaluation (1.8), and LLM backbones (Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-4o-mini). The core idea—injecting certified faults, re-executing the downstream suffix, and scoring exact-hop attribution against the known intervention—is a genuine methodological contribution, and the frozen-hop vs. suffix-regeneration distinction is conceptually sharp. Rigor is solid: bootstrap CIs (Section 5), exclusion of cells with n<10, cross-family judging, deterministic judge-free span labels, and an unusually candid Limitations section. However, evidence rests on a single backbone/dataset pairing (Section 6: strict dense Claude Haiku 4.5 on three-hop MuSiQue), the depth-2 content comparison is exploratory (n=18), depth-3 content results have n=3 (Appendix B), the judge's 0.89 at hop 2 is confounded by a positional prior (Table 3 note), and the HotpotQA sweep had only 9 and 2 failed trajectories (Section 9). No statistical test was possible on key comparisons (Appendix C: 1 vs 6 discordant pairs). Reproducibility is partial: seeded per-trace corruption and an appendix of diagnoser details support replication, but the referenced repository has no link, and prompts/hyperparameters are unspecified.

primary_link.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interleaves retrieval, reasoning, and answer generation across multiple hops. A retrieval error at hop 1 can surface only as a wrong answer at hop 3, while later retrieval can also repair the trajectory. This paper introduces AgenticRAG-FP, an interventional benchmark for causal failure attribution in agentic RAG. The benchmark injects a certified fault at a specified hop, re-executes the downstream trajectory, and evaluates diagnosers against the kno
papers.summary_zh: Agentic RAG 在多跳之間交錯檢索、推理與作答，第一跳的檢索錯誤可能到第三跳才以錯誤答案顯現，而後續檢索也可能自我修復，使事後軌跡難以判定真正的失敗根源。本文提出 AgenticRAG-FP，一個介入式基準：在第 h 跳注入經認證的故障（空檢索、不相關文件、查詢漂移、錯誤前提、過時證據或內容汙染），讓代理即時重執行後續軌跡，再以已知的介入標籤評估診斷器能否在後綴已改變後仍指出注入的跳數。比較對象涵蓋 coverage 式的 Doctor-RAG、LLM 評審、凍結跳的反事實修復與後綴再生成。在 Claude Haiku 4.5 對 80 題三跳 MuSiQue 的嚴格密集掃描中，coverage 歸因第一跳達 0.91（n=43），第二、三跳卻跌至 0.00（n=36、21），顯示後綴重執行會抹除事後覆蓋訊號。內容汙染研究中，深度 2（n=18）的探索性比較顯示 coverage 為 0.00、凍結跳修復 0.67、LLM 評審 0.89（含位置先驗疑慮）、後綴再生成僅 0.11，因再生成可能檢索乾淨證據而消去被測故障；深度 3 僅 3 例，只作描述。認證的替換區間支持判定式答案標籤：15% 的第一跳汙染被逐字吸收。限制包括樣本數小、未測持久語料庫汙染、非完整因子掃描。此工作把傳播深度變成明確的評估軸，對診斷與修復探針的選擇具指引意義。
papers.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: 當錯誤逐層傳播：Agentic RAG 中的因果失敗歸因

links.title: Forking Fast: Efficiently Estimating Uncertainty Dynamics in Text Generation

evidence: Section 1 / Figure 1: models Llama-3-8B-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B on tinyMMLU with chain-of-thought resampling; code and interactive dashboard at https://github.com/ericb-goodfire/forking-fast
Section 3 Data: reference FPA dataset with S=200, N=1 over n=100 tinyMMLU questions, 1.77B tokens collected in total
Section 3.1: sample-efficiency multipliers of 5.0x (S=5, 4-token spacing) and 22.1x (S=5, 1-token spacing) for Llama; 4.9x for DeepSeek sentence resampling

Section 3.3 / Appendix F: pooled TVD between disjoint replicates fits slope -0.4903 through S=200, matching the multinomial 1/sqrt(S) law; measured TVD within 2% (ratios 0.98-1.01) of the exact i.i.d. null

Appendix E: ablations show removing segmentation raises forking-region TVD by +0.0113 [+0.0039,+0.0187] for Llama at threshold 0.15, while L2 detection cost is statistically indistinguishable from the Full Model (+0.0003 [-0.0004,+0.0009])

Appendix A Limitations: experiments restricted to tinyMMLU multiple-choice, two 8B models, continuations of at most 400/1536 tokens; 90% credible intervals achieve only 0.48-0.64 empirical coverage; hyperparameters tuned on two questions from one model; estimator advantage reverses at fork threshold 0.20
Appendix G: authors report uncovering a silent cost-substitution bug in the ruptures PELT library affecting segment counts
Appendix H: paper and initial draft produced by the autonomous LLM agent Silico under human direction
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research on uncertainty dynamics in chain-of-thought generation, directly matching LLM and CoT/reasoning preferences plus behavioral interpretability; not an out-of-scope domain application. The contribution is a statistically grounded efficiency improvement to Forking Paths Analysis (PELT change-point segmentation + kernel-pooled Dirichlet smoothing) rather than a fundamentally new analysis paradigm, so novelty is moderate. Rigor is strong: a derived multinomial noise model is empirically validated (fitted log-log slope -0.4903 vs. expected -0.5, within 2% of the exact i.i.d. null), component ablations with paired per-question CIs are reported, and a preregistered null result at larger fork thresholds is disclosed. Evidence is extensive (1.77B tokens, TVD-based comparisons, efficiency multipliers of 3.3x-22.1x) but confined to tinyMMLU multiple-choice, two 8B models, and short rollouts, which the Limitations section candidly acknowledges alongside failed credible-interval coverage (0.48-0.64) and degraded estimator advantage at large forks. Reproducibility is aided by released code/dashboard, though the analysis depends on massive sampling infrastructure.

primary_link.title: Forking Fast: Efficiently Estimating Uncertainty Dynamics in Text Generation

papers.summary: LLM reasoning is stochastic, and so understanding a model requires grappling with the distribution of reasoning chains that it might produce for a given question, i.e., its uncertainty. Resampling-based analyses characterize this distribution, revealing which steps of a rollout determine how the model arrives at its answer. However, a major limitation of these approaches is that resampling text sequences at every token or sentence in a reasoning chain is very costly. Our work strives to make res
papers.summary_zh: 重取樣分析（如 Forking Paths Analysis）能揭示推理鏈中哪些步驟決定模型的最終答案，但對每個 token 或句子都重取樣數百條續寫極為昂貴，分析單一推理鏈常需數百萬 token。本文先證明：當重取樣次數夠多時，不確定性動態會收斂到平滑曲線，僅在少數分岔點劇烈變化，低樣本下的波動主要是多項式取樣雜訊——實測變異距離隨樣本數以約 1/√S 衰減（log-log 斜率 −0.49）。作者據此提出統計模型：先以 PELT 變化點偵測（搭配精確多項式成本）切分穩定區段，區段內以高斯核加權的 Dirichlet 池化平滑答案計數，超參數由交叉驗證調校。在 tinyMMLU 上以 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 與 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 共約 17.7 億 token 的資料驗證：平滑可把有效樣本量放大 3.3 倍（S=30）至 5 倍（S=5），1-token 間距時最高達 22.1 倍；結合拉大取樣間距可將總預算縮減至 1/8 而誤差僅略增。消融顯示變化點分割能保留分岔點、核池化改善平緩區精度，並發現 ruptures 函式庫會默默以 L2 成本取代自訂成本的 bug。限制：僅涵蓋 tinyMMLU 與兩個 8B 模型、rollout 較短、可信區間覆蓋率不足故建議使用點估計，且在最大分岔下平滑優勢會反轉。此研究把重取樣成本視為建模問題，大幅降低解讀 LLM 不確定性的門檻。
papers.title: Forking Fast: Efficiently Estimating Uncertainty Dynamics in Text Generation
papers.title_zh: Forking Fast：高效估計文字生成中的不確定性動態

links.title: AEGIS: Attention-Embedding Gradient Isolation Shield - Triple-Channel Gradient Masking for Privacy-Preserving Federated LLM Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract: AEGIS reduces attack ROUGE-1 from >=0.87 (undefended) to <=0.005 across 11 models and six datasets, claimed 99% relative reduction

Section VI-B, Table II: freeze-only leaves DAGER R-1 at 0.509 on GPT-2 (attack pivots to embedding channel); full AEGIS‡ reaches R-1 0.024 with PPL 25.6 vs 26.0 undefended, supporting the channel-completeness argument

Section VI-C, Table V: AEGIS-2ch raises MLP-SVD R-1 on GPT-2-XL from 0.166 to 0.292 (residual signal gets cleaner); AEGIS-3ch collapses it to 0.036, demonstrating the third channel is scale-dependent and load-bearing

Section VI-E: optimisation-based GRAB only partially degrades (WikiText-2 R-1 0.533 to 0.463; DialogSum increases 0.388 to 0.526, attributed to variance over three sentences) — honest but limits the defense's scope

Section VII-B, Limitation 1: no (eps,delta)-DP guarantee; does not defeat Robust-PCA/Marchenko-Pastur denoising or cross-round signal aggregation; Section IV-D concedes the Channel-3 guarantee is 'a design criterion and empirical prediction rather than a theorem'

Section VI-A and Appendix -C: single fine-tuning seed (seed=42) per (model, dataset) cell, hyperparameters chosen from a coarse pilot sweep, LLaMA-2-13B only 3/6 datasets completed (dagger in Tables III-IV)
Table IX anomaly: GPT-2 Rotten Tomatoes accuracy improves from 0.54 (undefended) to 0.68 under AEGIS, a large unexplained utility jump under a single seed
Section VII-A, Table VIII: overhead 1.10-1.22x step time with dense payload reduced to 0.68-0.77x, cheaper than measured DP-SGD (2.31-7.53x) and pruning baselines

Reproducibility section states all code/scripts/logs are 'included in the supplementary material', but Appendix -G says artifacts 'will be released under the MIT License at the camera-ready version' — contradictory availability claims

Section VII-A, Table VI: adaptive side-channel stress test with explicit validity gates (undefended R-1 > 0.10 and > null+0.05); MLP-fc and LM-head probes valid and blocked 8/8; MLP-proj and LayerNorm probes fail the validity gate
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: privacy-preserving federated fine-tuning of LLMs (GPT-2/LLaMA/Gemma/BERT) against analytical gradient-inversion attacks, strongly matching the LLM (2.5), AI Safety/attack-defense (2.0), and Training & Optimization preferences. The triple-channel analysis of DAGER's exploitable gradient structures (attention SVD, embedding row-norm sparsity, adaptive MLP-SVD) is a genuinely useful threat decomposition, though the individual mechanisms (parameter freezing borrowed from PEFT, calibrated Gaussian 'flooding') are modest recombinations. Rigor is above average: formal Theorems 1-3 with stated assumptions, component ablation (Table II), adaptive-attack ablation showing AEGIS-2ch actually worsens MLP-SVD recovery on GPT-2-XL (0.166 to 0.292) and AEGIS-3ch fixes it, side-channel stress test with explicit validity gates, and baseline comparisons vs DP-SGD/pruning/Soteria. Honest limitations: no (eps,delta)-DP guarantee, GRAB only partially degraded (and R-1 increases on DialogSum), single seed, hyperparameters from a coarse pilot sweep, LLaMA-2-13B only 3/6 datasets. Evidence is broad (11 models, 6 datasets, timing/memory overheads, qualitative gibberish reconstructions) but contains anomalies that go unexplained (e.g., GPT-2 Rotten Tomatoes accuracy jumping 0.54 to 0.68 under AEGIS in Table IX, 'PPL' reported for BERT classification), and key Channel-3 security rests on an empirical Marchenko-Pastur argument the authors themselves flag as not a theorem. Threat model is narrow (single-client, single-step FedSGD, honest-but-curious). Reproducibility support is mixed: detailed hyperparameters, seeds, software pins, and compute accounting, but contradictory code-release statements ('included in the supplementary material' vs 'released at the camera-ready version').

primary_link.title: AEGIS: Attention-Embedding Gradient Isolation Shield - Triple-Channel Gradient Masking for Privacy-Preserving Federated LLM Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: Gradient inversion attacks recover private training text from gradients shared in federated learning, posing a serious threat to collaborative model training. Through our analysis of transformer gradient structure, we identify three channels through which private token information leaks: the attention output projection gradient exposes a low-rank subspace that encodes input embeddings (Channel 1), the embedding gradient's row-norm sparsity directly reveals which tokens are present (Channel 2), a
papers.summary_zh: 在聯邦學習中，梯度反演攻擊可從客戶端上傳的梯度還原私有訓練文字。作者剖析 Transformer 梯度結構，指出三個洩漏通道：注意力輸出投影梯度構成的低秩子空間（Channel 1）、嵌入層梯度列範數的稀疏性直接暴露出現過的 token（Channel 2），以及 MLP 擴張梯度上可被自適應攻擊者重複利用的同型子空間訊號（Channel 3）。現有防禦最多封住一個通道，且往往犧牲效用。AEGIS 以三個反向傳播路徑操作同時關閉三個通道：凍結注意力投影參數使梯度恆為零、對嵌入梯度注入校準雜訊使列範數無法區分 token 有無、並對 MLP 擴張與投影梯度做類似均質化，把 SVD 訊號壓到 Marchenko–Pastur 雜訊底之下；相同的遮罩梯度同時驅動本地最佳化器與伺服器匯出。作者為通道 1、2 提供形式化保證，並以 Lean 4 形式化核心定理。在 11 個模型（GPT-2 系列到 LLaMA-2-13B、Gemma-2、BERT）與六個資料集上，DAGER 的 ROUGE-1 從 ≥0.87 降至 ≤0.005，SOMP 與 FedSpy-LLM 亦近歸零，GRAB 僅部分退化；測試困惑度持平或更佳，每步時間僅增 1.10–1.22 倍。限制：無 (ε,δ)-DP 保證、無法完全擊敗最佳化式攻擊或跨輪聚合攻擊、僅評估單一客戶端單步 FedSGD，且每格只用單一訓練種子。此工作顯示隱私防禦必須完整覆蓋所有可被利用的梯度通道。
papers.title: AEGIS: Attention-Embedding Gradient Isolation Shield - Triple-Channel Gradient Masking for Privacy-Preserving Federated LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: AEGIS：以三通道梯度遮罩保護聯邦式 LLM fine-tuning 的隱私

links.title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation

evidence: Abstract & Section 4.1.2 (Table 1): agent instruction files 1,074 events (35.4%) plus agent working notes 760 (25.1%) = 60.5% of 3,033 documentation interactions; API references 40 events (1.3%)

Section 4.2.2 (Table 3): run-test lift 0.23, cluster CI 0.08-0.45, adjusted OR 0.39 [0.25, 0.60]; code-edit lift 1.05 [0.86, 1.27] unadjusted vs. adjusted OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]; authors explicitly treat authoring associations as unresolved
Section 4.2.3 (Table 4): documentation is first recovery action in 109 of 2,034 failure episodes (5.4%); resolution 7/11 with CI 35.4-84.8% overlapping all alternatives, so no ranking claimed
Section 7.1: Tier-2 agent_working_note labels come from language-model classification of 500 ambiguous paths with 'No human validation of these labels has been performed'
Section 3.4: extraction matched SWE-chat tool_call_count exactly in five of six spot-checked sessions; shell-embedded path parsing defect fixed after one agent family showed zero events
Section 7.4: SWE-chat is opt-in telemetry with 87% of corpus from a single agent family; AIDev over-represents early-adopting public repositories
Section 4.4 (Table 8): sensitivity analysis shows agent-facing consultation share drops from 57.4% pooled to 50.5% (session-equal) and 50.1% (agent-reweighted), straddling the 50% boundary

Data and Materials Availability: replication package includes four format-specific extractors, 20-symbol event alphabet, Tier-1 rules and 527 Tier-2 labels, event-level table with evidence spans, and scripts with fixed seeds (13, 11, 7)
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope empirical study of LLM coding agents' documentation behaviour, directly matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLM-based agents; instruction files like AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md are prompt/context artifacts). Novelty is genuine: the related-work section plausibly establishes no prior measurement of consultation rates, document-type distributions, or self-initiated vs. failure-driven triggers for coding agents, and the agent_working_note category and two-lobed cycle model are new. Rigor is above average for empirical SE: stratified sampling, cluster bootstraps (2,000 resamples, fixed seeds), GEE adjustment, three weighting schemes, and unusually honest treatment of unresolved results (e.g., refusing to rank recovery strategies at n=11). Deductions: the headline 25.1% working-note share rests on unvalidated LLM-classified labels (Section 7.1), extraction was spot-checked in only six sessions, the stage heuristic is acknowledged as sticky, and no multiple-comparison correction is applied. Evidence strength is solid for robust findings (agent-facing 60.5% with CI 53.9-66.5%; testing lift 0.23 surviving adjustment) but several central claims (read-to-code coupling) flip depending on specification. Generalizability is limited: opt-in telemetry, 87% single agent family, early-adopter public repos, fast-moving snapshot. Reproducibility is strong with a full released pipeline, event-level data, fixed seeds, and generated tables.

primary_link.title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation

papers.summary: Technical documentation is written for human developers, but an increasing share of software changes is now authored by autonomous coding agents. Which documents they consult, when, and what follows remain unknown. We conduct a behaviour-grounded study of agent-documentation interaction across two public datasets: 557 agentic coding sessions from SWE-chat, yielding 94,813 development events including 3,033 documentation interactions; and 33,097 agentic pull requests from AIDev, with 690,260 clas
papers.summary_zh: 技術文件長期以人類開發者為預設讀者,但越來越多程式變更已由自主編碼代理完成,代理究竟查閱哪些文件、何時查閱、查閱後發生什麼,過去缺乏實證。本研究結合兩個公開資料集:SWE-chat 的 557 個真實代理編碼工作階段(94,813 個事件,其中 3,033 個文件互動)與 AIDev 的 33,097 個代理拉取請求(690,260 筆檔案層級變更記錄)。四項發現挑戰現行文件實務假設:一、代理的文件工作由代理友善產物主導,指令檔(如 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md)與代理工作筆記合計占 60.5%,API 參考文件僅 1.3%,疑難排解文件更低至 0.4%。二、查閱與程式編輯的關聯未定:相鄰轉移機率僅 0.002,未調整提升比為 1.05,經階段調整後勝算比為 1.33。三、未觀察到以文件為依據的驗證序列,查閱文件後反而較少立即測試或建置。四、查閱多為主動發起(70.2%)而非失敗驅動(7.5%),且程式先於文件被修改的頻率高出 4.7 倍。作者據此提出「雙瓣循環」的描述性模型,並指出「可操作性」與「可驗證性」等常見的代理友善文件主張缺乏行為證據支持,建議資源應優先投入指令檔的正確性。限制包括 Tier-2 標籤未經人工驗證、以檔案路徑辨識文件會遺漏程式內註解,且資料僅是快速變遷實務的快照。
papers.title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation
papers.title_zh: 從代理行為到代理友善文件:編碼代理如何探索、閱讀與撰寫技術文件的實證研究

links.title: Rethinking the Evaluation and Optimization of LLM-Based Social Simulation

evidence: §5.3/Table 1: SALT with Qwen3-8B reduces KL over SFT by 77.6%, JSD by 45.9%, TVD by 31.2%, MMD by 52.7% on SubjSim, best on all four metrics in every domain.
§3.2/Proposition 2 and Appendix C.2: Fano-inequality lower bound showing point-mass (hard-label) training error ≥ (s log K − log 2)/log(K−1), growing with subjectivity coefficient s.
§4/Theorem 1 and Eq. 18: bias-statistical tradeoff yields adaptive radius r(x) = C·(K_eff_hat(x)/n_g)^(1/(d_X+2)), with d_X=28 estimated via PCA (Appendix D).
§5.5/Figures 2-3: ablations (Top-N, fixed K_eff, Global-Freq) all underperform the adaptive radius; radius scale C shows low sensitivity (~0.003 KL across C∈[0.10,0.30]).
Appendix F/Table 4: paired bootstrap (1,000 resamples, 2,800 test contexts) gives disjoint 95% CIs between SALT and every baseline on all metrics.

Appendix A Limitations: evaluation uses elicited response propensities rather than repeated-choice frequencies; split tests unseen personas within known questions; aggregation can be harmful under poor embeddings or discontinuous behavior.

Appendix G: SubjSim construction documented (5,964-item pool from seven surveys, DeepSeek-chat screening prompt, 193 annotators, probability-ball protocol), with annotator-pool representativeness limits in G.3; data/code release promised in Reproducibility Statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: fine-tunes Qwen3-8B (SFT vs DPO/PPO/DSA) for behavioral distribution matching and builds an LLM evaluation benchmark, strongly matching LLM/training/evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid but bounded: soft labels from neighborhood aggregation is classical smoothing (Nadaraya-Watson, acknowledged in §3.2/Appendix B); the genuinely new pieces are the entropy-based subjectivity coefficient, the theory-derived subjectivity-adaptive radius, and the SubjSim probability-ball benchmark. Rigor is high: formal propositions with proofs (Appendix C), Fano-based lower bound, bias-variance tradeoff theorem, four ablations, subjectivity-stratified analysis, and paired-bootstrap significance. Evidence is comprehensive but confined to one self-constructed benchmark, one backbone, and an elicited-propensity proxy for ground truth (acknowledged in Appendix A); the annotator-level split does not test transfer to new questions, and the practical radius relies on a model-based K_eff heuristic (Remark 2). Generalizability is moderate since SALT requires shared action spaces and embedding-space behavioral smoothness, with sequential/multi-agent/open-ended settings deferred to future work. Reproducibility is strong: full algorithm, hyperparameter tables, dataset construction pipeline, and a commitment to release data and code.

primary_link.title: Rethinking the Evaluation and Optimization of LLM-Based Social Simulation

papers.summary: LLM-based social simulation is a promising complement to traditional methods such as surveys and behavioral experiments. A core question is how to evaluate the fidelity of LLM-simulated human behavior and optimize LLMs toward it. Prevailing practice evaluates by accuracy, checking whether the model selects the single response observed from a human, and trains the LLM to reproduce this hard label. However, human behavior is inherently subjective: the same person in the same situation may reasonab
papers.summary_zh: LLM 社會模擬被視為問卷與行為實驗之外的社會科學新工具,但主流評估沿襲編碼、數學等客觀任務的慣例:檢查模型是否選中單一觀察到的人類回應,並以該硬標籤訓練模型。本文指出人類行為本質上具隨機性,同一人在相同情境可有不同合理行動,觀察到的回應只是底層回應分佈的一次抽樣,因此準確率評估不可靠、硬標籤訓練會誤導。作者定義「主觀性係數」,一個以熵為基礎的量,區分客觀任務(編碼,係數近零)與主觀任務(社會模擬),並形式化證明:隨主觀性升高,準確率評估與單標籤訓練必然失效,任何點質量模型的誤差下界隨主觀性成長。據此提出 SALT(主觀性自適應軟標籤訓練),理論上證明聚合—估計誤差權衡並給出最佳半徑;方法上將語義相近、共用選項之輸入的觀察結果匯聚為軟分佈標籤,聚合半徑依各輸入估計的主觀性自動調整,在近客觀極限下自然退化為標準單標籤訓練。為支撐分佈式評估,作者建構 SubjSim 基準:193 位標註者回答 100 道主觀題,共 19,300 個情境,以機率球分配引出回應傾向分佈。以 Qwen3-8B 為骨幹,SALT 相較 SFT 將 KL 散度降低 77.6%、JSD 降低 45.9%、TVD 降低 31.2%、MMD 降低 52.7%,增益在高主觀性情境最大;消融實驗確認自適應半徑的必要性。限制包括 SubjSim 以引出的傾向而非重複選擇頻率作為真值,且方法依賴表示空間中的行為平滑假設。
papers.title: Rethinking the Evaluation and Optimization of LLM-Based Social Simulation
papers.title_zh: 重新思考 LLM 社會模擬的評估與最佳化

links.title: Beyond Memory Majority: Latent-Source Reasoning for Multi-Agent Memory Arbitration

evidence: Abstract: proposes Correlation-Aware Memory Arbitration (CAMA) that 'decouples retrieved memories and recovers missing independent evidence' to prevent false majorities in long-term multi-agent systems.

Methodology, Eq. (4): effective number of independent evidence sources computed via Hill diversity over latent slot presence e_j from max assignment, preventing correlated memories from inflating evidence mass.
Table 1: CAMA overall 59.1 vs. MADAM-RAG 54.3 on MemoryAgentBench under DeepSeek-V4-Flash; consistent gains with Qwen3.6-27B (62.4 vs. 57.1).
Table 3 (Ablation): removing evidence decoupling drops CMR from 71.2 to 48.2 on MemoryAgentBench; w/o Expand drops ERR from 36.2 to 15.3.
Appendix D (Correlation-aware Benchmark Construction): correlated memories generated by the authors through paraphrasing/summarization with recorded provenance links; ground-truth answers preserved.
Implementation Details: K=10 retrieved memories, J=6 latent slots, budget B=3, alpha=2, mu=0.5, gamma=0.95; evidence assignment module trained on training split and frozen during evaluation.
Appendix I: prompt templates provided for candidate hypothesis extraction, evidence scoring, and expansion query generation.
No statement of code or benchmark release, no error bars or significance tests found anywhere in the document; LoCoMo results appear only in Table 1 without correlation metrics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A method paper squarely in scope: multi-agent LLM memory systems, RAG-style evidence arbitration, and RL-based evidence recovery align strongly with the Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and LLM preferences. The 'Memory Correlation Bias' problem framing (correlated memories creating false majorities) and the Hill-diversity-based effective-evidence count are a fresh angle, though the solution assembles known pieces (soft slot assignment, provenance-biased attention, actor-critic recovery policy). Rigor is solid on structure: three benchmarks, two backbones, six baselines, five-way ablations, sensitivity analysis, and efficiency accounting with internally consistent tables (e.g., Table 2 CMR 71.2 matches ablation Table 3). Main weaknesses: the headline correlation-aware metrics are computed on variants the authors construct themselves via paraphrasing/summarization with recorded provenance (Appendix D), which structurally favors a method consuming provenance metadata; no statistical significance, variance, or seed reporting; no code/data release statement; and learned arbitration/recovery modules require supervised ground-truth conclusions, limiting deployment generalizability. Detailed hyperparameters, algorithm pseudocode, and prompt templates (Appendices A, I) partially support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Beyond Memory Majority: Latent-Source Reasoning for Multi-Agent Memory Arbitration

papers.summary: Long-term multi-agent systems continuously accumulate the memories produced by different agents. Existing memory methods typically treat retrieved memories as independent evidence and combine them through voting or weighting. However, this independence assumption often fails in multi-agent settings: memories written by different agents may inherit the same upstream source or shared bias, causing correlated evidence to be repeatedly counted and creating a false majority. We term this failure mode
papers.summary_zh: 長期多代理系統持續將各代理的觀察、摘要與推理結果寫入共享記憶庫,檢索後多以投票或加權聚合,隱含各記憶彼此獨立的假設。本文指出該假設在多代理場景常失效:不同代理撰寫的記憶可能繼承同一上游來源或共享偏誤,使相關證據被重複計數而形成虛假多數,作者稱之為「記憶相關性偏誤」,錯誤結論寫回共享記憶後更會自我強化。為此提出 CAMA(相關性感知記憶仲裁)框架:將檢索到的記憶建模為查詢條件下的潛在證據槽,結合神經依賴推論與基於溯源資訊的符號先驗,以 Hill 多樣性估計有效獨立證據源數量,避免相關記憶重複計票,仲裁改在證據因子層級聚合假設支持度。由於關鍵獨立證據可能不在初始檢索結果中,CAMA 再以強化學習訓練序列式恢復策略,在預算內選擇擴充查詢、沿溯源邊回溯或停止,主動補足缺失證據。實驗於 MemoryAgentBench、LongMemEval、LoCoMo 上,以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 與 Qwen3.6-27B 為骨幹,CAMA 全面超越 Vanilla RAG、多數投票、HippoRAG、Mem0、MAD 與 MADAM-RAG 等基準;在相關性感知指標上,少數正確證據回收率(CMR)大增、複製敏感度(RS)下降,證據解析率(ERR)亦提升。消融實驗證實證據解耦、溯源先驗與恢復動作各有貢獻,每千 token 的準確率增益亦具效率優勢。整體而言,可靠的記憶仲裁需要理解記憶背後的依賴結構,而非單純累積更多記憶。
papers.title: Beyond Memory Majority: Latent-Source Reasoning for Multi-Agent Memory Arbitration
papers.title_zh: 超越記憶多數決:多代理記憶仲裁的潛在來源推理

links.title: When Text and Numbers Disagree: Evidence Arbitration in Large Language Models

evidence: Section 3.2 defines four controlled conflict settings (modality priors, temporal recency, reliability, tool forecast) that independently manipulate arbitration cues with known ground truth by construction.

Section 4 reports systematic findings: Qwen3 models favour numerical evidence, temporal recency is followed more consistently than reliability cues, and tool forecast conflicts produce the strongest degradation with near-zero accuracy when context appears first.

Appendix E / Table A2 provides quantitative sensitivity analyses across domain, answer choice, margin range, noise, and time series length, showing conflict-setting accuracy shifts up to 0.20 for some models.
Section 3.4 states logits-based evaluation over answer tokens 'A' and 'B' avoids decoding variability, with results averaged over three random seeds and 2000 instances per setting.
Limitations section acknowledges no real-world data experiments and binary task simplification; Appendix D specifies models, hardware (RTX PRO 5000 48GB), ~40 GPU hours, and FP16 inference.
Section 3.5 lists evaluated models: Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B/14B, Gemma-2-9B-It, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, all open-weight.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed LLM evaluation paper that introduces a novel controlled benchmark for studying how LLMs arbitrate between conflicting textual and numerical evidence. Strongly aligned with multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents/tool use, evaluation). The experimental design is rigorous with balanced datasets, three seeds, sensitivity analyses across five parameter dimensions, and logits-based evaluation. However, the purely synthetic setting with template-based text generation limits generalizability to real-world deployments, only open-weight models up to 14B are evaluated, and the paper is purely diagnostic without proposing mitigation methods. No code release is mentioned, though experimental details are thorough.

primary_link.title: When Text and Numbers Disagree: Evidence Arbitration in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in settings where textual summaries, numerical observations, and external tool outputs may provide conflicting evidence. We study how LLMs arbitrate between such sources when they support opposing decisions. To do so, we introduce a controlled synthetic benchmark in which latent risk trajectories generate both numerical time series and natural language summaries, allowing us to construct conflicts where exactly one evidence source is aligned wit
papers.summary_zh: LLM 日益被部署於整合文字摘要、數值觀測與外部工具輸出的決策系統,當不同來源支持相反結論時,模型如何取捨證據,過去缺乏系統性研究。本文提出「文字—數值證據仲裁」的受控合成基準:由潛在風險軌跡同時產生數值時間序列與自然語言摘要,據此建構恰好只有一個來源與真實標籤一致的衝突情境,並獨立操弄四個維度:模態先驗、時間新近性、來源可靠性,以及證據來源(直接觀測對外部工具預測)。評估涵蓋 Qwen3(1.7B 至 14B)、Gemma-2-9B-It、Llama-3-8B-Instruct 與 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 等開源模型。結果顯示仲裁行為系統性而非隨機:各模型家族呈現不同的文字—數值偏好,Qwen3 一貫偏愛數值證據,Llama 與 Mistral 較倚重文字,Gemma 最為平衡;模型遵循時間新近性線索的程度明顯高於明示的可靠性標記;面對與情境證據衝突的外部預測,多數模型嚴重過度依賴工具輸出,部分情境甚至出現近零或低於隨機水準的準確率,顯示模型並非單純不確定,而是系統性偏向錯誤來源。證據呈現順序亦引發強烈的近因效應,後出現的證據影響更大。作者據此主張現行 LLM 多仰賴啟發式仲裁策略,僅以單一模態或工具使用指標評估,不足以反映多來源決策行為,衝突式評估可作為證據整合能力的壓力測試。限制在於全部採用合成資料,且任務簡化為二元預測,未涵蓋真實世界的完整複雜度。

links.title: PersonalBench: Measuring the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization

evidence: Abstract: all methods achieve LUAR similarity 0.484-0.508, below cross-author human floor 0.626 (ceiling 0.756); gen<->gen AUC 0.918 vs gen->real AUC 0.632
Section 4.2: LUAR validation on 2,500 same-author and 2,500 cross-author pairs achieves AUC 0.76 single-post (TF-IDF baseline 0.54) and 0.96 with 5-post aggregation
Section 3.2 / Table 1: prompt contamination ablation - raw first-sentence prompts inflate baseline TMR to 0.587 vs 0.384 with LLM content summaries (28pp reduction)
Table 2: hierarchical bootstrap 95% CIs (B=10,000) across 50 authors, 1,000 generations; method spread on LUAR is 0.024 and all CIs overlap, supporting 'statistically indistinguishable'
Section 4.6.1: circularity evidence - real author scores TMR 0.427, below Profile Extraction's 0.542, indicating the judge measures instruction-following rather than style fidelity
Section 4.6.2: trait extraction stability across 3 runs on 10 authors yields mean Jaccard similarity 0.22, undermining TMR reliability
Section 4.6.4: GLM-4 replication on 10 authors/150 generations keeps all methods below the human floor (0.417-0.576 vs 0.626, AUC 0.671), but sample size is small
Section 6: acknowledged limitations - LUAR trained on Reddit not blogs, distributional/format confound, no human validation of the judge, both models 32B 4-bit, single English domain from 1999-2004
Section 4.1: setup fully specified - Qwen 3 32B 4-bit generator (mlx-lm), GLM-4 32B 4-bit judge, ~3,300 LLM calls over ~24 hours on Apple M4 Pro 48GB
Appendix A: all seven prompt templates reproduced verbatim; Section 1 and NeurIPS checklist item 5 claim code/data release at github.com/yashsawant22/personalbench
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM evaluation/personalization benchmark paper squarely within scope: it evaluates inference-time LLM personalization (few-shot, profile extraction, contrastive prompting) using LLM-as-judge and a trained authorship model, with a calibrated negative finding that prompting shifts surface style but not the LLM authorship fingerprint. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, prompting/in-context methods, LLM-judge evaluation, NLP/stylometry). Novelty is moderate-good: using LUAR authorship verification as the primary metric and diagnosing judge-method circularity are fresh, but the core negative result corroborates prior work (Wang et al. 2025) and reuses an existing corpus and model. Rigor is above average for the scale: floor/ceiling calibration, hierarchical bootstrap CIs, LUAR validation (AUC 0.76/0.96), prompt-contamination ablation (28pp baseline shift), aggregation-sensitivity checks, and a second-generator replication; but the judge is never validated against humans (trait Jaccard 0.22 undercuts TMR), both models are 32B 4-bit, and the LUAR Reddit-vs-blog domain gap plus format confound are only partially mitigated. Evidence for the headline claim is convergent across metrics and two generators, though the GLM-4 replication covers only 10 authors. Generalizability is limited: one English blog corpus from 1999-2004, narrow model scale. Reproducibility is good: verbatim prompts (Appendix A), full setup/hardware specs, and a public GitHub release plus public corpus/model dependencies. Not a domain-application or out-of-scope topic; full 0-1 range applies.

primary_link.title: PersonalBench: Measuring the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization

papers.summary: Personalized text generation aims to make LLMs write in a specific individual's style, yet existing benchmarks measure task accuracy or preference alignment rather than whether the model's output actually resembles the target author's writing. We introduce PersonalBench, a benchmark that evaluates inference-time personalization methods through three independent lenses: LUAR (a trained authorship verification model), an LLM-as-judge, and automated stylometrics. Across 50 authors, 1,000 generation
papers.summary_zh: 個人化文字生成的目標是讓大型語言模型模仿特定使用者的寫作風格，但現有基準多衡量任務準確率或偏好對齊，而非輸出是否真正像目標作者。作者提出 PersonalBench，以三種獨立視角評估推論期個人化方法：作者身分驗證模型 LUAR、LLM 評審（LLM-as-judge）與自動文體計量（stylometrics）。實驗涵蓋 50 位部落格作者、1,000 次生成、四種方法（無個人化、few-shot、風格剖析檔抽取、對比式特徵），並以 Qwen 3 32B 生成、GLM-4 32B 評審。核心發現：個人化確實產生可區分目標作者的輸出（生成文本內部 AUC=0.918），但所有方法與真人作者的 LUAR 相似度僅 0.484–0.508，低於真人跨作者下限 0.626（上限 0.756），顯示 LLM 自身的作者指紋主導輸出，個人化文本甚至比隨機真人彼此更疏遠。LLM 評審上 Profile Extraction 的高分被歸因於特質抽取與剖析檔抽取間的循環性，且跨指標相關性近於零，單一指標不可靠。LUAR 已驗證可測量（單篇 AUC 0.76、多篇彙整 0.96）。限制包括僅測兩個 32B 4-bit 模型、單一部落格領域、LUAR 的 Reddit 領域落差與缺乏人工驗證。此基準提供校準量尺：推論期個人化只能調整 LLM 風格空間內的表面樣貌，縮小作者鴻溝可能需要 LoRA、強化學習等訓練期手段。
papers.title: PersonalBench: Measuring the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization
papers.title_zh: PersonalBench：衡量 LLM 個人化中的作者身分鴻溝

links.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: resource-wise attention matches Dense (82.3% vs 82.4% Inv-F1) with 3.655× TTFT speedup; full framework gives 92.43% memory reduction and 1.423× attention speedup
§6 Table 3: on T_IND, ReCache Inv-F1 80.3 vs Dense 82.4; Ω_20,3 beats attention-mass SA_20,3 by 3.0 points at matched budget
§6 Table 4: T_OOD Inv-F1 60.8 vs Dense 66.3 (91.8% retained); hallucination 0.6% vs SPEED 13.4% and SA_20,3 5.1%
§6 Tables 2-4 vs §2: modular cache-reuse methods (EPIC, CacheBlend, KVLink, KVCOMM) are discussed as related work but the reuse claim is only measured against Dense; no significance/variance reported
Limitations: only Qwen3-4B/1.7B backbones, trainable settings only with frozen-model adaptation deferred, and method assumes stable system instructions and resource schemas

§4.1 and Appendix A: 49,424 training examples plus 1,000-example IND/OOD splits assembled from seven public datasets via diversity-first sampling; Appendix A reports source duplication statistics (77.3% recurring names, 18.8% duplicate candidate subsets)

Appendix C Table 8: retaining resource name reduces hallucination from 76.0% to 1.8% relative to suffix-only schema; adding resource descriptions on top of argument descriptions changes metrics by <0.7%
§4.3 and Limitations: full fine-tuning on A800/RTX 5000; code claimed available at github.com/EIT-NLP/ReCache
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to agentic-LLM inference: KV-cache reuse and compression for tool-augmented Qwen3 agents touches Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Inference & Serving, and Transformer Architecture preferences with genuine methodology (attention-mask/position redesign plus training), not a domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: making caches composition-invariant by removing cross-resource attention and re-indexing positions is a clean twist on modular reuse (Prompt Cache, EPIC, CacheBlend, KVLink), and leave-one-in contribution routing plus field-aware schema pruning adapt known compression ideas to tool invocation; however, the cited modular-reuse baselines are never empirically compared, and pruning components largely recombine prior techniques. Rigor is solid on ablations (Block vs Ω_full, cross-scale budget analysis, semantic-field hierarchy, IND/OOD splits, TTFT/TPOT/Attn/Mem metrics) but results appear single-run without variance, and Gist/Beacon adaptations may be weak proxies (Gist collapses to 39.2 Inv-F1). Evidence for the efficiency claims is concrete and internally consistent; evidence for superiority over state-of-the-art cache reuse is thinner. Generalizability is limited by one model family, full fine-tuning requirements (frozen models deferred), and a stable-schema assumption. Code release and detailed dataset construction (Appendix A) support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

papers.summary: Agentic language models repeatedly encode tool and skill schemas that recur across requests in different combinations and orders, preventing standard prefix caching from reusing their key--value (KV) states. We introduce \textbf{ReCache}, a framework for independently caching resource representations while reducing their inference-time computational and memory overhead. Resource-wise attention removes cross-resource interactions and assigns resource-local positions, producing composition-invaria
papers.summary_zh: 工具增強型 LLM 代理會在不同請求中以不同組合與順序反覆編碼相同的工具與技能綱要，標準前綴快取因此無法重用其 KV 狀態，造成重複的前置編碼計算。ReCache 提出資源層級的 KV 快取重用與壓縮框架：resource-wise attention 移除跨資源注意力並在區塊內重置位置索引，產生與組合無關、可獨立建構與重用的 KV 區塊；結構剪枝以 leave-one-in 貢獻分析，僅讓貢獻最大的層–KV 頭群路由存取資源狀態；語意剪枝保留資源名稱、參數名稱與參數描述等呼叫關鍵欄位，並以最後一個 token 作為語意錨點；模型經輕量微調適應新的注意力與位置配置。作者整合七個公開工具與技能資料集建立基準，含資源不相交的 OOD 測試：resource-wise attention 幾乎不損效能（Inv-F1 82.3% 對 Dense 82.4%）並帶來 3.655 倍 TTFT 加速；完整框架減少 92.43% 的 KV 張量記憶體、注意力加速 1.423 倍，OOD 上仍保有 Dense 的 91.8% 效能，貢獻式選擇在未見資源上明顯優於注意力式與層非對稱基線，資源幻覺率也更低。限制在於僅驗證 Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-1.7B 兩個骨幹、目前需要可訓練設定，並假設系統指令與資源綱要相對穩定。此工作為動態資源情境下的代理推論成本提供實用的縮減路徑。
papers.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: ReCache：為工具增強型 LLM 代理提供高效率的 KV 快取重用與壓縮

§3.3 Table 6: additive ablation against matched-budget Dolmino-20BT; single-branch variants fall below no mid-training on MCP-Universe, and the complete mixture is the only config improving all eight metrics.
Table 5: web-search subset score is 0.00 across all settings, honestly framed in §3.2 as a capability boundary for deep-search behaviors.
Appendix A.3: DeCon contamination audit flags <20 candidates, all web-slice BFCLv3 matches manually confirmed as false positives.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM mid-training corpus and pipeline explicitly targeting agentic tool use (MCP, function calling), with SFT and GRPO RL experiments on Qwen3-4B/8B-Base. Core contribution is the two-branch synthesis design (context-grounded augmentation + native agentic trajectories) and the claim of the first open general tool-use mid-training corpus; methodologically incremental given prior agentic mid-training work (AgentFounder, Tongyi, daVinci-Dev), but the specific tool-use focus and 20.3B-token mixture are new. Deductions for single-run results with no variance estimates, ablation variants not token-budget matched (admitted in Appendix D), and heavy reliance on proprietary teachers (GPT-5/5.1/5.2, Qwen3-235B) whose prompts are not fully specified. Generalizability limited to one model family in main results, with only an exploratory gemma-3 pilot; release of data/models claimed.

papers.summary: Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive abilities such as math and science, and can also improve agentic capabilities in software-engineering settings. In this work, we study the parallel but less explored agentic capability: general tool use. We present MidTool, an open corpus construction pipeline for agentic tool-use mid-training that c
papers.summary_zh: 工具使用能力的進展多半來自後訓練的 SFT 與 RL，本文追問：通用工具使用能力能否透過專門的中期訓練（mid-training）更早塑造？作者提出 MidTool，一條開放的代理式中期訓練語料管線：蒐集網頁（FineWeb）、PDF（FinePDFs）、程式碼儲存庫與結構化工具成品（REST API 與 MCP 技能）四大來源，再以兩條合成分支轉為訓練監督——文件為本的情境接地軌跡擴增，以及從真實 API 與 MCP 技能出發的原生代理軌跡合成，並嚴格驗證綱要接地、輪次順序與工具回應一致性，最終組成 203 億 token 的 MidTool-Mix。以 Qwen3-4B-Base 與 Qwen3-8B-Base 中期訓練後接相同的 SFT 與 RL 配方，在 BFCLv3、τ²-Bench 與 MCP-Universe 上一致超越僅 SFT 的基線，多輪與互動情境增益最大，且 SFT 收斂更快、RL 初期適應更佳。消融顯示兩分支互補：原生軌跡利於函式呼叫，情境接地利於遷移，但 MCP-Universe 的網路搜尋子集仍為零分，揭示通用工具先驗的能力邊界，深度搜尋行為需要專門資料。限制包括下游配方固定、未與中期訓練共同設計，混合設計空間未完整掃描，且依賴 GPT-5 等專有教師模型。此研究證明工具使用如數學與程式能力一樣受益於專門中期訓練，為代理能力的預訓練階段奠定基礎。

links.title: Peer-Voted LLM-Agent Stress Tests Find Feed-Induced Lexical Convergence but No Reliable Matched-Exposure Advantage for Distributed Sources

evidence: Abstract: 448 trials and 112 model-by-topic-by-seed blocks; peer-ranked feed raises final lexical similarity (+0.0082 TF-IDF cosine [0.0043,0.0121], p=0.000105, n=64 core; +0.0109 [0.0069,0.0151], p=0.000001, n=48 larger variants), while the preregistered distributed-minus-single contrast is inconclusive (+0.057 [-0.009,0.125], p=0.112 core; -0.040, p=0.332 larger), failing the prespecified consistency criterion.

Section 3.5: inferential unit is the complete paired model-topic-seed block 'never an individual post'; 20,000-draw block bootstrap, exact sign tests, and sign-flip randomization; parse failures 0.26%/0.20% (posts) and 0.76%/1.05% (votes) all below the frozen 5% warning threshold, with failed generations retaining prior stance.

Section 5: exploratory audit reports 'paraphrase leakage' (all-keyword detector found zero matches despite close restatements), 'stance confounding' in embeddings, and two independent LLM stance judges agreeing on only 43.6% of endpoint labels (Cohen's kappa=0.258), so misinformation rankings are not claimed.

Section 6.3: limitations concede the feed contrast bundles peer-post exposure with ranking (no unranked-feed arm), the distributed contrast tests a package not account count in isolation, scope is four open-weight families plus three larger variants on four platform-policy topics, and results do not transfer to humans or named platforms.

Code and data availability: complete implementation, frozen protocol (CONFIRMATORY_PREREGISTRATION.md), configurations, and 59,776 production posts from 528 trials (every confirmatory post, vote, exposure record, endpoint) released on GitHub and HuggingFace, with deterministic request seeds per Section 3.1.

Section 4.2: heterogeneity analysis shows lexical effects positive for three of four core models and all larger variants (Gemma 4 E4B slightly negative), survival effects concentrated in Qwen 3.5 4B (-12.5 pp), and the larger Qwen variant significantly negative within its 16-block PDI stratum, supporting the model-strata reporting principle.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent population study (multi-agent LLM simulation, adversarial agent coordination, evaluation methodology) directly matching Agents & Tool Use (w2.5), LLMs (w2.5), and AI Safety/Red-Teaming preferences, though with no Japanese-LLM, reasoning, or code angle and no methodological advance to the models themselves. Research quality is unusually high for LLM social simulation: a frozen preregistration, paired model-topic-seed blocks as inferential units, block bootstrap plus exact randomization tests, honest reporting of a failed prespecified coordination criterion, and a thorough limitations section (bundled feed/ranking treatment, bundled distributed-source package, open-weight-only scope, synthetic populations). Evidence strength is capped by small effect sizes (0.008-0.011 TF-IDF cosine), shallow outcome measures (self-reported discrete stance, TF-IDF similarity), acknowledged causal confounds (no unranked-feed arm), and inconclusive negative results correctly reported as inconclusive rather than null. Novelty is moderate: opinion-dynamics and LLM-collective simulators exist (Park 2023, OASIS, MOSAIC, Zhong 2025); the matched-exposure adversarial design and exploratory/confirmatory separation are the genuine innovations. Generalizability is deliberately narrow (four open-weight families, three larger variants, four platform-policy topics, no humans). Reproducibility is excellent: deterministic seeds, released code, frozen protocol file, and 59,776 posts with all votes and exposure logs on GitHub/HuggingFace. Weighted total lands near 0.74.

The experiment comprises 448 trials and 112 complete model-by-topic-by-seed blocks. Relative to a topic-only control, a feed of previous-r
papers.summary_zh: 單一代理基準無法刻畫 LLM 代理群體在平台上的遞迴行為：代理發文、互相投票，排名訊號又影響後續生成。作者提出同儕投票社交模擬測試台 PV-SST，並在預先凍結、預註冊的協定下執行匹配曝光實驗：448 個試驗、112 個完整的模型×主題×種子配對區塊，涵蓋四個主題、四個種子、四個開放權重模型家族（Qwen 3.5 4B、Gemma 4 E4B、Ministral 3 8B、Granite 4 3B）與三個較大變體。兩組對比分別檢驗同儕按讚排名的動態消息相對於僅見主題的控制組，以及四個分散式對抗來源相對於單一來源，後者對每位誠實代理的對抗曝光次數完全相同。結果顯示唯一在兩個面板都穩定複製的效應是詞彙趨同：看過排名動態消息後，最終貼文的 TF-IDF 餘弦相似度上升約 0.008–0.011（核心面板 p=0.000105）；對立陣營存活率下降僅在核心面板顯著；分散式來源在匹配曝光下對立場改變並無可靠優勢，未能滿足預註冊的一致性準則。限制包括純合成族群、實驗處理將曝光與排名、帳號數與訊息實現綁在一起、僅涵蓋開放權重模型與平台政策主題，且語意測量存在改寫洩漏、立場混淆與 LLM 評審一致性偏低的問題。其價值在於方法學示範：平台風險應分解為曝光、排名、來源數等機制並以配對設計檢驗，生成貼文應作為稽核證據而非獨立樣本。

links.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?

evidence: Abstract, p.1 and Table 2, p.9: best agent Claude Code with Opus-5(max) achieves overall Pass@1 47.90% while public score is 96.64%, supporting the test-hardness claim.
Section 3, p.4 and Figure 2(a): 119 tasks from 98 GitHub repositories across 20 domains; 52 Issue-driven, 49 Expert-exploratory, 18 Engineering-integration tasks.

Section 4, pp.6-8: four-stage construction (source screening, snapshot freezing/reproduction, information isolation, hidden oracle with counter-calibration) with hidden validators against hard-coded and pseudo-fixes.

Section 5, p.9: eight agent configurations evaluated with public/private test split; PrivateScore, Fail2Pass, Pass2Pass, Pass@1 metrics defined; private tests mounted only after patch submission in a separate evaluator container.

Section 6.2, p.11: on the 91-task separable subset, GPT-5.6-sol Pass@1 falls 36.26%→31.87% with scientific information while DeepSeek-V4-flash rises 16.48%→23.08%; authors state paired differences 'do not establish statistical significance or a causal effect.'
Table 3, p.10: failure-mechanism error counts across agents; Claude-Opus-5 has lowest categorized scientific errors (58 + 4 runtime/evaluation-path failures) and only 2 misguided-exploration errors.
Section 7, p.12: authors acknowledge limited tasks per scientific domain and that the scientific-knowledge analysis is 'relatively preliminary.'
Page 1 availability claims: code at github.com/OpenMOSS/SWE-bench-Science, data at huggingface.co/datasets/OpenMOSS-Team/SWE-bench-Science, and a public leaderboard.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A repository-level coding-agent benchmark for scientific software, squarely in-scope for LLM/agent/code preferences: it evaluates eight LLM-harness configurations (GPT-5.6-sol/Codex, Claude-Opus-5/Claude Code, DeepSeek-V4, Kimi-K3, Qwen3.5-397B, etc.) on repository repair tasks. Novelty is moderate: scientific SWE benchmarks already exist (AInstein Bench, SWE-Bench5G, SciCode; Table 1, p.3), and the differentiators are the three-paradigm taxonomy, a four-way failure-mechanism audit, and a paired scientific-information ablation. Rigor is solid on construction (four-stage pipeline, hidden oracles, anti-overfitting validators; Section 4) and internally consistent (counts sum: 52+49+18=119; domain table sums to 119), but the ablation uses only two models and the authors explicitly state results 'do not establish statistical significance or a causal effect' (Section 6.2, p.11); no inter-annotator agreement is reported for the manual failure taxonomy, and per-paradigm samples are small (18 Engineering-integration tasks). Evidence within the document is quantified and consistent (Table 2, p.9: best Pass@1 47.90%; Section 6.2: GPT-5.6-sol 36.26%→31.87% vs DeepSeek-V4-flash 16.48%→23.08% with scientific info), but key claims rest on unverifiable manual audits and a 2-model subset. Generalizability benefits from 20 domains/98 repos yet is limited by one-task domains and acknowledged model-coverage gaps (Section 7, p.12). Reproducibility is supported by released code/data/leaderboard (p.1), frozen snapshots, locked dependencies, and post-submission mounting of private tests (Section 3.1), though proprietary frontier models impede exact replication.

primary_link.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?

papers.summary: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. We introduce \textbf{SWE-bench Science}, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprisi
papers.summary_zh: 軟體已成為科學儀器的一部分,科學程式碼的缺陷可能危及科學結論的證據基礎。本文提出 SWE-bench Science,一個儲存庫層級的科學軟體工程基準,涵蓋 98 個 GitHub 儲存庫的 119 項任務、橫跨 20 個科學領域,並將任務分為 Issue-driven、Expert-exploratory 與 Engineering-integration 三種範式。每項任務皆經人工檢驗,確保科學契約、可重現性與評測有效性。實驗顯示,即使表現最佳的 Claude Code 搭配 Opus-5,Pass@1 也不到 50%(47.90%),凸顯科學軟體工程的艱鉅挑戰。作者歸納出四種反覆出現的失敗機制:科學知識或抽象能力不足、探索方向錯誤或表面修補、修補涵蓋面或系統整合不完整,以及科學知識無法泛化到未見案例。在 91 項可分離任務上進行配對消融,移除明確的科學輔助資訊後發現:科學知識並非總有助益——恰當的資訊能約束修補並提升平均分數與 token 效率,不對齊的指引反而可能造成錨定效應,未必提升精確修補成功率。此基準為研究編程代理在科學軟體工程上的能力與失敗機制,提供了廣泛的測試平台。

links.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 47.26x (FP8) and 27.19x (BF16) speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 128K context, and 30.49x over an FA3/4-aligned dense baseline on NVIDIA H20.

Section 4.1 Setup: evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 against Full Attention, MInference, FlexPrefill, XAttention, with fixed hyperparameters (B=128, 256 sink, 512 window, alpha=0.1) and stack CUDA 12.9 / PyTorch 2.9.1 / CUTLASS 4.3 / SGLang 0.5.10.

Section 3.2: the mean correction is described as 'a surrogate-contribution idea also adopted in [15]' (Sol-attn), and Section 3.3 states the kernel 'builds upon the Hopper-specific techniques established by FlashAttention-3/4', limiting methodological novelty.
Section 4.4 / Table 8: ablating mean correction costs up to 6.2 points at 128K in FP8 (83.49 vs 85.82 avg), supporting the correction term's contribution.
Table 9 (Sec 4.4): threshold sweep at 64K shows corrected FP8 stays within 2.7 points of full attention at 5.2% density, while the uncorrected variant drops 2.7-5.4 points.
Section 4.3 / Table 6: chunked prefill erodes BF16 speedup to 1.2x on Qwen3-30B at 8K chunks, an honest report of a deployment limitation.
Section 3.4 Serving Integration: 'decode falls back to dense attention, since a single query token per step leaves no room for block-level sparsity', restricting scope to prefill.

Table 3 (Sec 4.1): measured attention density falls from ~70% at 4K to ~5% at 128K on needle-in-a-haystack inputs; all operator speedups in Table 1 are measured on this workload, raising transfer concerns to non-retrieval workloads.
Header/footer: code availability claimed at https://github.com/qhfan/FlashPrefillv2; Table 4 notes TTFT averaged over 30 repeated measurements.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free block-sparse prefill attention kernel for long-context LLM serving, squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, long context, inference & serving, efficiency). Strengths: broad evaluation (3 models, RULER with 21-task LongBench, TTFT/open-loop/chunked-prefill serving experiments), multiple baselines including an FA3/4-aligned dense kernel and production HPC-BSA, ablations of the correction term and threshold, explicit overhead/error analysis, and released code with exact configs. Novelty is incremental: it extends the authors' own FlashPrefill V1, adopts the mean-correction/surrogate idea from Sol-attn, and the kernel explicitly reuses FlashAttention-3/4 execution techniques. Evidence is strong but self-reported on a single GPU type (H20) and speedups are largely measured on needle-in-a-haystack workloads whose sparsity may not transfer; decode is not accelerated. Limitations of workload and hardware dependence temper generalizability.

papers.summary: Long-context modeling is a pivotal capability for Large Language Models, yet the quadratic complexity of attention remains a critical bottleneck, particularly during the compute-intensive prefilling phase. Our previous work, FlashPrefill, mitigates this cost through instantaneous pattern discovery and max-based dynamic thresholding; however, it remains an algorithmic prototype that is still distant from production deployment. In this paper, we present FlashPrefill V2, which evolves FlashPrefill
papers.summary_zh: 長上下文建模中,注意力的二次方複雜度在計算密集的 prefill 階段尤為瓶頸。前作 FlashPrefill 雖以即時模式發現與最大值動態門檻降低成本,但仍屬演算法原型。本文提出 FlashPrefill V2,沿三個方向邁向實用部署:其一,引入均值修正項,以被剪枝區塊的池化 K/V 統計量補償近似誤差,即使在極端稀疏下也能控制精度退化;其二,重新設計稀疏注意力核心,採用 PackGQA 記憶體存取、warp 特化與乒乓流水線,全面對齊 FlashAttention-3/4,並支援 FP8 推論;其三,原生支援分頁 KV 快取與連續批次,可作為注意力後端整合至 SGLang 等現代推論框架。在 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上的評測顯示,於 128K 上下文長度下,FP8 精度相較 FlashAttention-2 加速達 47.26 倍,BF16 達 27.19 倍;相較 FA3/4 對齊的稠密基準,FP8 仍有 30.49 倍加速。端對端服務實驗中,128K 下 TTFT 最多降低 4.8 倍且精度損失有限;消融實驗亦證實均值修正對 FP8 尤其關鍵。此工作將稀疏注意力從演算法探索推向實際長上下文服務。
