evidence: Sec. VI-A / Table II: proposed CNP attains TCR_TC=0.902±0.009, above all 15 baselines (best GA 0.838; Holm p<0.001; Cliff's δ −0.57 to −0.96) at 0.874 of the CP-SAT upper bound.

Sec. VI-B / Table III: windowed TC-EDF+EFT list scheduler at W=40 reaches 0.896 vs full auction 0.902 within CIs; batching horizon (0.795→0.942 as W:1→200) and TC-first ordering, not the auction or any learned component, explain the advantage; UCB1 bandit matches static auction (0.901, p=0.465).

Sec. VI-C / Table IV: under mid-run surge, CNP-LLM +0.0053 (p=0.004) and HAS +0.0060 (p=0.005) beat static heuristic while CNP-bandit does not (p=0.571); no significant gains under outage (p=0.313/0.916).

Sec. VI-D: 27 schema-constrained calls at mean 3.0 s latency (median 2.8 s, p95 4.3 s), confirming the LLM cannot sit on the per-task critical path; monitor rationale logged and audited at one of two review points.
Sec. V: 60 instances (20 seeds × three topologies), identical online constraint for all baselines, Claude Haiku with structured outputs and caching; Appendix A gives PSO/GA/DDQN hyperparameters.

Sec. VI-E (Threats to Validity): simulator with deterministic channels, single workload size, small disruption benefit shown for one surge model, single lightweight LLM; model-scale and sampling-variance study deferred to future work.
Sec. I footnote: code and seeded instances released at https://github.com/rezarz98/multi-agents-llm-edge-scheduling.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM multi-agent orchestration study (LLM 2.5x, Agents 2.5x) applied to edge task scheduling; not a pure domain application because the central research question is when LLM control planes add value, tested against matched non-LLM controls. Rigor is strong: 15 baselines under one shared online engine, 60 seeded instances across three topologies, paired Wilcoxon with Holm correction and Cliff's delta, a CP-SAT upper bound, and an honest factorial decomposition showing the auction/LLM add nothing under stationary load (Sec. VI-B) with a small but significant surge gain (+0.0053, p=0.004; Sec. VI-C). Evidence is quantified and appropriately hedged, including control-plane latency (3.0 s mean, Sec. VI-D) and a threats-to-validity section. Deductions: simulator-only with deterministic channels, single workload size and a single lightweight model (Claude Haiku, one cached sample per decision), effect size modest and tied to one surge model, limiting generalizability; novelty is moderate since the scheduler is deliberately standard (contract-net + TC-EDF + EFT) and the LLM-for-scheduling idea exists in prior work, though the controlled conditional evaluation is a genuine contribution. Code and seeded instances are released.

primary_link.title: When Do LLM Agents Help? Deadline-Aware Mixed-Criticality Task Scheduling at the Autonomous-Vehicle Edge

papers.summary: Autonomous vehicles offload latency-sensitive perception tasks to nearby mobile edge computing (MEC) servers, where a missed safety-critical task is unsafe rather than merely degraded. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as adaptive, explainable schedulers, yet evidence of when they help is scarce. We study deadline-aware, mixed-criticality scheduling on heterogeneous MEC servers, where time-critical (TC) tasks must be protected at a controlled cost to best-effort traffic, and
papers.summary_zh: 自駕車將延遲敏感的感知任務卸載至附近的行動邊緣運算(MEC)伺服器,錯過安全關鍵任務不只是效能下降,而是危險。本文探討大型語言模型(LLM)多代理控制層能否在期限感知的混合關鍵性排程上勝過強啟發式方法。作者分兩步:先建立「視窗化合約網拍賣」資料平面,按時間關鍵(TC)優先與最早截止時間排序,以最早完成時間(EFT)指派異質伺服器;再新增由 broker、edge、monitor 三類 LLM 代理組成的輕量控制平面,每個視窗設定一次策略。在 60 個實例、三種拓撲、15 個基準的相同線上限制下,啟發式達到 0.902 的 TC 完成率(最佳基準 0.838),為 CP-SAT 上界的 0.87。受控分解顯示優勢主要來自批次視窗與 TC 優先排序,拍賣機制與 LLM 在平穩負載下皆無增益。但當行程中段湧現安全關鍵任務浪潮時,LLM 控制平面顯著優於靜態啟發式與 bandit(+0.005,p=0.004),且代理理由記錄可檢驗。限制包括模擬器環境、確定性通道、增益幅度小、使用輕量模型與單一負載規模。結論:LLM 編排只有在非平穩性開啟固定策略無法利用的空間時,才值得其成本。

Sec. 3.2: decoupled estimator - baseline from on-policy rewards only (Eqn. 6 inversion band), directional gain g_q (Eqn. 7), detached oracle advantage A_gt (Eqn. 9-10).

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal RL post-training methodology (not pure CV/diffusion): GRPO-style RL for video MLLMs with a new 'annotation-as-rollout' mechanism. Preference relevance is moderate: strong matches to Reinforcement Learning, Multimodal AI, Training & Optimization, Scaling & Efficiency, and partial CoT engagement (answer-only vs CoT ablation), but no coverage of the highest-weight topics (text-only LLMs, Japanese NLP, agents). Novelty is solid though incremental relative to LUFFY-style off-policy guidance and the authors' own Tempsamp-R1 reward shaping: the decoupled oracle-free baseline, detached oracle advantage, and sign-balanced pruning with moment correction are new and coherent. Rigor is a highlight: matched initialization/data/budget comparisons (Tab. 12-13), a large-scale advantage-inversion analysis over 92,024 rollouts (Tab. 14), per-component ablations (Tab. 15), pruning trade-offs (Tab. 16), scaling and two-backbone checks (Tab. 10, Fig. 4-5). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, though headline VSI-Bench 73.1 vs GPT-5 55.0 comparisons mix specialist post-training against general models and are answer-only. primary_link.title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become a prevailing paradigm for unified video perception. However, post-training on large multi-task datasets remains challenging, as existing reinforcement learning methods sample on-policy groups with few high-quality rollouts even with costly chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. In this paper, we study the sample efficiency and scalability of RL post-training for video MLLMs and introduce OraRL. We identify an overlooked role for annotations: Beyon
papers.summary_zh: 影片多模態大型語言模型(MLLM)的後訓練長期受樣本效率瓶頸限制:現有 RL 方法(如 GRPO)在 on-policy 群組中常缺少能命中精確區間、框或遮罩的高品質 rollout,chain-of-thought 又拖慢訓練與推論。OraRL 提出「標註即 rollout」原則:把每個標註序列化成模型回應格式,作為 oracle rollout 加入 on-policy 群組,提供可靠的正向目標。但直接混合會造成 advantage inversion——高獎勵 oracle 抬高群組基線,使本應受強化的正優勢 rollout 反被懲罰。OraRL 以解耦優勢估計器解決:基線只由 on-policy 獎勵決定,oracle-policy 差距則透過方向增益與分離的 detached oracle 優勢兩項編碼;配合符號平衡剪枝與動量校正,步階時間僅為 SFT 的 2.2 倍,低於 GRPO+CoT 的 4.9 倍。Video-ORA-9B 在七個任務家族全面領先:時間定位 mIoU 66.0、追蹤 AO 78.2、分割 70.4、空間智慧宏平均 56.1,VSI-Bench 得分 73.1 遠超 GPT-5 的 55.0;且無 CoT 時解碼僅 130 毫秒。成果從 0.8B 到 9B、資料預算至 100k 提示皆持續擴展,並跨兩種骨幹驗證。限制在於假設標註可序列化為有效 oracle,未評估含雜訊或部分監督,複雜空間推理仍遜於部分專有模型。此工作確立標註即 rollout 為統一影片感知的高效率 RL 原則。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM-methodology work: latent KV-cache communication between frozen LLM agents, touching high-weight preferences (LLMs, multi-agent systems, inference/efficiency, KV-cache memory). The contribution is a meaningful but incremental advance over C2C/LCF-X (dual-cache receiver-aware pooling, cross-layer joint memory, heterogeneous depth/head-geometry support), and ablations show each component matters. Rigor is decent: full 3x3 sharer-receiver grid over 5 datasets, two baselines, per-component ablations, and an appendix that recomputes aggregate claims from per-cell tables (internally consistent on check). Confidence is tempered by: tiny models only (0.6B-3B) with scaling deferred to future work, single-run experiments with no variance or significance reporting, a self-authored heterogeneous LCF-X baseline, cell-level instability where ablated variants beat the full model by up to ~6.6 F1 (undiscussed), a synthetic evidence-partition setting rather than real agent workloads, and no code release. Solid, well-documented engineering paper with a genuine efficiency result (10.3x faster translator, 76% fewer params, 6.8x faster E2E than text) but limited generalization evidence.

primary_link.title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models

papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems split work across models, so answering often requires knowledge that sits in another agent's context: a Sharer has encoded information that a Receiver needs to complete its task. They usually communicate by exchanging text, which puts autoregressive decoding on the critical path and reduces the exchange to a discrete message written without sight of the receiver's state. Recent latent protocols instead translate the sharer's key-value (KV) cache into the receiver's: C2C s
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統中,一個代理常需要另一代理已編碼的證據,但部署系統幾乎都以文字交換,使自迴歸解碼落在關鍵路徑上。潛在協定可將 sharer 的 KV 快取轉譯進 receiver,然而 LCF-X 等方法僅壓縮 sharer、對每個 receiver 位置供應相同的層內單一摘要,且假設層數與 KV 幾何相符。XKV 提出雙快取轉譯器以三個元件突破:學習查詢注意力同時池化兩個快取;對 receiver 對齊的層 token 做自我注意力,以學習層映射調和不同深度,混合成緊湊的聯合記憶;共享位置解碼器讓每個原始 receiver 快取位置檢索自己的逐頭門控殘差,寫入 receiver 原生 KV 幾何。兩個模型皆凍結,可在家族、深度、KV 頭數、頭維度與 tokenizer 上不同,僅訓練轉譯器。在五個分割證據任務、九個 ordered 模型配對共 45 個設定中,XKV 取得最高宏觀分數(52.4,優於 LCF-X 的 49.8 與文字通訊的 48.9),在每個資料集都勝過 LCF-X;轉譯器快 10.3 倍(5.8 對 59.9 毫秒)、可訓練參數少 76%,端對端比 LCF-X 快 26%、比文字通訊快 6.8 倍。消融證實 receiver 感知元件以極小成本提升品質。限制包括使用 0.6B–3B 小型模型與單次更新,未來需擴展至更大模型、多輪多代理通訊與訊息內容解讀。
papers.title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models

links.title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Slot-Selective Evidence Masking Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies

evidence: Abstract: 'Restricted-visibility societies outperform their globally visible twins by at least 20 percentage points at both depths in 9 of 10 pairs, with median paired advantages of 0.7648 and 0.6050.'

Section 3: 'A society comprises four cells and one readout. All cells share a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct backbone and one rank-8 LoRA... there are no cell-specific parameters or learned cell identities.'
Table 1 (Section 5.1): gate 'Restricted median depth three >= 0.70' result '0.6988 — fail'; 'Complete preregistered conjunction — fail'.

Section 6: 'same-value transplant accuracy is 0.94–1.00 across all tested interfaces... Counterfactual transplants redirect outputs toward the mathematically predicted answer, with fidelity ranging from 0.74 to 1.00'.
Section 5.3: 'On map-novel depth-three programs, the median paired advantage remains +0.558, compared with +0.634 on the map-redundant stratum.'

Section 7 (Role-cue limitation): 'the mask jointly changes foreign-evidence access, role disambiguation, and active-context load. The present comparison therefore identifies the effect of the complete masking regime'.
Appendix B Table 5: audited models span six restricted societies plus G:m204:o954 whose 'same-value 0.12–0.25' differs sharply from restricted models.

Appendix E: released package includes '19 of the 20 society final checkpoints... all evaluation, stratification, and audit JSON records; the audit and evaluation scripts; the preregistration and protocol-history documents; and the incident ledger' with GitHub/HuggingFace URLs.

Appendix F: 'family-A packet states remain perfectly transportable and causally steering in the family-D context (same-value preservation 1.000...)' while 'the preregistered initialization-benefit criterion failed in both checkpoints'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM research: a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B backbone with shared LoRA underlies a four-cell multi-module 'society' whose only inter-cell pathway is learned latent packets, audited with causal-abstraction-style interchange interventions. Strong alignment with high-weight preferences (LLMs, multi-agent latent communication, interpretability) and moderate alignment with reasoning/compositional generalization, though the 0.5B scale and synthetic Z_17 arithmetic task temper topical fit. Novelty is real but compositional: visibility masking exists (CoFlow, Béna & Goodman), causal interchange tests exist (Geiger et al.); the contribution is the tightly matched conjunction, honestly positioned in §2/§7. Rigor is exceptional: preregistered gates with a formally reported failure (restricted depth-three median 0.6988 vs 0.70 floor, Table 1), byte-identical initializations and training streams, bit-exact machine gates, all-cut/noise/shuffle controls, post hoc analyses explicitly labeled. Evidence for the paired masking effect is strong (9/10 pairs ≥20pp, medians 0.7648/0.6050, Table 2) and survives collision stratification (+0.558, §5.3), but rests on only five independent initializations (sign-flip p=0.0625 is the attainable floor), one global counterexample showing restriction is not necessary, and mechanism claims conditioned on correct answers across six post hoc-selected models. Generalizability is explicitly narrow (§7): one architecture, one templated task world, fixed budget; the Appendix F scout shows packet-code portability but zero-shot transfer failure and no initialization benefit. Reproducibility is excellent: deterministic settings, released checkpoints (19/20, one disclosed missing), audit JSONs, scripts, preregistration and incident ledger via GitHub/HuggingFace (Appendix E).
topics: attention masking as training-time inductive bias

primary_link.title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Slot-Selective Evidence Masking Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies

papers.summary: Multi-module neural systems often expose every module to the full input. We test whether a slot-selective evidence-masking regime -- restricting each module to its own evidence span -- changes which solutions gradient-based training discovers. Four-cell societies share one frozen pretrained language model and one low-rank adapter, communicating only through two model-width continuous vectors in a fixed relay. On a prospectively sealed natural-language function-composition task, we train ten matc
papers.summary_zh: 多模組神經系統通常讓每個模組看到完整輸入,使整體程式查表成為可用的捷徑解。本文測試槽位選擇性證據遮蔽——限制每個模組只能讀取自身證據區段——是否改變梯度訓練找到的解。四細胞社會共享一個凍結的 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 與一個 rank-8 LoRA,僅以兩個 896 維連續向量在固定接力中溝通,任務為 ℤ17 上的自然語言函數組合。十對配對的受限/全域雙胞胎共享初始化位元組、訓練順序、token 佈局與計算預算,僅注意力遮蔽不同,並採用預註冊門檻、密封任務與位元級機器驗證。結果:受限社會在 10 對中 9 對於兩個深度都至少領先 20 個百分點,中位配對優勢為 0.7648 與 0.6050;切斷所有封包使受限社會降到隨機;碰撞分層分析中,映射新穎程式上的深度三優勢仍為 0.558。機制檢驗顯示,六個受審計的受限社會中,同值封包移植在 0.94–1.00 保留行為,反事實封包能將輸出導向數學預測答案;唯一高效能的全域模型(0.843)其封包卻不可跨情境互換,遮蔽交叉測試亦顯示兩臂都學到「遮蔽原生」的解。限制:完整預註冊電池因受限臂深度三中位 0.6988 低於 0.70 門檻而正式失敗;遮蔽同時改變角色提示與情境負載,歸因待角色標記對照;全域可見性並非組合的必要條件。整體而言,資訊可用性會強烈改變訓練找到的解及其形態。

papers.title_zh: 看不到的才是學到的:槽位選擇性證據遮蔽促成共享基因體語言模型社會的組合泛化

links.title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: method improves strongest latent-reasoning baseline by +9.5% on FrozenLake (widening to +19% at 32x32) and +5.2% average across nine visual-centric reasoning benchmarks

Section 3.2 (Eqs. 3-4): scaffolding encoder trained end-to-end via frozen base VLM's task CE loss, then VLM fine-tuned with L2 latent matching plus task loss; helper image and encoder discarded at inference

Section 3.3 and Appendix B (Eqs. 5-8): Scaffolding RL samples residual latent actions from a learned input-adaptive Gaussian and evaluates the same sampled action under current and old policies in a GRPO-style clipped objective, contrasted with VLPO's fixed-variance deterministic regularization (Eq. 2)

Section 4.3 (Figure 7): Stage-1 ablation isolates factors — task-loss objective with attention pooling +4.3%, additionally tuning the vision encoder +10.0%, totaling +14.3% over Mean Pooling (No Opt.)
Section 4.3 (Figure 2): RL comparison — No Sampling +0.6%, VLPO +1.8% (fluctuating), Scaffolding RL +3.0%; worst RL with scaffolding encoder still beats best RL without it
Table 1: Scaffolding Encoder+RL avg 75.0±0.3 vs VaLR 65.5 and SFT 52.0, with per-level results at Levels 8/16/24/32
Table 2: Scaffolding Encoder+RL avg 73.9±0.3 across nine benchmarks vs VaLR 68.7 and Vanilla SFT 63.5; best on CVBench, HRBench-4K, HRBench-8K
Appendix C.1: full training details — AdamW lr 2e-5/5e-5, batch 32, GRPO group G=8, clip 0.2, beta_KL 0.001, 8x A100, ~10 hours per configuration, 100 held-out test examples per level
Table 6: gains preserved at 3B scale (+17.0% over 3B SFT, +5.5% over strongest latent baseline) and under LoRA r=32 (+17.0% over LoRA SFT)
Table 7: inference latency 272 ms, +4.6% over 260 ms Qwen2.5-VL-7B base; image-generation baselines incur >3x latency
Appendix A Limitations: approach requires an intermediate helper image at training; alternative helper-image designs not exhaustively searched
Table 2 footnote: Mirage fully re-implemented (‡) and parts of VaLR re-implemented, introducing potential baseline-number uncertainty
llm_evaluation.rationale: Multimodal latent-reasoning methods paper squarely in high-weight preference zones (Reasoning/CoT 2.5, LLM/foundation-model 2.5, Multimodal 1.8, RL 1.5); it has genuine language-model methodology (latent CoT tokens, GRPO) and is not pure CV/diffusion, so no out-of-scope cap. Novelty is moderate: it is a credible but incremental delta on an established two-stage latent-reasoning paradigm — (1) learning the target encoder end-to-end instead of a frozen vision encoder, (2) replacing VLPO's deterministic fixed-variance Gaussian with a learned input-adaptive sampler over residual latent actions (Sec. 3.2-3.3, Appendix B). Rigor is good: factor-isolating ablations (Fig. 7: objective swap +4.3%, tuned VE +10.0%; RL comparison: Scaffolding RL +3.0% vs VLPO +1.8% vs no-sampling +0.6%), K sweep, loss-weight sweep, helper-image 2x2, 3B/LoRA variants, seed std devs, and a limitations section admitting dependence on training-time helper images. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 1: 75.0 vs VaLR 65.5 = +9.5; Table 2: 73.9 vs 68.7 = +5.2) and includes latency (Table 7: +4.6% overhead). Weaknesses: single backbone family (Qwen2.5-VL), several baselines self-reproduced (‡) without baseline variance, gains concentrated on spatial/fine-grained tasks, no explicit code release statement. Reproducibility supported by full hyperparameters, data construction (Appendix C/D incl. value-iteration code), and compute budget (8x A100, ~10 hrs).

primary_link.title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning

papers.summary: Latent reasoning has advanced multimodal reasoning through a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a helper image is encoded into latent tokens to teach visual chain-of-thought during a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, and (2) these latent tokens are further refined with reward feedback during a reinforcement learning (RL) stage. In this paper, we identify two key limitations of this framework, one in each stage. First, the SFT stage typically relies on an off-the-shelf vision encoder to encode th
papers.summary_zh: 潛在視覺推理讓視覺語言模型能在思考鏈中插入連續的潛在視覺 token，現行作法採兩階段訓練：先於 SFT 階段以現成視覺編碼器將輔助影像編碼為潛在目標，再於 RL 階段以強化學習精煉。本文指出兩大限制：其一，凍結的通用編碼器未針對下游推理任務最佳化，潛在表示次佳；其二，既有 RL 方法僅以確定性正則化約束潛在分量，無法取樣替代潛在軌跡進行探索。作者提出 Scaffolding Minds：第一階段學習專屬的 scaffolding encoder，透過凍結基礎 VLM 的任務損失端對端訓練出最佳化潛在目標，再訓練 VLM 單憑輸入預測該目標；第二階段引入 Scaffolding RL，以兩個 MLP 頭學習高斯取樣器的平均值與變異數，於推論時取樣殘差潛在動作，使獎勵訊號能直接最佳化潛在空間探索。實驗以 Qwen2.5-VL 為骨幹：FrozenLake 空間規劃較最強潛在基準平均提升 9.5%，於 32×32 網格擴大至 19%；九項視覺推理基準平均提升 5.2%，推論延遲僅增約 4.6%。消融實驗顯示目標最佳化貢獻主要增益，且兩階段互補。限制為訓練仍需輔助影像，且未系統性搜尋其設計。本研究證明潛在目標品質與潛在空間的直接探索皆為潛在視覺推理成功的關鍵。

links.title: InsufficiencyBench: Evaluating LLM legal advice on underspecified user queries

evidence: Abstract: 202 benchmark items (58 base queries, 144 deficient variants), six legal domains, 24 US jurisdictions, annotated by practising attorneys; no model exceeds F2=0.46, median recall 0.44.
Section 3.3/3.4: taxonomy of eight canonical categories across switch/gating/fatal-prerequisite failure modes; 541 annotated material elements (96% required), 335 distinct sub-tags.
Section 4 and Fig. 2(a): GPT-5.2 leads (F2=0.455, recall=0.666); DeepSeek-V4-Pro trails (F2=0.278); fixed minimal system prompt across all models; GPT-5 as fixed judge.

Appendix D: re-scoring all 10x202 responses with Claude-Haiku-4.5 and GLM-5 keeps max F2 below 0.46; per-item Pearson r=0.54-0.76 with GPT-5 judge; judge agreement not validated against human scoring (Section 5 limitations).
Section 5 (limitations): dataset limited in size (202 items), single-turn setting only, moderate LLM-judge agreement.
Appendix A/B/C: full judge prompt templates, per-model configurations (vendor IDs, temperatures, reasoning effort, max_tokens=32768), and raw per-model scores for reproducibility.
Dataset availability: https://huggingface.co/tri-fair-lab/insufficient_queries (abstract); footnote 1 states data and code will be released on acceptance.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation work with strong preference fit: evaluates ten frontier LLMs (Section 4), contributes an abstention/clarification benchmark (Red Teaming & Evaluation, AI Safety, Prompting relevance), and studies calibration of hedging behavior rather than a pure legal domain application. Novelty is solid: first benchmark targeting query-side insufficiency with a legally grounded eight-category taxonomy and three structural failure modes (Section 3.3), though it builds on adjacent abstention/clarification work (AbstentionBench, CLAMBER, QuestBench). Rigor is decent but capped: controlled variant construction with known ground truth, metric decomposition (hedge rate vs F2|Hedge), and judge-robustness checks (Appendix D) are strengths; weaknesses are a small dataset (202 items), annotation by only two attorneys without reported inter-annotator agreement, an LLM judge not validated against human scoring, and single-turn-only evaluation (Section 5 limitations). Evidence is internally consistent: Table 4 raw scores match headline claims (max F2 0.455, median recall ~0.44), and alternative judges preserve the difficulty conclusion (Appendix D, r=0.54-0.76). Generalizability is limited to US common-law, English, six domains. Reproducibility is good: public dataset link, full judge prompts (Appendix A), per-model configs (Appendix B), raw scores (Appendix C), though code release is deferred to acceptance (footnote 1).

primary_link.title: InsufficiencyBench: Evaluating LLM legal advice on underspecified user queries

papers.summary: Legal AI systems are increasingly used to answer legal questions, yet existing benchmarks assume queries arrive fully specified. In practice, users omit facts that materially determine the legal outcome. We introduce InsufficiencyBench, the first legal benchmark targeting query-side insufficiency: whether a model recognizes when a query lacks legally material information, identifies what is missing, and refrains from premature conclusions. We formalize a taxonomy of eight canonical missing-eleme
papers.summary_zh: 法律 AI 系統日益被用於回答法律問題，但現有基準假設查詢資訊完整。實務上，使用者常遺漏足以左右法律結果的關鍵事實，導致模型「過早法律結案」：默默代入假設後流暢作答，對使用者的實際案情可能完全錯誤。本文提出 InsufficiencyBench，首個針對查詢端資訊不足的法律評測基準。作者建立八大缺失要素分類（司法管轄、控制法源、程序姿態、當事人與身分、侵害事實、時效、約因、使用者目標），並歸納三種結構性失效模式：switch 決定適用法律框架、gating 決定框架是否適用、fatal prerequisite 為框架內必要前提。資料集含 58 個完整基準查詢與 144 個刻意移除要素的缺陷變體，共 202 個項目，涵蓋六個法律領域與 24 個美國司法管轄區，由執業律師逐句標註。評測指標含要素識別 F2、解釋正確性、安全率與過度警示率。對十個前沿模型的評測顯示：無任何模型 F2 超過 0.46，中位召回率僅 0.44；模型要不過度迴避，要不在未言明假設下直接作答；程序姿態類要素最易被忽略（平均召回 0.09），控制法源相對最佳（0.64）。限制包括資料集規模有限、單輪對話設定與 LLM 評審未經人工驗證。此基準凸顯安全的法律助理須先判斷查詢能否被安全回答，再進行推理。

links.title: Hear2Act: Benchmarking When Prosody Should Change What an Assistant Does

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 3: under Prosody-mediated feedback, transcript→audio+transcript changes average 1st% only 14.6→15.3, while audio-inferred state reaches 39.6 and ground-truth state 40.7.

Section 4.3: scenario is the statistical unit with paired scenario-level bootstrap 95% CIs (2,000 resamples); Table 9 reports e.g. text-LLM state-access effect +36.7 [+34.3, +38.9] under Prosody-mediated feedback.

Section 5.3 / Figure 4: label-fidelity interventions show ask shares of 44–45% across conditions but 1st% of 35.4–53.3% vs 68.1% with correct state, showing gains require correct turn-specific labels, not more questioning.

Appendix E / Tables 10-11: two annotators validate 100 clips per renderer (human accuracy 0.92, kappa 0.96/0.90); Qwen2.5-Omni recovers intended concern status at 0.85 (Qwen3-TTS) and 0.76 (VoxCPM2), supporting the perception-action gap interpretation.
Table 2: 480 scenarios across 48 SGD-seeded domains, 11 candidates each, 54,240 total evaluation rollouts; Appendix F states pretrained models only with no training or hyperparameter search.

Limitations: isolates one prosodic function (whether a recommendation remains unresolved), uses synthetic speech from structured states, and the inferred-state condition 'adds both an explicit representation and an additional inference step, so it establishes that the intervention is sufficient without isolating the mechanism'; no explicit benchmark or code release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent evaluation paper: audio-capable LLMs (Qwen2.5-Omni, Qwen2-Audio) and five text LLMs are benchmarked on multi-turn task-oriented dialogue decisions, matching LLM/agent/evaluation preferences, though the prosody/spoken-dialogue focus is peripheral to core LLM interests and not Japanese NLP. Methodology is strong: a controlled benchmark (480 scenarios, 54,240 rollouts per Table 2) with matched paired rollouts, five access conditions, SER baselines, label-fidelity interventions, two speech renderers, and scenario-level paired bootstrap CIs. The central finding—raw audio adds little (14.6→15.3% 1st%) but an explicit audio-inferred textual state recovers most of the ground-truth-state gain (39.6 vs 40.7%)—is well supported with confidence intervals and intervention controls ruling out a mere asking-more explanation. Novelty is moderate-to-good: it is the first protocol to trace prosodic evidence through multi-turn task decisions to verifiable outcomes, but the perception-action gap echoes prior work (LISTEN, ParaBridge) and the user engine is a deterministic simulator. Generalizability is limited by one prosodic function, synthetic speech, and a fixed three-layer concern structure; reproducibility suffers from no explicit code/data release claim despite detailed prompt cards. Weighted score 0.70.

primary_link.title: Hear2Act: Benchmarking When Prosody Should Change What an Assistant Does

Yet existing benchmarks typically evaluate prosodic perception, response appropriateness, and task-oriented dialogue in isolation, making it difficult to test whether prosodic evidence changes downstream decisions. We introduce Hear2Act, a unified evaluation protocol for text and spoken assistants with 480 persona-grounded scenari
papers.summary_zh: 在任務型對話中，使用者韻律可能傳達任務相關資訊：猶豫的「好，可以」或代表疑慮未解，語氣輕快的同句則代表真心接受。然而現有基準多將韻律感知、回應適切性與任務型對話分開評估，難以檢驗韻律證據是否改變下游決策。本文提出 Hear2Act 統一評測協定，含 480 個以角色為基礎的情境、隱藏的使用者顧慮與可客觀驗證的結果。每個情境固定任務與使用者需求，僅變化顧慮以文字明說或主要由韻律傳達，並在逐字稿、音訊與顧慮狀態等存取條件下比較配對推演。結果顯示：在韻律中介回饋下，將音訊加入逐字稿僅使兩個音訊 LLM 的平均最佳解率從 14.6% 升至 15.3%；但當模型先從音訊推論顧慮狀態、以文字表示再用於行動選擇時，最佳解率升至 39.6%，接近真值狀態的 40.7%；在顧慮已明說於文字的條件下，此對比幾乎消失。給予五個文字 LLM 真值狀態時，韻律中介條件平均提升 36.7 個百分點，明示條件僅 6.4。正確顧慮資訊亦促使模型先蒐集資訊，並將過早停於次佳選項的比率從 69.7% 降至 26.7%。限制在於僅隔離單一韻律功能、語音為合成，且音訊推論狀態同時引入顯式表示與額外推論步驟。本研究揭示音訊 LLM 存在明顯的感知—行動落差，需顯式中間表示才能將語音資訊轉化為行動。
papers.title: Hear2Act: Benchmarking When Prosody Should Change What an Assistant Does
papers.title_zh: Hear2Act：評估韻律應於何時改變助理的行動

llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems/evaluation-methodology paper squarely in the Agents & Tool Use and LLM-evaluation space: it evaluates LLM agent skills (SKILL.md packages) via paired with-skill/baseline live runs across harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Terminus-2), using LLM-as-Judge, behavior checks, MCP declarations, and CI-native deployment. Preference relevance is high but not maximal because the paper contributes evaluation infrastructure rather than LLM modeling or reasoning methodology. Novelty is moderate: paired differential measurement ('Skill Lift'), reference decoys, and the isolation-vs-group 'routing premium' decomposition are sensible and somewhat new compositions in the nascent skill-evaluation niche, but differential tool evaluation, G-Eval judging, and RAGAS goal accuracy are established building blocks, and the paper itself positions against SkillsBench, SkillTester, and related 2026 work (Table 3, §8). Rigor is above average for a systems paper: paired design with fixed supports, cluster bootstraps ([0.1898,0.2350] over skills; [0.1880,0.2385] over cells, §6.3), an imputation sensitivity check showing composite lift falls from 0.2153 to 0.1840 but stays positive (Appendix B), judge-model sensitivity analysis (§2.2), and honest causal/scope caveats (§7). Evidence strength is good: 947 scored paired cases, 2,022 trajectories, 11,642 tool calls, per-metric decompositions (§6.4), and static-live decorrelation (Tier 1 ρ=-0.0181, Tier 2 ρ=-0.0266, §6.7), though key corpora are internal/anonymized, the OpenClaw sanitization case is n=1, and some claims (e.g., refinement lowers judge variance, §4.2) lack quantitative support. Generalizability is limited by a corpus skewed to System Access/Deployment/Platform categories, uneven harness coverage, and enterprise-only endpoints (§7). Reproducibility is partial: the Apache-2.0 SkillEvaluator implementation is open (§1, §9), but raw trajectories and skill identifiers are withheld (§6.2).

primary_link.title: Evaluating Skills, Not Just Agents: Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills

papers.summary:
Enterprise agent programs are moving from prototypes into production, where reusable skills, tools, and workflow packages must be reviewed with evidence rather than prose. Current gates often scan these artifacts for structure, style, and security, but they do not answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete enterprise tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy?
  We present ACES (Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills), a repository-native
papers.summary_zh: 企業代理人計畫正從原型走向生產環境，可重複使用的技能、工具與工作流程套件需以證據而非文字描述審查。現行門檻多僅掃描文件的結構、風格與安全性，無法回答關鍵問題：該能力套件能否幫助線上代理人在相同模型、沙箱與評分政策下完成企業任務。本文提出 ACES，一套以儲存庫為本的方法框架，將技能視為可執行的代理人成品評估：對每個技能執行成對線上實驗，在有技能與基線（目標技能被隱藏，預備與干擾技能固定）兩條件下執行相同任務，將軌跡正規化為 ATIF 格式，計算六項預設執行期指標，並報告 Skill Lift——目標技能在固定任務、測試框架與評分器下的邊際價值；另以隔離與群組模式分解內容與路由貢獻。在來自內部企業儲存庫與公開目錄的 145 個真實技能上，掃描類門檻雖能找出撰寫問題，但兩種掃描分數的 Spearman 相關僅 0.14，且與線上 Skill Lift 幾乎零相關（約 −0.02）。在 64 個生產技能中的 58 個、四個主要測試框架的 947 個配對案例上，平均複合 Skill Lift 為 0.2134（95% CI [0.1967, 0.2301]），結果面僅 0.1799，複合提升為正的案例占 72.8%；最大增益出現在技能執行、行為檢查與技能效率，反映文件掃描無法觀察的發現、路由與工作流程遵循；87 個負向案例成為除錯訊號。限制包括語料偏向特定類別、覆蓋不均與評審模型敏感度。此方法讓技能評估如同測試套件，可納入 CI/CD 持續審查。

links.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference

evidence: Section I-B / Table I: pre-registered five-task bar of 42.2 fixed before training; Peer-135M at 51.2 explicitly conceded.
Table V (Section VII-A): hybrid val_bpb 0.910398 vs dense twin 0.917774 (0.81% win, clearing the pre-set 0.5% floor); five-task 44.68 vs 44.82 with per-task swaps described as noise.
Table VII (Section VII-C): decode 739.3±35.5 vs 420.3±5.5 tok/s at depth 2048 (1.76×) with alternating passes; advantage near unity (1.20×) at depth 0, matching the mechanism.
Table VIII (Section VII-D): 2.08× at depth 2048 vs external Peer-135M, argued to rule out training/export artefacts.

Table II (Section IV): first-order bandwidth model predicts 1.17× vs measured 1.76×; authors reject a bandwidth-only explanation and attribute the residual to latency-bound softmax traversal and per-layer fixed costs.

Table IX/X: Daedalus 47.31 vs re-scored Pythia-160M 41.0, GPT-neo-125M 41.9, OPT-125M 42.1, GPT-2 42.2; WinoGrande at 50.04 vs 50.0 chance floor acknowledged; but MobileLLM-125M 46.3 is quoted as published, inconsistent with the Section XI-A harness-comparability argument.

Section IX-C: quantisation-aware training produced non-finite loss on first step and was abandoned; released model carries ~6% perplexity penalty (9.18 fp16 vs 9.75 Q4_0) instead of the 2.5% at 5B tokens.

Section X: 47.9% of convolution channels inert (stable across steps 9,896-30,041); structural pruning rejected by runtime shape check, with a rebuilt full-width control file loading correctly, isolating the cause.
Section IX-E: single seed, English-only, decode advantage not extrapolated beyond the trained 2048-token context.

Section XIV: all numbers claimed to come from public repository files; weights published at half precision and 4-bit; corpus assembled from public datasets; 1× RTX 5090 hardware (Table IV) is reproducible at small scale.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope small-language-model architecture/efficiency work: a 160M-parameter conv-attention hybrid (12 depthwise short-conv blocks, 6 GQA attention blocks) trained from scratch on 59.9B tokens and evaluated for batch-size-one 4-bit CPU decoding, matching the curator's LLM, transformer-architecture, efficiency, and inference/serving preferences; it is not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself states 'The contribution is not a new operator' (Section II); hybrids with minority attention layers are established (Griffin, RWKV cited), so the contribution is a regime-specific layer-ratio argument plus a matched ablation. Rigor is unusually high for a solo effort: pre-registered bar (42.2) and ablation decision rule (Section I-B, VII), parameter-matched twin trained on identical data/schedule, peers re-scored on one harness (Section XI-A), alternating decode passes to control background load (Section VII-C), and honest reporting of failures (QAT non-finite loss, mixture drift 10.42 over the 10.0 limit, optimizer-state reset). Deductions: single seed conceded in Section IX-E; the ablation runs only 5B tokens while the headline is 59.9B; Table IX quotes MobileLLM-125M's published 46.3, which contradicts the paper's own Section XI-A warning that mixing local and published harness numbers manufactures ~1 point of spurious advantage; absolute throughputs are measured on a shared machine. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Tables II, V, VII, VIII with error bars; the 1.17x predicted vs 1.76x measured gap is analyzed rather than hidden; the dead-channel pruning claim includes a rebuilt full-width control file, Section X), but all results are self-reported and pre-registration is self-attested. Generalizability is deliberately narrow: the advantage is near zero at empty context (Table VII) and measured only to the trained 2048-token context (Section IX-E), English-only. Reproducibility is strong on paper (weights at half precision and 4-bit, public corpus, full config in Table IV, re-runnable pruning script, Section XIV), though no repository URLs appear in the document.

primary_link.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference

papers.summary:
Small language models are usually built like large ones and then squeezed onto a CPU afterwards. We did the opposite: we fixed the target first, one user, one token at a time, 4-bit weights, ordinary CPU, and chose the architecture to suit it. The result keeps full attention in only 6 of its 18 blocks. The other 12 use short convolutions whose memory is two timesteps wide no matter how long the conversation gets, so two thirds of the network never re-reads a growing cache.
  Trained from scratch
papers.summary_zh: 本文主張小型語言模型不應先做大再塞進CPU,而是先固定部署目標——單一使用者、一次解碼一個token、4-bit權重、普通CPU——再依此選擇架構。Daedalus-150M共有18個區塊,僅6個保留完整注意力,其餘12個採用深度可分離短卷積,狀態只寬兩個時間步且與上下文長度無關,因此三分之二的網路不必反覆讀取持續成長的KV cache。模型以59.9B tokens從零訓練,在HellaSwag、ARC-Easy、PIQA、OpenBookQA與WinoGrande五項任務平均得47.31,超越訓練前設定的42.20門檻,並勝過用了三到六倍資料的GPT-2 124M、Pythia-160M、OPT-125M與GPT-neo-125M,也超過MobileLLM-125M的公開分數。作者以參數量相近的全注意力孿生模型做預先註冊的消融:混合架構在驗證bits-per-byte勝出0.81%,下游任務打平,4-bit檔案小6.3%,在2048上下文解碼快1.76倍,對外部同級模型達2.08倍,且優勢隨上下文增長,符合快取機制的預期。論文也誠實報告失敗處:量化感知訓練未成功,留下約6%的困惑度代價;約47.9%卷積通道失效且無法在既有推論執行環境剪枝;詞彙表偏大;資料混合漂移略超預設上限。此結果顯示在batch size為一的CPU情境,層組成比例才是關鍵設計變數,對邊緣部署深具參考價值。
papers.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
papers.title_zh: Daedalus-150M:專為CPU推論設計的卷積—注意力混合架構

links.title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention

evidence: Abstract: 'We provide a new method for fine-tuning models with sparse attention. It works for any KV cache policy, runs on a moderate hardware budget (e.g., a single Nvidia A100 GPU with 40 GB RAM)'

Section 3.2: delta encoding stores 'delta_key, delta_value' in the autograd graph instead of full KV buffers, cutting autograd memory 'by a factor of k, to O(N_C · D) per autograd call', comparable to inference alone

Section 4: 'results are mixed and inconclusive: sp is best for nq and hotpot_qa, no for trivia_qa (fine-tuning does not help), and us for pop_qa'; strong us wins are on the six Table 2 datasets at 128k
Section 4/A.5.3: failure mode 'its outputs are far too long and contain mostly random nonsense' for sp; Table 7 shows sp R values of ~30-128 with p128 often near 100% versus R≈1 and p128=0.0 for us
Section A.5.2, Table 6: our method's training step is 'about 30% more expensive than exact' sequence parallelism at chunk size 2048 on 4x A100 40GB
Section 4: single model Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, LoRA rank r=16 alpha=16 on all linear blocks, AdamW lr 0.0005, up to 5 epochs, checkpoint chosen by lowest validation loss

Section A.9/A.9.1: open-source library KeysAndValues (https://github.com/awslabs/keys_values) with full training/eval commands, hyperparameters, and dataset construction details (Table 3 dev/eval splits)
Section 5: concedes sparse attention latency 'may be an inherent disadvantage over sequence or context parallelism, which may remain the best choice if a large hardware budget can be afforded'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM infrastructure/methodology work on long-context fine-tuning with sparse attention: highly aligned with LLM (w2.5), Long Context & Memory (w1.8), Transformer, Training, and Inference preferences. The delta-encoding of KV cache buffers via autograd saved-tensor hooks to make training policy-agnostic on modest hardware is a genuine technical contribution, and the open-source KeysAndValues library aids reproducibility. However, evaluation uses a single 4B model (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507) with LoRA only on adapted Helmet tasks; the paper itself concedes results are 'mixed and inconclusive' on the four RAG/QA datasets, and the dramatic Table 2 wins are driven by an output-length failure mode of the sequence-parallelism baseline under sparse inference (thoroughly quantified, but a narrow failure surface). No error bars on main tables, no ablations of the method's own components (nested checkpointing, 8-bit training-time KV quantization), and generalization across model sizes/families is untested. Latency disadvantage of sparse attention vs CP/SP is candidly acknowledged.

primary_link.title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention

papers.summary: A lot of prior work addressed key-value (KV) cache selection and compression by sparse attention to enable long-context inference for transformer language models without excessive hardware budgets. We provide a new method for fine-tuning models with sparse attention. It works for any KV cache policy, runs on a moderate hardware budget (e.g., a single Nvidia A100 GPU with 40 GB RAM), and allows the model to co-adapt with the policy, often outperforming models trained with exact attention (sequenc
papers.summary_zh: 長上下文推論的瓶頸在於KV cache的記憶體需求,稀疏注意力(如H2O)以固定大小快取與驅逐策略解決此問題,但以精確注意力配合sequence parallelism訓練的模型,切換到稀疏注意力推論時常大幅退化。本文提出一種能在中等硬體預算(如單張A100 40GB)下、對任意KV cache策略微調模型的方法:避免對快取策略微分,改以replay log記錄驅逐決策;結合巢狀啟用檢查點與CPU offloading;再利用相鄰chunk快取緩衝區僅差少數值的線性遞迴,透過PyTorch autograd saved tensors hooks做delta編碼,把autograd的GPU記憶體需求壓到與推論同級。作者並改良H2O:允許逐batch與head的決策、提出正規化分數,並以Triton搭配FlashInfer SDPA核心回傳加總注意力權重。實驗以LoRA微調Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507,在Helmet基準(64k/128k)上比較自家方法與sequence parallelism:四項QA資料集互有勝負,但其餘六項資料集上自家方法大幅領先——後者輸出過長且多為無意義內容,無法正確停止生成。結論是模型應在與推論相同的條件下訓練。限制包括:現有稀疏注意力實作延遲仍高於序列或內容平行,逐chunk的序列式決策可能是先天劣勢;部分指標對多餘輸出過於寬容。作者同時釋出KeysAndValues開源函式庫。

links.title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents

evidence: Abstract/Sec. 5.2: SSR raised 0.031→0.281 on IS-Bench, 0.048→0.469 on OOD-TaskShift, and SafetyALFRED hazard accuracy 0.274→0.438 (Table 2, Table 3).
Table 2 / Sec. 5.1: matched Qwen3-VL-32B backbone; Trajectory DPO and success-matched variants isolate pair construction from the objective, with Trajectory DPO SSR dropping to 0.000 on IS-Bench.
App. F.2 Table 13: +FB ablation shows retaining the critic cue in training prompts collapses SFT-only SSR to 0.000, validating hindsight relabeling.
App. F.4 Table 14: runtime GPT-4o full-critic outperforms SafeBranch on the ID split (SRec 0.680 vs 0.467), honestly reported as a cost trade-off.
App. F.5 Table 15 and Limitations: single seed (42), no multi-seed error bars, dev split of only 32 tasks where one task changes SSR by ≈0.031.
App. F.1: the 100-pair spot-check was performed by two co-authors (κ=0.84) rather than external annotators; funnel is 753→675→475 pairs.
App. B.6: SafetyALFRED port uses hint-injection/gold-gate surrogates instead of simulator rollback; spoilage and fall_trip_hazard categories yield 0 training pairs.
App. A Tables 5-7 and App. E: full hyperparameters (LoRA r=16, β=0.1, lr 5e-6, seed 42) and prompt templates provided; datasets/adapters 'will be released' but no link present in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to high-weight preferences: an agent-safety alignment method (DPO-style BranchPO) for VLM-based embodied planners, combining Agents & Tool Use, Alignment & RLHF, and AI Safety with LLM/VLM backbones (Qwen3-VL-32B, GPT-4o critic). Not pure robotics: the methodology is language-model preference alignment with prompting and hindsight relabeling. The branch-pair construction via environment rollback and cue-stripping is a sensible but incremental contribution over DPO/TCPO/CHOP-style embodied preference learning. Rigor is solid on ablation design (matched backbone, pair-construction ablations, +FB ablation, funnel analysis, per-checkpoint dynamics) but weakened by a single seed, a 32-task dev split, author-performed pair verification, and self-constructed OOD benchmarks. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent, and the paper honestly reports that the GPT-4o full-critic baseline beats it on the ID split; however, key headline numbers rest on one seed and small evaluation sets. Generalizability is partially demonstrated (two simulators, OOD splits) but the SafetyALFRED port needed a different surrogate pipeline and yielded zero pairs for two hazard categories, and rollback-capable simulators are required. Reproducibility is aided by extensive hyperparameters and full prompt listings, but artifacts are only promised, not yet released.

primary_link.title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents

papers.summary: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. Training such agents to act safely is difficult, since safety and task success are distinct objectives, and safety arises only at a small number of safety-critical steps within a trajectory. Standard supervision is insufficient: imitating safe trajectories teaches behavior without explaining why it is safe, and contrasting
papers.summary_zh: 以視覺語言模型驅動的具身代理能完成任務,卻常在過程中違反安全約束,例如煮完飯留下爐火未關。這類互動式安全只在軌跡中少數安全關鍵步驟成形:單純模仿安全軌跡的SFT學不到該避開什麼,而把整條安全與不安全軌跡做對比的trajectory-level DPO,訊號又分散在眾多與安全無關的差異上。SafeBranch以「分支對」作為監督形式:當代理rollout違規時,由安全批評者(實驗採用GPT-4o)指出違反的約束,環境回滾到肇因步驟,代理在相同脈絡下結合回饋取樣安全的替代動作,再以後見重標記移除回饋,使兩分支僅在該步驟不同;最後以BranchPO(源自DPO的目標)對這些成對資料做對齊,部署時完全不需要批評者。結果顯示:IS-Bench安全成功率從0.031升至0.281,未見物件的OOD變體從0.048升至0.469,SafetyALFRED危害準確率從0.274升至0.438,且分支對生成效率比自然best-of-N取樣快約5.2倍。消融顯示在相同DPO目標下,trajectory對照變體幾乎無效,增益確實來自分支對構築;但在ID分割上,每步呼叫GPT-4o的執行期完整批評者仍略勝。限制:訓練仍需批評者成本,且依賴支援回滾的模擬器。此工作將互動式安全內化到代理本身,是具身安全對齊的重要進展。

Section 4.2: reward model is two GraphSAGE layers with residual connections, node features from all-MiniLM-L6-v2 role/query embeddings plus 5 structural features, trained with Bradley-Terry loss; pass/pass pairs down-weighted to 0.1 as they are 80–90% of data.
Section 4.3: on-policy GRPO variant with importance ratio omitted (equals 1); Appendix A Table 6: group size 4, KL β=0.2, σ_min=0.01, BoN N=5, reward weights λ_c=0.6, λ_V=0.3, λ_E=0.1.
Section 5, Table 5: ablation on GSM8K/HumanEval/MMLU shows Full method lowest token use (e.g., GSM8K 3863 vs 4166 w/o RM, 4281 w/o BoN); w/o BoN slightly higher MMLU accuracy but 30.5% more tokens.

Section 6/Limitations: single Qwen3-4B backbone; reward data requires executing candidate graphs on a specific base LLM; method restricted to tasks with verifiable ground truth; heterogeneous LLM agents left as future work.
Footnote 1 (Section 1): code and hyperparameter settings claimed available at https://github.com/psuwannapich/RGA-Designer.

Section 4.2/Conclusion: global reward model trained on combined six-benchmark data handles unseen roles via embeddings, unlike ARG-Designer's role-pool-conditioned node generator requiring head extension and retraining.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope topic: LLM-based multi-agent systems (Agents & Tool Use, w=2.5), RLHF-style reward modeling with a GRPO variant (Alignment & RLHF, w=2.0), evaluated on math-reasoning and code benchmarks with a Qwen3-4B LLM backbone, targeting token-efficiency (Scaling & Efficiency). Novelty is incremental: the method is a reward-guided fine-tuning stage bolted onto ARG-Designer, combining standard components (GraphSAGE reward model, Bradley-Terry loss, GRPO); the transferable global reward model via role/query embeddings is a modest additional contribution. Rigor is above average: 6 benchmarks, 5 baselines, 10 runs with mean±std, Welch's t-tests, 4-setting ablation, fixed hyperparameters (Appendix A Table 6), and honest reporting that accuracy gains are statistically insignificant (Section 5, Table 4). Evidence is verifiable: the headline 20.5% token reduction matches Table 3 (ARG 3815±124 vs RGA 3032±205 avg) and is significant on 5/6 benchmarks vs ARG-Designer; ablations (Table 5) support both reward model and Best-of-N. Generalizability is limited per the paper's own Limitations: single 4B backbone, ground-truth-verifiable tasks only, full dataset rebuild required per base LLM, heterogeneous LLM agents unsupported. Reproducibility aided by a public code URL (footnote 1) and a complete hyperparameter table, though no seed protocol or reward-model quality validation is reported. Minor hygiene issue: author affiliation/email fields are mismatched.
topics: GRPO / reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards

primary_link.title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design

papers.summary: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generati
papers.summary_zh: LLM多代理系統(MAS)仰賴多個代理協作,效能強但token消耗可觀。先前ARG-Designer把通訊拓撲設計重塑為自迴歸圖形生成,但其最大概似訓練目標沒有鼓勵稀疏高效結構的誘因。本文提出RGA-Designer,借鑑RLHF:先執行候選圖形並以成敗標記,依任務正確性與結構緊湊度(權重分別為0.6、0.3、0.1)計算獎勵、組成偏好對;接著訓練以GraphSAGE為骨幹的圖層級獎勵模型;最後以on-policy的GRPO變體微調預訓練的圖形生成器,推論時另以Best-of-N挑選獎勵最高的拓撲。由於獎勵模型在嵌入空間對節點角色編碼,其訓練資料可跨資料集共用,也能容納未見過的代理角色,這是相對ARG-Designer的額外優點。以Qwen3-4B為底層模型,在GSM8K、AQuA、MultiArith、SVAMP、MMLU與HumanEval六項基準各跑十次獨立實驗:任務準確率與ARG-Designer無統計顯著差異,token消耗平均減少20.5%,除模板化、變異有限的MultiArith外均達顯著(Welch t-test)。消融顯示獎勵模型與BoN選擇皆有貢獻。限制:實驗僅用單一4B模型,更換底層模型需重建資料集;訓練依賴可驗證的標準答案,不適用開放式任務;異質MAS尚未支援。整體而言,此方法在不犧牲準確率的前提下大幅降低MAS的推論成本。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic LLM paper: DMP trains a Qwen2.5-VL-3B controller to orchestrate perception/execution/verification tools for rule-constrained planning, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, Multimodal AI, and LLM preferences; not pure CV since rules are natural-language, LLM-formalized, and verified via synthesized code. Novelty is moderate: maze planning for (M)LLMs is crowded (AlphaMaze, MVoT, VPRL cited), and the genuine advances are the Language-Logic-Function validator pipeline and externalized rule verification enabling zero-shot unseen rules. Rigor is solid but not exemplary: baselines span Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash, GPT-5, Direct/CoT/SFT, plus tool ablations, data-scale curves, and error analysis; however, test sets are small (400 per environment), no variance/seeds or significance tests are reported, and the EM metric assumes a unique shortest valid path. Generalizability is limited: default 3x3 grids, synthetic rendering, CLIP-legend perception, and deterministic validators acknowledged in Appendix A as simplified abstractions. Reproducibility is decent: GitHub link, full hyperparameters (LoRA rank 8, lr 1e-4, 15 epochs), algorithms and prompts in the appendix, though manual validator inspection is a bottleneck.

primary_link.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rule
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）雖結合視覺感知與語言推理，但在明確或未見過的規則約束下執行視覺空間規劃的能力仍待檢驗。本文提出RuleMaze基準，要求模型在迷宮導航中遵守不同複雜度的自然語言規則，並設計Language–Logic–Function Hybridization流程，以LLM自動生成規則、轉為邏輯表示並合成可執行驗證器，免去人工規則工程。方法上提出Disentangled Multimodal Planning（DMP），將感知、執行與規則驗證拆解為可呼叫的工具，訓練控制器學習何時呼叫，驗證器可替換以支援新規則而無需再訓練。實驗顯示DMP-3B在未見規則上達90.0% EM，較SFT基線的70.3%大幅提升，困難規則與QuestMaze情境仍維持優勢；DMP-Prompting亦提升GPT-5等專有模型表現（53.5%至81.4%）。限制包括僅在合成網格迷宮上驗證、驗證器假定規則可精確形式化，以及迭代工具呼叫的額外運算成本。此研究為評估規範性、可解釋的多模態規劃建立了原則性基準，對自駕與具身智慧等需遵循變動約束的場景具參考價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an LLM-agent governance harness (MCP control plane, tool registry, knowledge graph grounding, commitment/claim cards, review layer) instantiated in neuroimaging, so it is not a pure domain application, but the domain focus and neuroimaging-specific registry temper preference relevance. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG/Knowledge, and LLM-as-judge evaluation topics. Methodology is novel: binding agent analyses to sealed commitment cards, six-state claim adjudication, and multiverse exposure of analytic-choice sensitivity is a distinctive framing versus prior scientific-agent systems. Rigor is unusually high: paired 7-model tool-calling benchmark with pre-fixed reference routes, exact Wilcoxon tests, routing ablation, 272-item human judge audit, explicit denominators, and honest reporting of failures (review layer missed sign-blind scoring; TRIBE new-source endpoint unsupported). Evidence strength is good but limited by a self-constructed benchmark with acknowledged vocabulary-circularity risk, judge self-preference risk, low absolute grounding (22.0%), and descriptive case studies (n=3). Generalizability is moderate since the machinery is domain-general in principle but all evaluations are neuroimaging-only. Reproducibility is excellent: MIT-licensed code, Zenodo archives, released manifests, scoring contracts, and audit sheets.

papers.summary: AI agents can execute scientific analyses, but an analytic output becomes a defensible claim only after alternatives are weighed and the claim is limited to what the evidence supports. Agents may reproduce failures including selective analysis, premature declarations of success and optimization of imperfect criteria. papers.summary_zh: AI代理能執行科學分析，但分析結果要成為可辯護的主張，須權衡替代方案並限縮結論範圍。本文提出Brain Researcher，一套在神經影像研究者運算環境中運作的代理研究框架，預先規範可允許的分析、必要檢查與主張範圍。系統包含工具註冊表、BR-KG知識圖譜（約74.6萬節點、246萬邊）、commitment card與claim card等可稽核紀錄，並以accepted、qualified、revised、blocked、rejected、deferred六種主張狀態明確裁定結論。基準測試顯示，七個前沿模型的首次工具選擇正確率從23.3%升至93.6%，可驗證證據引用率從4.6%升至22.0%。三項協作者研究以多宇宙分析揭露分析選擇的敏感性，如NeuroMark精神分裂症三項假說皆列為qualified；兩項自我演化研究則將探索結果轉為凍結的後續分析。限制方面，自動審查曾漏掉符號盲視的評分錯誤而需人類審查者發現，證據判定依賴LLM裁判，且缺乏獨立重複驗證。此平台示範如何將方法學判斷內嵌於AI輔助研究的工作流程，而非事後補救。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An ASR benchmark-integrity paper with genuine language-model methodology (mechanistic steering/patching from the LLM interpretability literature, evaluation of speech-LLM decoders, reward-hacking framing), so it is not capped as pure audio, but its core domain is speech recognition, limiting preference relevance. Novelty is solid: the three behavioral probes (reference disagreement, masked-number recovery, orthographic switching) and bidirectional causal manipulation of benchmark-conditioned behavior are new for ASR evaluation. Rigor and evidence are strong: 11 open models, silenced-audio prior control (audio lift, Eq. 1), hard-cell difficulty gates (App. A.4), TTS intelligibility gates (App. A.3), 93% consensus-panel validation against human annotations on 1,113 edits (Sec. 3.3, Table 1), bootstrap/Wilson CIs, McNemar test, and honest negative results (Phi-4 steering causally inert 0.200→0.201; Higgs no clean operating point, App. A.7). Generalizability is moderate: English-only, VoxPopuli-centric with LibriSpeech secondary, private DaiKon control set (Sec. 3.1), and the mechanism of how the behavior arises in training remains open (Sec. 5). Reproducibility is good: public code repo (footnote 1), open-source models, and detailed appendix protocols (layers, alphas, normalization, perturbation specs). Weighted score ≈0.68.

primary_link.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models

papers.summary: Public benchmarks are important measures of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model capabilities. However, by nature of being public, there is risk of models being optimized for these benchmarks in ways that do not generalize well to real-world data. We present a methodology for quantifying benchmark optimization, focusing on cases where the audio underdetermines the reference transcript. We identify three families of behavioral probes that reveal models' capabilities of reproducing benchmark r
papers.summary_zh: 公開語音辨識（ASR）基準的分數可能因模型針對基準特性最佳化（benchmaxxing）而高估實際能力。本文提出量化此現象的方法學，聚焦音訊無法唯一決定參考轉錄的情況，設計三類行為探針：參考不一致（模型複製參考中的錯誤）、遮罩數字回復（音訊被靜音仍輸出原數字）與正字切換（依語料慣例切換拼寫）。在11個開源模型上，VoxPopuli表現最好的模型（Cohere、Canary-Qwen、Granite、Phi-4等）accept-ref達0.18至0.30，顯著複製與音訊矛盾的參考內容。機制分析顯示此行為由狹窄的聲學線索觸發：基準測試集說話者的語音克隆會誘發，通用聲音或新收集的同域資料則不會；且可透過拼接基準音訊或對單一編碼器層做線性操控雙向開關，消融該方向可使accept-ref下降82%至92%。此行為未泛化至訓練截止後新收集的ep-fresh等資料。作者建議測試集應採時序分層或完全保留，選模型時以多重指標輔助WER。

links.title: Vibe Coding: Practice, Performance, Productivity, and Risk -A State-of-the-Art Review

evidence: Section 1.3 & Table 1: declares itself 'a state-of-the-art review rather than a systematic one'; 123-source corpus tiered by trustworthiness with vendor material flagged Low and Wayback/archive.today snapshots as canonical citations.

Section 4.1: documents SWE-Bench Verified trajectory 1.96% (Oct 2023) to 95.0% (Jun 2026), the self-reported vs independently-run SWE-Bench Pro gap (80.0% vs ~59-61%), OpenAI's audit finding defects in 59.4% of consistently-unsolved problems, and METR's reward-hacking in >30% of evaluation runs.

Table 3 & Section 5.3: assembles the contradictory quantitative record (+26.1% s.e. 10.3% peer-reviewed field experiment; -19%/-18% METR RCTs; +441% review time telemetry; 55.8% CI 21-89% vendor trial) and reconciles it via six explicitly stated patterns.

Section 7.2: concedes 'no study in the corpus stratifies AI-assisted productivity by codebase age'; the greenfield-vs-mature conjecture is presented as falsifiable but untested, bounding the paper's claims.

Sections 6.1-6.2: security incidents (Moltbook exposing 1.5M API tokens; Escape.tech scan of ~1,400 vibe-coded apps) and quality telemetry (GitClear 153M LOC, refactoring share 25% to <10%; CodeRabbit 470 PRs, 1.7x issues) are drawn from vendor/grey sources that the paper itself caveats for commercial interest.

Acknowledgements: discloses that Claude Opus 4.8 drafted text and 'artificial reviews of paper drafts' were used to find weaknesses; transparency is good, but no reproducible search protocol, dataset, or analysis code is provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A state-of-the-art review of LLM-driven 'vibe coding' that sits squarely on the highest-weighted preferences: LLMs, coding agents/tool use, code generation, and AI safety/evaluation (Sections 3-6). The synthesis is genuinely useful: it triangulates contradictory productivity evidence (Cui +26.1% field RCT vs METR -19% RCT vs Faros +441% review-time telemetry), documents benchmark inflation (SWE-Bench Verified 95% vs self-reported Pro 80% vs independently-run ~59-61%), and proposes a falsifiable codebase-age conjecture (Section 7.2). Rigor is above average for a narrative review - explicit evidence tiering (Table 1), vendor-interest flagging, and honest limitations - but the corpus is non-systematic, the six convergence patterns are post-hoc interpretations, and the central conjecture is admitted to be untested by any corpus study (Section 7.2). Evidence strength is mixed: peer-reviewed anchors are solid, but the 2025-2026 quantitative core rests heavily on vendor telemetry, vendor surveys, and grey literature that the paper itself classifies as low/medium tier. Reproducibility is limited: the tiered 123-source corpus and Wayback archiving conventions aid traceability, but no search protocol, data, or code is released. Not out-of-scope; scores reflect strong topical fit tempered by survey-only contribution and grey-literature dependence.

radar.summary_zh: Vibe coding指開發者以自然語言描述意圖、透過執行而非閱讀程式碼來驗證結果的AI輔助開發實務。本文彙整該領域十七個月內的實證證據，涵蓋軟體工程、人機互動、勞動經濟與安全研究等面向。效能上，早期基準已飽和但任務能力不均：程式碼生成可靠，錯誤檢測與文件稽核偏弱。生產力紀錄看似矛盾：同儕審查的田野實驗報告每週任務數增加26%，獨立隨機對照試驗（METR）卻測得資深開發者在成熟程式庫減速19%，團隊遙測更顯示審查時間上升441%。作者以六種穩定模式解釋分歧，包括測量範圍擴大時效應縮減、自評與獨立測量背離、產出量與生產力混淆等，並提出可否證的推測：增益在新程式碼上真實，在成熟程式庫則縮減或反轉。文中亦記錄部署安全事件、程式碼品質劣化（重複程式碼約四倍）、著作權爭議與技能萎縮（初級工程師理解測驗低17個百分點），對評估AI編碼工具的真實價值極具參考性。
