evidence: Abstract: policy stays close to base accuracy on MATH500 (0.782 vs 0.796) while cutting mean response length from 4,796 to 2,811 tokens (41% reduction), with 76% token reduction on GSM8K.

Table 5 (Appendix D): final accuracy and mean length for router vs NoThink/Short/Long-only baselines and base, mean ± std over three seeds; router 0.782±.006 at 2810±59 tokens on MATH-500, Long-only 0.802±.004.
Appendix A: two-mode Countdown router collapsed within 30-50 steps in every configuration; hard per-mode caps introduced so the label cannot decouple from behavior.

Experimental Setup + Limitations: single model DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, MATH-lighteval training, 90 steps on 4×H100, three seeds; limitations state results cover one 1.5B model on one mathematical distribution and caps are task-specific.
Related Work (Adaptive Reasoning-Mode Selection): positions the method against AdaptThink, AutoThink, ARM, and Thinkless, but no head-to-head comparison with these prior adaptive methods is run.
Appendix D (Figure 10 caption): per-OOD routing split not available because 'the released logs do not record per OOD benchmark'; realized length used as a proxy.

Appendix C (Table 4 / phase 2): balance coefficient annealed to 0 over steps 60→85 and reward flattened (all bases 1.0, all γ=1.0) for steps 60→90 to verify the mode split persists without reward shaping.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM reasoning work: adaptive test-time compute allocation for a reasoning LLM via GRPO, matching high-weight preferences (Reasoning & CoT, LLMs, RL training, efficiency). Novelty is moderate: three-mode self-routing end-to-end in RL without a supervised stage is a lean delta over AdaptThink/AutoThink/ARM/Thinkless, and the reward surface builds directly on prior discounted-GRPO work; the hard-cap anti-collapse mechanism and documented Countdown negative result are the freshest parts. Rigor is solid for the scale (3 seeds, matched single-mode baselines, balance-term annealing and phase-2 reward flattening as controls, difficulty-level correlation analysis) but weakened by no head-to-head against prior adaptive methods and figure-based Pareto claims. Evidence is internally consistent and quantified (41% MATH-500, 76% GSM8K token reduction with seed std), though the base accuracy figures differ slightly across tables (0.796 vs 0.807) and OOD routing splits are inferred from length because logs were not recorded. Generalizability is limited to one 1.5B model and one math training distribution with task-specific caps, as the authors admit. Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters and protocol detail, but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation

radar.summary: Reasoning language models trained with reinforcement learning typically operate under a fixed token budget rather than an explicitly adaptive one, which can lead to over-computation on easy problems and insufficient computation on difficult ones. We study whether a model can learn to allocate its own reasoning effort by choosing, as the first token of its response, one of three modes: \textsc{NoThink} (answer as quickly as possible), \textsc{Short} (brief reasoning), or \textsc{Long} (extended r
radar.summary_zh: 以強化學習訓練的推理模型通常採固定token預算，易在簡單問題上過度運算、在困難問題上不足。本文提出三模式自我路由：讓模型在回應的第一個token選擇NoThink（盡快作答）、Short（簡短推理）或Long（延伸推理），選擇透過GRPO端對端學習，無需獨立路由器。為克服路由塌縮，方法結合各模式的硬性token上限、依模式給予不同基礎獎勵與折扣的獎勵曲面、加入優勢項的平衡項，以及強制路由暖身。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B上，三種模式自然浮現（約20/32/47%）且未塌縮，路由分配與MATH-500難度單調一致。結果顯示平均回應長度從4,796降至2,811 tokens（減少41%），準確率0.782接近基礎模型的0.796；零樣本轉移至GSM8K時token減少76%且優於同等長度的固定模式，在AIME則正確保留長推理預算。Countdown任務的二元路由負結果說明難度差異是路由可學習的前提。方法仍限於單一1.5B模型與數學領域，模式上限需依任務調整。
radar.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation
radar.title_zh: 學習何時思考：測試期運算分配的自適應推理

links.title: Interrupting the Loop: Periodic Subject Changes Raise Judged Surprise and Connection in Base Language Models

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.2: interruption raises judged surprise over habituation alone by ~1.2-1.4 points on fresh windows (e.g., +1.20 [+0.43,+2.11], p=0.010 at period 150); connection effect largely a self-copy artifact (+2.40 all-windows vs +0.75 fresh).
Section 4.7 and Table 44: pre-registered replication on ten new premises confirms H1 (+1.48 [+0.70,+2.07], p=0.003; fresh-only +0.82, p=0.035) and refutes H3 in the exploratory direction.

Section 5: judge measured for repeatability (Opus 5 median intra-window spread 0.71), second judge family Kimi K2.6 agrees rho=0.65-0.85, three human raters' consensus agrees rho=0.58 on surprise with low inter-rater alpha (0.30-0.38).

Section 4.8 and Table 28: document-level judgment shows no arm exceeds 2.5 on integration/development/coherence/surprise; the interrupted preserved-context stream scores below habituation alone on document surprise (-1.30, p=0.002).

Section 4.10 and Appendix F: on online bin packing with a verifier, the interruption arm multiplies distinct valid functions (5.1 vs 1.8, B2 p=0.0117) but does not raise best-candidate gain (B1 p=0.94).

Section 8 (Limitations): ten cells per arm with one random seed, batteries 1-3 exploratory, judge from one family, residual-stream analysis descriptive with no causal intervention; stronger decoding baselines not tested.

Appendix C: public repository, code (117 tests), per-run token streams, judgments, human-rating packs, dated laboratory notebook, verbatim judge prompts, full hyperparameters and premises, judge cost ~US$500.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-generation study: it dismantles a cognitively inspired 'DREAM' scaffold on base LLMs (Qwen3-8B/30B-A3B, OLMo-2-13B) and shows most judged-surprise gain comes from two simple operators (windowed repetition penalty + periodic subject-change injection), while contributing an evaluation protocol for long-generation judging (generated-only windows, fresh-only estimates, document-level reading, premise as unit). Preference relevance is solid but mid-tier: squarely about LLMs, text generation, LLM-as-judge evaluation and some residual-stream interpretability, but it does not engage the top-weighted themes (agents, reasoning/CoT, Japanese NLP, alignment). Rigor is unusually high for a small study: sham and reset controls, factorial ablation, exact permutation tests with Cliff's delta and BH correction, self-copy audit exposing replay artifacts, a second judge family, and a pre-registered replication on new premises; deducted for n=10 cells per arm with a single fixed seed, an analysis protocol revised after early results, and an outcome that rests on judge scores whose human agreement is only moderate (rho=0.58 surprise, alpha=0.30-0.38). Evidence is strong within its operationalization (Section 4.8 honestly shows local gains do not compose), but generalizability is narrow: forced-continuation regime, quantized English base models, one post-trained model in raw continuation, and stronger decoding baselines untested. Reproducibility claims are detailed and specific (repository, per-run data, judge prompts, hyperparameters, premises, notebook, ~$500 judge cost).

primary_link.title: Interrupting the Loop: Periodic Subject Changes Raise Judged Surprise and Connection in Base Language Models

radar.summary: Where does the novelty a base language model produces with no task come from, and what can an LLM judge of a long stream actually see? We dismantle a cognitively inspired generation loop over 24 conditions on three base models. Most of its effect lives in one operation: a new subject injected every few hundred tokens (an interruption) into a stream whose literal repetition is damped (habituation). We judge windows of generated text only, with the premise as the unit (n=10) and a judge measured f
radar.summary_zh: 基礎語言模型在無任務指令下的自由生成能否產生新意，來源常歸於取樣器、提示或生成迴路。本文以24種條件的拆解實驗檢驗這些來源，發現效果主要來自一項簡單操作：每隔數百token注入新主題句（中斷），配合抑制字面重複的習慣化懲罰。在僅評模型生成文字的視窗協議下，中斷使評審的驚奇分數較僅習慣化提升1.2至1.4分、連結提升0.8分；新主題（而非段落邊界）是效果來源，重置上下文至少與保留上下文同等有效，並經預註冊複製確認主要對比。研究更揭露視窗式LLM評審的三大盲點：將實驗者注入的句子視為模型自產、無法看見超出視野範圍的自我重播、以及區域增益無法組成整體——文件層級判定顯示被中斷的文本讀起來是一連串重啟。在可驗證的bin packing任務上，中斷使有效且相異的候選函數增加三到四倍，卻未提升最佳解品質，顯示其為變異算子而非價值創造者。此研究同時提供長文生成的評測協議與對簡單干預的嚴謹刻畫。
radar.title: Interrupting the Loop: Periodic Subject Changes Raise Judged Surprise and Connection in Base Language Models
radar.title_zh: 中斷迴路：週期性主題變換提升基礎語言模型受評的驚奇與連結

links.title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts

evidence: Abstract: 'Frontier models perform surprisingly poorly with only one model reaching 0.75 macro average recall despite strong performance on seemingly related general benchmarks'

Section 3.2: 'ContractScrub consists of 3,014 annotated tasks across 9 categories drawn from 44 contracts', annotated by 9 lawyers each with at least 8 years of practice; no inter-annotator agreement statistic is reported

Section 3.3: recall adopted as primary metric because 'the potential costs of false negatives are significantly higher than the cost of false positives', plus a word-only ablation isolating identification from localization
Table 2: GPT-5.5 R=0.750/P=0.580/F1=0.632 at $1.38 and 533s per contract; Gemini 3.1 Pro best F1 (0.655) at 0.19/76s
Appendix B: reasoning ablation shows +0.107 avg recall for GPT-5.5 and +0.090 for Claude Opus 4.7, with gains 'concentrated in categories that require full-document term consistency'

Section 5 Limitations: benchmark 'drawn from only 44 contracts', 'only English-language contracts with an approximate length of 10–15 pages', and structured JSON output 'introduces sensitivity to instruction-following ability as a confounder'

Section 4 Long-Distance Referencing: recall decreases with reference distance, 'effect becoming most pronounced past ten thousand characters', based on manual annotation of half of the Incorrect Section References items
Appendix G: complete per-category prompt templates and JSON schemas provided; Appendix F Table 8 lists provider, temperature, and reasoning effort for all 10 models
Appendix E: 'The dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance', while the abstract already lists a HuggingFace URL (https://huggingface.co/tri-fair-lab/contract_scrub)
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation benchmark for contract 'scrubbing' — a recall-sensitive, full-document defect-identification task. Topic relevance is solid for LLM-focused preferences: it directly evaluates frontier LLMs (Section 3.4), spans long-context reasoning and consistency checking, includes a reasoning on/off ablation (Appendix B), and is squarely an evaluation/benchmark contribution (Red Teaming & Evaluation). It is not, however, a methodology paper — no training, architecture, or algorithmic novelty — and misses several high-weight areas (Japanese NLP, agents, code, alignment). Novelty is moderate: the task definition ('what is wrong with this relative to the contract's own internal conventions', Section 2) and 9-category tuple schema are new vs. CUAD/ContractNLI/ContractEval-style classification, but construction is a conventional expert-annotation-plus-error-insertion pipeline. Rigor is decent but has gaps: no inter-annotator agreement statistics despite 9 SME annotators (Section 3.2), inserted errors may differ distributionally from natural drafting errors with no validation, no human-lawyer baseline to contextualize the 0.75 recall ceiling, single prompt template with no prompt-sensitivity testing, and no significance testing. Evidence strength is good: internally consistent tables (Table 2 vs Tables 3/5/6/7), costs/latencies reported, and cross-benchmark contrasts grounded in cited numbers (Section 5, FaithEval/NIAH comparisons). Generalizability is limited and candidly acknowledged (Section 5 Limitations: only 44 contracts, English-only, 10–15 pages, JSON-output confounder). Reproducibility is above average: full prompts (Appendix G), inference hyperparameters (Table 8), normalization rules (Section 3.5), and a HuggingFace release, though Appendix E says availability is 'upon acceptance' and no scoring code is explicitly released. Overall a credible, well-executed domain benchmark with real practical value but bounded methodological contribution.

primary_link.title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts

radar.summary: Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, painstaking work requiring detailed attention to long documents. Scrubbing also seems to align naturally with the general capabilities expected of frontier LLMs around long-context re
radar.summary_zh: 契約scrubbing指交易合約簽署前的最終審查，目的在找出錯誤與不一致，屬繁瑣但攸關法律風險的例行工作。本文提出ContractScrub，首個評估LLM執行契約scrubbing能力的基準，包含3,014個標註任務、44份源自CUAD的契約，由九位具八年以上執業經驗的律師手工標註九大類問題，如未定義的大寫詞、未大寫的已定義詞、錯誤章節引用、錯誤當事人引用與語言不一致等。評測九個前沿與開源模型後發現，表現最好的GPT-5.5總體recall僅0.750，所有F1低於0.650，明顯低於模型在相關通用基準的表現。各類別差異懸殊：具明確詞彙訊號的已定義詞平均recall約0.835，需推斷上下文意圖的情境性大寫錯誤僅約0.427；啟用推理僅帶來中度增益，跨長距離的引用偵測尤其困難。限制包括契約數量有限、僅涵蓋英文與10至15頁篇幅、要求結構化JSON輸出可能壓低分數。此基準凸顯專業領域針對性評測對衡量真實部署價值的必要性。
radar.title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
radar.title_zh: ContractScrub：法律契約最終審查基準

links.title: Write Once, Run Everywhere: The Axon DSL for Shape-Safe and Framework-Agnostic LLM Architectures

evidence: Abstract and Results, Table 1: 467 experiments; median runtime ratios 0.903 (PyTorch), 0.843 (Triton), 0.481 (JAX) for <4B autoregressive generation, with JAX mean 1.122 indicating high variance from BLOOM/XGLM outliers.
Results, vLLM section, Table 3: Axon-native vLLM faster in 65/88 checkpoints (74%), median ratio 0.631 vs HF Transformers.

Technical Supplement, 'Python Overhead' Tables 6-7: F.linear and SDPA call counts identical between Axon-Torch and Transformers while nn.Module.__call__ drops from 35,616 to 0, supporting the claim that speedups come from the Python layer, not better kernels.

Limitations section: 'We present no ablation isolating the AST and Graph IR optimization passes'; benchmarks on a single GPU type (NVIDIA B200) and a single Apple Silicon M3 Max configuration; some checkpoints required FP32 fallback for token parity.
Results, Table 2 and text: forward-pass performance is weak, e.g., JAX 0/14 at parity for 4-32B encoder models (median 3.747x slower), honestly reported rather than hidden.

Training with Axon Derived Models section: only one training experiment (Gemma-3 270M, ArXiv summarization, 2000 steps, 120.3ms vs 133.0ms step-time, identical final loss 2.506) - minimal training evidence.

Reproducibility: Technical Supplement provides extended EBNF grammar (Figure 14), compiler stage invariants (Table 5), and a complete GPT-2 Axon definition (Figure 7), but the paper contains no repository link or code-availability statement for the Axon compiler.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems/infrastructure paper squarely targeting LLM architectures and LLM inference/serving (vLLM, KV cache, MoE, Mamba support), matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, efficiency, and code/DSL tooling; it is not a pure domain application and stays in scope. Novelty is moderate: backend-agnostic compilation (ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA) is well-trodden, but an authoring DSL with symbolic dimensions and checkpoint-path semantics compiled to five runtimes is a distinct positioning. Rigor and evidence are solid but not exceptional: 467 benchmark runs with warmups, repetitions, and top-1 token-parity checks, plus a credible profiling analysis attributing speedups to eliminated nn.Module dispatch overhead; however, the only baseline is HF Transformers (no TensorRT-LLM/other optimized baselines), medians on PyTorch/Triton are modest (7%/12%), JAX mean ratio 1.122 shows high variance, forward-pass results are weak, and no compiler-stage ablations exist (acknowledged). Generalizability is good across 60+ families and 135M-32B sizes but single-GPU-type hardware limits it. Reproducibility is middling: grammar, compiler-stage invariants, full GPT-2 listing, and versioned setups are provided, but no public code or compiler release is stated.
topics: inference efficiency and serving (vLLM, KV cache)
cross-backend compilation (PyTorch, Triton, JAX, MLX, vLLM)

primary_link.title: Write Once, Run Everywhere: The Axon DSL for Shape-Safe and Framework-Agnostic LLM Architectures

radar.summary: The entire ecosystem of open-source language models effectively relies on a single platform. What if this platform was forced to shut down tomorrow? Implementing and maintaining efficient model definitions and translating them between different training and inference regimes is a resource-heavy task that severely limits model efficiency and portability, hindering both scaling and deployment. Here, we present Axon, a strongly typed domain-specific language with Haskell-like syntax, that enables a
radar.summary_zh: 開源語言模型生態實際上依賴單一平台，模型定義難以在不同訓練與推論框架間移植，造成實作漂移與技術債。本文提出Axon，一種強型別、Haskell風格語法的領域特定語言（DSL），實現「寫一次、到處執行」典範：以符號維度與張量型別達成形狀安全，單一定義經三階段編譯管線（脫糖、Graph IR最佳化、後端lowering）編譯為PyTorch、PyTorch+Triton、JAX、MLX與vLLM的獨立實作。在涵蓋135M至32B參數、60個模型家族逾204個模型的467項推論實驗中，相較Transformers參考實作，Axon在PyTorch、Triton、JAX、MLX分別達7%、12%、91%、107%的中位加速；vLLM原生部署中位加速58%。剖析顯示加速主要來自消除nn.Module的Python派發開銷。訓練實驗（Gemma-3 270M）顯示損失曲線與Transformers一致且步時快9.6%。限制包括僅測語言模型、單一硬體組態，以及大型編碼器-解碼器模型的forward效能仍偏弱，編譯器各階段的貢獻亦未做消融。
radar.title: Write Once, Run Everywhere: The Axon DSL for Shape-Safe and Framework-Agnostic LLM Architectures
radar.title_zh: 寫一次、到處執行：實現形狀安全且框架無關LLM架構的Axon DSL

links.title: Question-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Multimodal Visual Question Answering

evidence: Abstract: Q-Guide outperforms direct prompting and multi-agent systems, 65.0% vs 40.0% on DocVQA2026 and 32.4% vs 24.4% on M109NC, with gains holding across Claude Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 4.5.

Section 5.1: DocVQA2026 validation split contains 80 questions across 8 categories (documents 1–181 pages); M109NC has 504 questions from 10 Manga109 books built by the authors via greedy set-cover context selection.

Table 2: Q-Guide overall 65.0% with Wilson 95% CI [54.1, 74.5] vs DocAgent/MDocAgent CI [30.0, 51.0]; per-category cells have n=10 and are explicitly flagged as trends only; McNemar and bootstrap tests are cited but no statistics are reported.

Section 5.3 / Table 1: leave-one-out ablation shows Visual Inspection (−17.2) and Targeted Query (−16.2) are the most impactful tools; Fig. 6 shows 3-stage planning reaches only 35.7%, below the Visual+OCR direct baseline at 38.8%.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: Q-Guide leads every baseline on both benchmarks across all three backbones (e.g., DocVQA2026: 65.0/62.8/64.2), while MDocAgent degrades 40.0%→31.4% with weaker backbones.
Section 5.5 / Table 5: mean per-question cost 10,351 tokens (9,668 input, 93% input-dominated) vs 4,055 for DocAgent; accuracy saturates at T_max≈3 (40.0%→55.0%→~65%).

Section 5.5 Limitations: map/spatial-topological questions are the clearest weakness, M109NC accuracy scales with OCR quality (21.8%→32.4%→53.7% across none/Claude-OCR/GT-OCR), and long-document handling uses fixed-window chunking with confidence-weighted adjudication rather than retrieval.

Section 4: implementation uses proprietary components (Amazon Textract, Surya, Qwen3.5-2B grounding, LangGraph) with temperature 0 and T_max=3; no code, prompt, or benchmark release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent methodology paper (single-loop tool-calling agent over Claude backbones for question-conditioned document/manga VQA), so it is in scope under Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning/test-time compute, Multimodal AI, and partially Japanese NLP (Manga109 character naming from Japanese dialogue) — not pure CV despite the vision surface. Strengths: same-backbone re-implementation of agentic baselines (DocAgent, MDocAgent, ARIAL), leave-one-out tool ablations (Table 1), orchestration-vs-tools ablation with a useful negative result (Fig. 6: 3-stage planning at 35.7% below Visual+OCR 38.8%), three-backbone validation (Table 4), measured token costs (Table 5), explicit termination/sufficiency formalization, and an honest limitations section. Weaknesses: the headline benchmark has only 80 questions (per-category n=10), M109NC is self-constructed with no external validation or release, p-values for the claimed McNemar/bootstrap robustness are not reported, all backbones are proprietary Claude models with no open-weight port, the heuristic chunk adjudication is unexamined, and no code or data availability is stated. Novelty is moderate: question-conditioned zoom/OCR tool loops are well precedented (TextCoT, Chain-of-Spot, ARIAL, AgenticOCR); the main new contribution is the empirical claim that perception targeting, not orchestration, drives gains.

primary_link.title: Question-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Multimodal Visual Question Answering

radar.summary: Multimodal LLMs can see a document, but they often can't read it reliably. Small text, tables, visual cues, and topological elements still trip them up under direct visual inference, even when the page is already sitting in the model's context. Most document-VQA systems treat perception as fixed: they encode the page once, ask the question, and answer from whatever the model happened to extract in that single fast pass. We think document VQA needs slower, more deliberate perception: rather than
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型雖能「看到」文件,卻常無法可靠讀取其中的小字、表格與視覺提示。多數文件視覺問答系統採單次快速編碼,不論問題為何都以相同方式處理頁面,導致模型推理正確卻感知出錯。本文提出 Q-Guide,一個讓感知變慢且受問題引導的小型代理:代理先判斷還缺少哪些證據,再呼叫五種恢復工具(文字擷取、視覺細節、目標查詢、空間定位、結構版面)補足資訊,循環至證據充足才提交答案,信心不足時則棄答 Unknown。在 DocVQA2026 上達 65.0%,遠高於直接提示的 38.8% 與 DocAgent、MDocAgent 等 agentic 基線的 40.0%;在自建的漫畫角色命名任務 M109NC 上為 32.4% 對 24.4%,且在 Claude Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6 與 Opus 4.5 三種骨幹上都成立。消融顯示收益來自把感知導向正確位置:視覺檢查與目標查詢工具最重要,加入規劃、路由或多代理協作反而無益;準確率隨感知預算上升,兩至三輪即趨飽和。限制包括運算成本高於單次推理、地圖等空間拓撲內容仍困難,且成效受 OCR 品質限制(改用真值 OCR 可達 53.7%)。此研究顯示對文件 VQA 而言,慢思考最該用在感知本身,而非更複雜的控制邏輯。
radar.title: Question-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Multimodal Visual Question Answering
radar.title_zh: Q-Guide:問題引導的證據擷取用於多模態視覺問答

links.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib

evidence: Abstract: 'All six judge models evaluated recover the reviewers' preference well above chance, from 80.8% to 63.5%, and two open-weight judges reach roughly 70% at a tenth of the best judge's cost.'
Table 1: six judges (three closed, three open) on 218-pair test split, three replicates, 95% CIs from clustered bootstrap over declarations and replicates; costs from published list rates.

Section 0.3: judges are noisy — 'Re-running one over the same declarations flips between a fifth and nearly half of its verdicts'; the same ablation gives p=0.34 on one replicate and p=0.006 on another, so single-run intervals overstate significance.
Section 0.2.2: dataset of 218 declaration pairs from Mathlib PRs, dev split of 123 used to tune rubric; curation performed by claude-sonnet-5 reviewing past PRs (potential selection bias).

Section 0.3.1: worked example PR 11640 where the judge searched the repository and marked down library leverage; paper asserts regex/linting could not do this, but no no-tool baseline ablation is reported to quantify tool access's effect.
Abstract footnotes: judge harness (github.com/SJCaldwell/ProofJudge), evaluation dataset and traces (HuggingFace SJCaldwell/proofjudge, proofjudge-eval-traces) released as open-source artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic LLM-as-judge system with tool access that scores Lean 4/Mathlib proof quality beyond kernel-verified correctness, evaluated on a novel 218-pair dataset of real PR revisions against human reviewer preferences. It sits squarely within weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning, LLM-as-judge evaluation) and is not out-of-scope. Novelty is moderate: it builds explicitly on Agent-as-a-Judge and APE-BENCH, with the new contribution being pairwise human-preference alignment on Mathlib revisions plus a tool-grounded, repo-state-aware judge and open dataset. Rigor is solid in statistics (3 replicates, clustered bootstrap CIs, sign test p<1e-5) and unusually honest about judge noise, but lacks a no-tool/judge ablation quantifying tool access's contribution, has no human inter-reviewer agreement baseline, and the dataset was LLM-curated by the same model family that tops the leaderboard (selection/contamination risk). Quantitative claims are supported by Table 1 with per-judge CIs and costs; the noise finding that single-run benchmarks overstate significance is a genuinely useful methodological caveat. Generalizability is limited to formal math library review, though the recipe could transfer to code review. Reproducibility is strong: harness, dataset, and traces are released with named models, budgets (20 tool calls), and cost accounting; rubric weights and prompt text are not shown in-paper.

primary_link.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib

radar.summary: Formal proofs in Lean 4 that pass the kernel's type checker can nonetheless vary widely in quality. We introduce ProofJudge, an agentic LLM-as-judge system that scores formal proof quality along five dimensions beyond correctness: library leverage, automation fit, structural clarity, statement quality, and Mathlib conventions. We evaluate ProofJudge on a novel dataset of 218 declarations drawn from distinct Mathlib PRs. The judge agent is grounded by tool access to the commit the PR is applied t
radar.summary_zh: 在 Lean 4 中能通過核心型別檢查的形式化證明,品質仍可能天差地遠。Mathlib 以人工審查維護程式庫品質,重視 tactic 衛生、引理一般性、證明結構與命名慣例等深層特性,但隨 LLM 生成證明的成本逐年下降,審查負擔日益沉重。本文提出 ProofJudge,一個以工具為基礎的 LLM 評審系統:評審代理可存取 PR 所在的 commit 並查詢 Mathlib 庫狀態,依五個維度(程式庫槓桿運用、自動化契合度、結構清晰度、陳述品質與 Mathlib 慣例)各評 1–10 分後加權成總分。評測集包含來自真實 Mathlib PR 的 218 組宣告對;若評審認為被接受版本優於退回修改的初版,即視為與人類審查者偏好對齊。六個評審模型全數遠高於 50% 隨機基線:claude-sonnet-5 達 80.8%,gemini-3.7-flash 為 75.2%,兩個開放權重模型 muse-glimmer-30b 與 inkling-small 約 70%,成本僅約最佳模型的十分之一。作者也誠實指出評審雜訊偏高:重跑同一模型會翻轉五分之一到近半的判定,單次執行的信賴區間會掩蓋此現象,故單跑版本的比較不宜過度解讀。未來方向包括拆分評審、將工具呼叫預算視為可調參數,以及以 ProofJudge 作為 RL 獎勵訊號,顯示證明的可讀性與可維護性對語言模型代理並非不可判讀,有望減輕 Mathlib 維護者的負擔。
radar.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib
radar.title_zh: ProofJudge:以工具為基礎的 LLM 評審方法評估 Mathlib 形式化證明品質

links.title: Loreley: Repository-Scale Program Evolution with Quality-Diversity Search

evidence: Abstract: 'Neither contrast established a QD advantage; Sequential had the highest observed 48-job mean and median.'

Section 4.1: 'We ran seven paired blocks on one Linux ARM64 host... initialized only from the same frozen root and given 48 attempted physical candidate jobs'; planning used gpt-5.6-sol, coding gpt-5.6-luna.
Section 5.1: paired QD effect +0.320% vs Independent Root (BCa [-0.082,+0.686]%, Holm p=.375) and -0.135% vs Sequential ([−0.556,+0.161]%, Holm p=.547); 'Neither paired interval excludes zero.'

Section 7: 'RHO's HELIX optimizer is a direct repository-level antecedent'; 'Our claim is therefore not priority for repository-level evolution, agent mutation, learned QD descriptors, or per-cell Pareto retention.'
Section 8: 'The matched comparison covers one repository, one pair of GPT routes, one Linux ARM64 host, and seven blocks.'

Section 9: 'Loreley is released under Apache-2.0' with zstd_formal_records. and zstd_formal_treatment. and a validator that 'replays the winner rule'; but 'The public record omits prompts, private paths, hidden corpus contents, and candidate source from the formal study.'
Section 5.2: engagement evidence — 'Four of seven final QD winners had a non-incumbent state in their primary-parent ancestry'; paper notes this is 'not an estimate of causal benefit.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core methodology is LLM coding-agent search over Git repositories (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, Code 2.0; GPT-5.6-sol/luna routes as variation operators, lineage with ELM/FunSearch/AlphaEvolve), giving solid preference relevance, though the LLM itself is a fixed component rather than the object of study. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes RHO/HELIX and CktEvo as close antecedents and claims only the configured runtime plus a matched mechanism-vs-endpoint study. Rigor is a strength: preregistered primary endpoint, 7 paired blocks, BCa intervals, exact sign-flip tests with Holm correction, finalist-width sensitivity, leave-one-out checks, and honest separation of engagement from efficacy. Evidence honestly supports a null result (no QD advantage at 48 jobs) but is limited by one repository, one host, one GPT-route pair, and n=7 blocks; capability cases include post-hoc selection qualifications. Generalizability is explicitly narrow per the paper's own Limitations. Reproducibility is good (Apache-2.0 release, treatment/record JSON, validator, seeds) but prompts and candidate source are omitted from the public record. Overall a carefully executed, honestly reported negative-result systems paper.

primary_link.title: Loreley: Repository-Scale Program Evolution with Quality-Diversity Search

radar.summary: Sequential agent search accumulates changes from its current champion but discards alternative branches; independent proposals preserve breadth but restart from the root. Loreley instead retains complete repository states in a Quality-Diversity (QD) archive and samples them as parents or supplies them as context for later edits. Candidates are Git commits produced in isolated worktrees and judged by a project-supplied evaluator. We compare configured Loreley QD, sequential champion editing, and
radar.summary_zh: 在成熟的軟體儲存庫中,效能補丁是與既有型別、測試與介面互動的跨檔案變更,有用的儲存庫狀態極為稀疏。程式代理雖能提出連貫修改,但選擇下一輪編輯脈絡的政策至關重要:序列冠軍搜尋集中預算於最佳狀態,獨立根提議保留廣度卻無法跨代累積改進。Loreley 以 Quality-Diversity 檔案保存完整 Git 儲存庫狀態,以 PCA 化的儲存庫嵌入分配至 MAP-Elites 網格,每格保留有界 Pareto 前沿,並可取用保留狀態作為父代或靈感脈絡。作者執行配對的 Zstandard 實驗:七個配對區塊、每政策每區塊 48 個實體候選工作。結果顯示 QD 相對獨立根的配對效果為 +0.320%(95% BCa 區間含零),相對序列冠軍為 −0.135%,皆未確立優勢;序列冠軍有最高的 48 工作平均與中位數。不過譜系記錄證實檔案確實保留非現任狀態並於後續取樣,七個最終贏家中四個的祖先含非現任狀態,滿足機制啟用條件,但啟用不等於終點效益。三次較早的能力戰役(markdown-it-py +6.75%、pathspec +25.14%、Zstandard +1.234%)展示系統可產出第四代多檔案改進。限制包括僅單一儲存庫、48 工作地平線可能太短,且未個別隔離描述子與取樣元件的效應。本文價值在於嚴謹區分「政策啟用」與「政策成效」並公開負結果。

links.title: Where Grounding Accuracy Lives on the IoU Curve: Label-Free Inference-Time Boundary Refinement

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: task is referring expression grounding with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B VLM; LFPR is a label-free inference-time refinement (two components: predicted-small routing to 4,194,304-pixel budget and guarded crop re-grounding with midpoint fusion).

Section 2: LFPR positioned against coarse-to-fine cascades, test-time self-correction ('self-correction mirage'), EGG, TTSP, and Chain-of-Caption; admits at most one crop attempt and geometry-only accept/reject as the differentiators.
Section 4.4: 10,000 image-cluster bootstrap replicates, two-sided percentile 95% CIs, Holm correction families per table; Section 6.1 and 6.2 explicitly demote Ref-L4 results to retrospective status.

Table 1 / Section 5: three evidence tiers - Ref-L4 31,921 rows (+1.194 Acc@0.5, CI [0.944,1.439]; +5.354 Acc@0.9), frozen RefCOCO transfer 30,969 rows (+0.817 Acc@0.5, Acc@0.9 null -0.029), prospective image-disjoint Flickr30K merged-box (+0.815 Acc@0.5, +1.022 Acc@0.9).

Table 11/12 and Appendix B.3: genuine unguarded negative control recomputed from the same stored candidates underperforms the incumbent on every metric (-2.926 Acc@0.5, -5.748 Acc@0.9); routing alone gains +1.162 Acc@0.9 while crop/guard/fusion marginal effect is -1.192, explaining the pooled strict-IoU null.

Section 5.3 / Table 31: LFPR applied to released EGM-4B/8B specialists improves every endpoint (Acc@0.9 +1.569/+6.716) at ~2x latency (Tables 20/30), but the refined generalist still trails the 4B specialist at Acc@0.5 by -0.694.

Section 6.2 limitation 4 and Appendix B.13: operator-effect evidence covers one architecture family; cross-family checkpoints (GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking, Qwen2.5-VL-7B) were screened only at the direct-answer stage and not carried into the full pipeline.
Appendix D.5 and D.6: two documented errata (silently discarded pixel budget override; Mean IoU reported against the wrong arm) with re-measured results - unusually transparent provenance accounting.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix A: public code URL, verbatim prompts, Algorithm 1 pseudocode, SHA-256 per-row artifact manifest (Table 5), environment pinning, and a 128/128 byte-identical determinism check (Appendix A.2).
Appendix B.14: no head-to-head runs against the closest training-free baselines (Chain-of-Caption, EGG, TTSP), justified only by code/backbone incompatibility checks rather than empirical comparison.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A vision-language grounding paper (frozen Qwen3-VL-8B on referring expression benchmarks), so it matches the Multimodal AI preference and touches test-time/inference-efficiency topics, but it has no LLM-language, reasoning, or agent methodology, keeping preference relevance moderate; it is not pure CV since the task is language-conditioned VLM grounding. The core mechanism (resolution routing + crop re-ground + geometric guards + midpoint fusion) is a simple composition of known ideas, with the IoU-threshold-profile framing and the routing-vs-crop separability finding as the main novel analytical contributions. Rigor and reproducibility are unusually strong: paired image-cluster bootstrap with Holm correction throughout (Sec 4.4), genuine unguarded ablation, confidence-gate mechanism control, placement/self-consistency controls, published errata for two bugs (Appendix D.5, D.6), verbatim prompts, pseudocode, artifact hashes, and released code. Evidence is broad (three tiers, specialists, cost audits) but bounded: no head-to-head with closest training-free baselines (Appendix B.14), and the operator effect is tested on one architecture family with cross-family checkpoints screened out (Sec 6.2, Appendix B.13). The shipped policy is honestly shown to be non-dominant (guarded replacement beats it on the primary endpoint, Appendix D.2) and crop/guard/fusion adds nothing beyond routing on Flickr30K (Sec 5.4).

primary_link.title: Where Grounding Accuracy Lives on the IoU Curve: Label-Free Inference-Time Boundary Refinement

radar.summary: Vision--language models can identify the correct referent while returning an imprecise bounding box. We study whether a frozen direct-answer model can use its own prediction to allocate one additional localized observation without accessing target annotations at inference. Label-free precision refinement (LFPR) routes predicted-small regions to a higher-resolution pass, re-grounds the expression inside a context crop, admits a candidate only under fixed geometric guards, and returns a fixed coor
radar.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型在 referring expression grounding 中常能選對參照物,卻回傳過於粗糙的邊界框,而單看 Acc@0.5 會掩蓋嚴格閾值下的差異。本文研究一個狹義問題:凍結的直接回答模型能否在不接觸標註的前提下,利用自身預測分配一次額外的局部觀察。所提 LFPR 管線以像素面積將預測框分桶,僅將「小目標」路由至高解析度二次推理;在放大的脈絡裁剪內重新定位;以縮放一致性、IoU 與面積比三重幾何守衛決定是否接納候選;最後取座標中點融合。在 31,921 條 Ref-L4 上,mAcc 由 72.947% 升至 76.013%,Acc@0.9 由 55.788% 升至 61.142%;凍結轉移至 RefCOCO 族改善 Acc@0.5、mAcc 與平均 IoU,但 Acc@0.9 持平——路由本身帶來 +1.162 點,卻被裁剪與守衛的 −1.192 點抵銷。前瞻性的 Flickr30K Entities 測試改善所有端點;套用到兩個已釋出的專家模型 EGM-4B/8B 也全面提升,其中 8B 的 Acc@0.9 增加 6.716 點。真正的無守衛對照在所有指標上皆不如原模型,證明守衛是承重元件。作者強調選參照與邊界精準度部分可分,建議以完整閾值輪廓而非單一 Acc@0.5 報告結果。限制包括 Ref-L4 估計屬回溯性質、推論延遲約加倍,且與專家模型的比較未完全等化運算成本。

links.title: FL-MAESTRO: Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Federated Learning

evidence: Abstract: 'matches the accuracy of the strongest energy-aware baseline while cutting wasted round energy from over a third to near zero'; code at https://github.com/denoslab/FL-MAESTRO

Section IV-B/IV-C: three specialist LLM agents with shared cost/feasibility tools; Coordinator emits typed JSON; non-LLM Validator enforces battery eligibility, aggregator capability, weight normalization, epoch bounds with clipping repair
Section V-B, Table I: FLM-Coupled best_acc 0.657 (hard) / 0.615 (extreme) vs ResourceAware 0.651 / 0.598; waste 3.9%/0.2% vs FedAvg 33.5%/42.6%; USD/run $0.28
Section V-C: paired one-sided t-test t=0.32 (p=0.39), 'we report this as directional consistency rather than statistical significance and leave an extended-seed study as future work'
Section V-D: 'simpler failure-aware baselines that consume F(r) would attain comparable round-energy efficiency'; Table III shows FLM-Coupled++ (0.640) does not beat FLM-Coupled (0.648) on hard
Section V-E: heterogeneous-schema deployability is 'an architectural argument rather than a measured result'; scaling beyond 30 clients open due to prompt-context budget
Section V-A: simulation-only setup, N=30 clients, CIFAR-10 CNN of 545,098 parameters, three seeds, backends GPT-4.1-mini (API) and Qwen3.5-35b (Ollama on DGX Spark)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: the core contribution is LLM multi-agent orchestration (three specialist agents, coordinator, typed-JSON structured output, tool-grounded analysis, non-LLM validator) applied to per-round federated learning decisions, matching the highest-weighted Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: joint runtime orchestration of topology/resources/aggregation is a plausible step beyond T-ELLM, Helmsman, and ComAgent, but the mechanism reducing wasted energy is largely deterministic exclusion of predicted-failure clients, which the authors themselves concede simpler baselines could match (Section V-D). Rigor is mixed: good baseline coverage (FedAvg/FedProx/FedNova/q-FedAvg/FedLE/ResourceAware/RuleBasedJoint) and a thoughtful structural ablation, but simulation-only, 30 clients, one small CNN on CIFAR-10, three seeds, and accuracy gains that the authors report as statistically non-significant (p=0.39). Evidence strength is limited by N=3 seeds, directional-only accuracy claims, and the self-acknowledged confound, though tables report SDs, failure rates, and USD/run costs. Generalizability is weak: single dataset/model, one client-schema testbed, and the heterogeneous-device benefit is explicitly 'an architectural argument rather than a measured result' with scaling beyond 30 clients open. Reproducibility is decent: public code link, full hyperparameters, energy constants, seeds, and specified backends (GPT-4.1-mini, self-hosted Qwen3.5-35b via Ollama), though LLM nondeterminism and simulation-only energy accounting temper this.

primary_link.title: FL-MAESTRO: Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Federated Learning

radar.summary: In Federated Learning (FL), the communication topology is a runtime variable rather than a fixed design choice, since links and edge devices drop in and out during training. Each round, the server must commit three coupled decisions, namely the communication topology, per-client resource allocation, and the aggregation rule for combining local updates. Recent agentic systems have begun bringing large language models (LLM) into FL, but the existing line of work either operates at setup time or ha
radar.summary_zh: 聯邦學習在真實邊緣部署中,通訊連結與裝置狀態每輪都在變動,伺服器須同時決定通訊拓撲、逐客戶端資源分配與聚合規則三個耦合決策;傳統方法如 FedAvg、FedProx 僅調整聚合權重,將電力瀕臨耗盡的「預測失敗」客戶端納入輪次,導致其在訓練與上傳後即被丟棄,浪費超過三分之一的輪次能量。本文提出 FL-MAESTRO,一個多代理 LLM 編排器:TopologyAgent、ResourceAgent 與 AggregationAgent 各以領域工具推論,交換型別化約束分析後由協調者合成單一決策,再由非 LLM 的驗證器強制可行性(電池、聚合器能力、權重正規化),不可行決策會被修復而非崩潰。在 Dirichlet 非 IID 的 CIFAR-10 模擬(30 個客戶端、困難與極端兩情境)中,FL-MAESTRO-Coupled 達到最高準確率,同時把浪費輪次能量從 FedAvg 的 33.5%–42.6% 壓至接近零;改用自架的開放權重 Qwen3.5-35b 亦能重現雲端模型表現,免除雲端依賴。消融顯示輕量協作即足夠:加入談判或多閾值失敗探測並無準確率增益,因為動作空間小且有外部驗證器。限制為純模擬、規模僅 30 客戶端、單一 profile 結構,且準確率優勢在三個種子下僅具方向一致性而非統計顯著,數千客戶端的擴充仍待階層式分解。

links.title: Frequency-Aware Continual Learning for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Large Language Models

evidence: Sec VII-C, Table IV: FA-LoRA reaches 0.8185 Micro-F1 at 1B (tying QLoRA 0.8185, below WaRA 0.8398) and 0.8424 at 3B (above LoRA 0.8370 and QLoRA 0.8365 but below WaRA 0.8515) with 2.62M trainable parameters, partially supporting the abstract's superiority claim.

Sec VII-F, Table VI: FAR backward evaluation matrix rows average (0.7128+0.7171+0.8935+0.8854)/4 = 0.8022, internally consistent with the claimed average Micro-F1; task_A shows the largest forgetting (-0.0367).

Sec VII-E, Table V: APPM attains ΔInd +2.7% with 156 ms merge time and 0.0 CPU delta, versus Simple-Mean +5.5%, TIES +5.5%, DARE +7.9%; however the CL comparison in Sec VII-D ('outperforming all five baselines') is reported only via Fig. 5 without per-baseline numbers.

Sec VII-A, Table II: complete hyperparameters (rank r=16, γ=0.2, replay buffer 2,000, FAR temperature τ=2.0, APPM ρ=1.0), LLaMA-3.2-1B base with 4-bit NF4, and the DIVE benchmark (22,330 contracts, K=4 temporal tasks); no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere.

Sec VII-G: sensitivity analysis over 27 experiments shows ρ is the only impactful hyperparameter (+3.07% from 0.0 to 1.0, monotonic), while r, γ, and τ vary by ≤0.0041, supporting robustness claims but on a single dataset and model family.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology-centric LLM paper (frequency-domain LoRA adaptation, loss-dynamics prioritized replay, adapter merging) applied to smart contract vulnerability detection, giving solid coverage of LLM, training/PEFT, efficiency, and code-security preferences, though with no reasoning, agentic, or alignment relevance. Novelty is incremental: FA-LoRA adds learnable gates and high-frequency top-k selection on top of FourierFT/FouRA, FAR resembles prior prioritized-replay ideas, and APPM is an anchor-weighted variant of existing merging. Experimental coverage is fairly comprehensive (seven PEFT baselines at 1B/3B scales, CL and merging baselines, component ablations, 27-run sensitivity), but central CL and merging results appear only in figures without numeric tables, there are no significance tests or seeds, and evaluation is confined to one dataset (DIVE) and one model family, limiting generalizability. Internal consistency is strong (Table VI row averages reproduce the claimed 0.8022; APPM 0.8085 matches the +2.7% gap in Table V), yet the abstract overclaims 'consistently outperforming' LoRA/QLoRA despite an exact tie with QLoRA at 1B and WaRA scoring higher at both scales. Reproducibility is aided by a full hyperparameter table and public dataset/model but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Frequency-Aware Continual Learning for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Large Language Models

First, new vulnerability categories demand parameter-efficient adaptation, since full retraining is prohibitive for sequentially arriving tasks. Second, training per-task adapters on a shared backbone causes catastrophic forgetting of previously learned vulnerabilities. Third, the resulting multiplicity of adapters must be consolidated into a single model, since task identity is unkno
radar.summary_zh: 智慧合約漏洞檢測面對持續演化的攻擊型態,LLM 檢測器須依序學習新類別、避免災難性遺忘,並在部署時合併為單一模型,三個難題環環相扣。本文提出三階段管線:第一階段以 FA-LoRA 在傅立葉域進行低秩調適,透過可學習的頻率閘門與稀疏高頻選擇,僅需 0.4% 可訓練參數即勝過 LoRA 與 QLoRA;第二階段的 Forget-Aware Replay(FAR)利用頻率閘門與損失動態估計每個樣本的遺忘風險,以溫度縮放的 softmax 優先重播高風險知識;第三階段的 Anchor-Protected Progressive Merging(APPM)利用 FAR 訓練產生的不對稱泛化,選出泛化最強的 adapter 作為錨點,以錨點保護的加權合併與頻域閘門競爭,將所有任務 adapter 合併為單一模型。在 DIVE 基準(22,330 個真實合約、8 類多標籤漏洞、依時間切成四個任務)上,以 LLaMA-3.2-1B 為骨幹,FAR 達平均 Micro-F1 0.8022,APPM 合併後為 0.8085,距各任務獨立訓練的上限僅 2.7%,合併成本 156 毫秒且無額外推論記憶體。敏感度分析顯示錨點保護係數 ρ 是唯一關鍵超參數,秩與頻率保留比皆相當穩健。限制在於重播式 CL 對最早任務取樣不足,遺忘仍集中於 task_A。此框架為區塊鏈安全的持續學習部署提供從依序訓練到統一推論的端到端解方。

links.title: FlavourBench: Executable Culinary Reward Maps for Language Model Evaluation and Post-Training

evidence: Abstract: 'We evaluate 27 frontier endpoints on the same 534 substitution, pairing, and constraint tasks, yielding 14418 complete observations'

Section 2.1: 'The original training run, seed, and source revision for this runtime were not recovered... We therefore use it as a fixed reference function, not as independently established culinary truth'

Section 3.4 / Table 3: 'Every one of the 351 model pairs uses the same 534 tasks. Two-sided anchor-cluster sign-flip tests use 100000 Monte Carlo draws and Holm correction'; Grok 4.6 point estimate 65.1 with 'corrected evidence does not identify a unique best endpoint'

Section 5 / Table 8: 'Epicure SFT... improves its score on 84 anchor-disjoint maps by 13.30 points over a format- and label-matched control (95% CI 6.52–20.29, p=1.70e-4)', with base parsing only 89.29% vs 100% for trained arms

Section 8 (Limitations): 'FlavourBench Score measures agreement with a released reward map, not universal human taste'; Recipe1MSubs 'neither validates the unrecovered primary runtime nor tests the pairing and constraint components'; transfer study 'uses LoRA SFT of one 0.6B checkpoint over three seeds'

Section 6 (Reproducibility): content-addressed release including 'all response records... raw text... parser output, task score, and digest', exact routes (Appendix A), and 'a verifier and asset builder that reconstruct the leaderboard CSV... from local files without provider access'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation and post-training paper (27 frontier LLM endpoints, LoRA SFT of Qwen3-0.6B), so it is not a capped pure-domain application, but its culinary testbed is niche: tasks reduce to selecting 3-of-8 ingredients against a learned embedding reward map, and the paper itself concedes the score 'measures agreement with a released culinary reward map, not universal human taste' and is 'not evidence of... general language-model ability'. Methodologically the work is unusually rigorous: preregistered score-blind task selection, simultaneous max-t bands, Holm-corrected paired sign-flip tests over all 351 contrasts, panel replication, roster/metric/weight/reward-map sensitivity analyses, and a format-matched SFT control that cleanly separates syntax learning from reward learning (+13.30 on 84 anchor-disjoint tasks, 95% CI 6.52–20.29). Evidence strength is tempered by the authors' admission that the primary Epicure runtime's training provenance was unrecovered and that Recipe1MSubs validation shares corpus ancestry, so the reward surface is a reference function rather than validated ground truth. Generalizability is explicitly limited (one 0.6B model, one environment, SFT only). The described content-addressed release with raw responses, route manifests, and offline verifiers is exemplary for reproducibility. Relevance to core LLM preferences is genuine but modest: evaluation/benchmark methodology and SFT training dominate, with little bearing on reasoning, agents, or safety.

primary_link.title: FlavourBench: Executable Culinary Reward Maps for Language Model Evaluation and Post-Training

radar.summary: Open-ended language-model evaluation often substitutes another model or a small preference panel for a missing answer key. We introduce FlavourBench, which instead compiles dense answer maps from a versioned culinary environment. Each task asks for a three-ingredient portfolio from eight candidates; before inference, Epicure scores all 56 portfolios. We evaluate 27 frontier endpoints on the same 534 substitution, pairing, and constraint tasks, yielding 14,418 complete model-task observations. An
radar.summary_zh: 開放式語言模型評測常以另一個模型當評審,或依賴少量人類偏好,導致評審與受測系統糾纏。FlavourBench 改走可執行環境路線:從版本化的 Epicure 料理環境編譯出稠密答案地圖,每題從八種食材中選三種,推論前即窮舉 56 個合法組合並凍結 0–100 分數,答案以查表評分,無需模型評審。面板涵蓋 27 個前沿端點與 534 道替換、配對、飲食約束任務,共 14,418 個完整觀測;任務篩選、分數地圖與執行路徑皆在檢視分數前以雜湊凍結。Grok 4.6 點估計最高(65.1),但 351 個成對比較中僅 101 個在 Holm 校正後顯著,同時信賴區間顯示資料無法確立唯一最佳;排序在獨立編譯的雙面板、替代指標與三個公開 Epicure 檢查點下皆大致複製,公開檢查點在人類觀察的 Recipe1MSubs 替代標籤上也高於機會基準。預註冊的三種子後訓練研究顯示:對 Qwen3-0.6B 施以 Epicure 最優答案的 LoRA SFT,在 84 個錨點不相交的保留地圖上比格式對照組高 13.30 分(95% CI 6.52–20.29),公開地圖複製 +11.73 分,證明學到的是獎勵函數而非答案格式。限制包括分數衡量的是與釋出獎勵地圖的一致性而非普世人類味覺,主要運行時的原始訓練來源未復原,且傳遞研究僅測 SFT 與單一 0.6B 模型。
radar.title: FlavourBench: Executable Culinary Reward Maps for Language Model Evaluation and Post-Training
radar.title_zh: FlavourBench:用於語言模型評測與後訓練的可執行料理獎勵地圖

links.title: LoRA-GA$^2$: Low Rank Adaptation with Multi-step Gradient Adaptive Alignment

evidence: Abstract: LoRA-GA2 'surpasses the leading baseline by an average of 0.66 points on the GLUE benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 1.03 points on GSM8K and 0.87 points on HumanEval' — consistent with Table 1 (88.62 vs GoRA 87.96) and Table 2 (73.94 vs 72.91; 49.85 vs 48.98).

§5/Table 4: key ablations — one-step gradient 72.13±0.34 vs full 73.94±0.48 on GSM8K; 'No SVD init.' drops to 68.92±0.12; 'Effective rank only' 73.51±0.51 and 'No rank alloc.' 72.40±1.32, indicating rank-allocation gains overlap with seed noise.
§5: probe overhead quantified — '5 minutes 55.83 seconds with 108,019 MB peak GPU memory' vs training '31 minutes 14.4 seconds with 137,695 MB', supporting the low-overhead claim.
§4.1: fair-comparison protocol — 'We use the same optimizer settings as the corresponding baselines' and 'Each experiment is repeated using three different random seeds.'

Appendix A.2: probe protocol details (fixed LR 5e-5, weights restored, data loader restarted so probe batches may be reused) and Appendix B propositions (e.g., Prop. 5 trajectory-vs-static bias, Prop. 10 descent guarantee) are stylized but explicit.

§6: acknowledged limitations — 'the probe introduces a small extra probing phase' and 'the current method uses a global exponent λ for all layers and tasks'; no code repository or release is mentioned anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/PEFT methodology paper: multi-step gradient probing (AdaLomo look-ahead with weight restoration), dual sensitivity/effective-rank allocation, and SVD initialization for LoRA, evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B (GSM8K/HumanEval), T5 (GLUE), and CLIP. Directly relevant to LLM fine-tuning and training-efficiency preferences, though it touches no highest-weight topics (no agents, reasoning methods, Japanese NLP, or RAG; reasoning tasks are evaluation-only). Novelty is incremental: it extends LoRA-GA/GoRA/RaLoRA by combining their known ingredients (gradient init, sensitivity, effective rank) plus a trajectory probe. Rigor is good: matched baseline optimizer settings (§4.1), 3 seeds with std devs, budget-matched one-step ablation (§5), appendix propositions. Evidence is internally consistent (+0.66 GLUE, +1.03 GSM8K, +0.87 HumanEval all match Tables 1-2) but component ablations are partially within noise: 'Effective rank only' 73.51±0.51 vs full 73.94±0.48 on GSM8K (Table 4), and 'No rank alloc.' (72.40) underperforms both single-signal variants, so the allocation contribution is weakly supported; the main driver is multi-step vs one-step (1.81 pts). Generalizability is supported across three architectures/modalities but only small ranks (r_ref=8). Reproducibility is moderate: detailed pseudocode, hyperparameters, probe protocol and γ-selection criterion (Appendix A), but no code release is stated. Limitations (extra probe phase, global λ) are honestly acknowledged (§6).

primary_link.title: LoRA-GA$^2$: Low Rank Adaptation with Multi-step Gradient Adaptive Alignment

radar.summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a prominent fine-tuning method for large models, achieving competitive performance with reduced memory overhead. However, a persistent performance gap remains between LoRA and full fine-tuning. Recent studies have sought to narrow this gap by employing one-step gradient approximations of pretrained weights to align LoRA updates with the principal directions or intrinsic dimensionalities of full fine-tuning updates. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to capture the
radar.summary_zh: LoRA 雖高效,與全量微調之間仍有持久差距。以單步梯度對齊的方法(如 LoRA-GA、GoRA、LoRA-One)只捕捉初始檢查點的梯度,過於短視;LoRA-Pro 等持續多步對齊則須修改最佳化器、大幅增加 GPU 記憶體與訓練時間。本文提出 LoRA-GA²,在訓練前以 AdaLomo 作為輕量探針:沿實際最佳化軌跡累積 64 步的多步梯度(梯度在 CPU 累積、權重事後還原),零永久記憶體開銷、僅約六分鐘時間成本。接著以頻譜感知的雙指標進行秩分配:敏感度 avg(|W₀⊙G|) 衡量層對任務的重要性,有效秩(奇異值譜的熵)衡量需要多少方向,兩者相乘確保只有「既重要且譜分散」的層獲得高秩,並以平方根形狀因子避免寬層壟斷預算。初始化則對累積梯度做截斷 SVD,以負梯度主方向構成受控的低秩暖啟動,並以 σ₁γ 正規化控制初始擾動幅度。實驗涵蓋 GLUE(T5-Base)、GSM8K 與 HumanEval(Llama-3.1-8B)及 CLIP 影像分類:平均分別為 88.62、73.94、49.85 與 91.16,超越最強基線 GoRA 0.66、1.03、0.87 與 0.63 點,在 GSM8K 上甚至超過全量微調。消融顯示多步梯度與 SVD 初始化各自必要,與「同樣批次數的單步估計」對照證明收益來自跟隨早期軌跡而非單純平均更多批次。限制是探針階段的額外時間與全域指數 λ 未自適應。
radar.title: LoRA-GA$^2$: Low Rank Adaptation with Multi-step Gradient Adaptive Alignment

links.title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents

evidence: Abstract: terminal form 'converges to three elements: a generalized database, a large model, and an agent' with conditions 'expressible, verifiable, externally stateful, and tool-complete'.

Section V-F, Table III: SQLite prototype with UNIQUE(machine, slot) and BEFORE INSERT trigger rejects 16/33/45 violating proposals at epsilon=0.1/0.2/0.3; ~1.1 ms per 200 operations; planner is a 'deliberately noisy scheduler', i.e., simulated model.
Section V-G, Table V: live Qwen-Plus on 3x3 job shop, 20 trials, 'zero of them were feasible', all 20 rejected by storage constraints; single model, small instance, no prompt details reported.
Table VI: tool-using agent requests solver in 10/10 trials and reports correct makespan (9) every time; n=10, one model.
Table VII: fault injection shows a single forgotten capacity check leaks in hand-written code while declarative storage constraints enforce; authors concede declarative constraints are not novel.
Section VI-C: acknowledges the tool-boundary dilemma ('completeness and closedness cannot both hold'), a candid limitation.

Artifact Availability: prototype and scripts at github.com/kyloTyn/software-form-convergence; deterministic experiments depend only on Python and OR-Tools; live experiments require DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; prompts, model version, and decoding parameters not documented.
Section II-E: authors position contribution as unifying four existing strands 'at the macro level of software form', conceding the components are established.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A position/vision paper squarely in scope for LLM-agent architecture (Software 3.0, LLM OS, storage-model-agent convergence), not a domain application. Topical fit is strong (agents, tool use, LLMs, DB+AI), but the core thesis is largely a synthesis of prior strands (Karpathy's LLM OS, DBOS, ReAct, MemGPT) with a modest framing contribution (expressibility x criticality three-way split of business logic; storage as arbiter of consistency). Empirical support is real but minimal: a SQLite constraint prototype with a simulated noisy planner (Table III), toy CP-SAT job-shop solves (Table IV), a single live model (Qwen-Plus) on a 3x3 job shop with 20/10 trials and no prompt/decoding details (Tables V-VI), and a small fault-injection comparison (Table VII). The 100% catch-rate result is near-tautological given declarative constraints. Strengths: unusually honest boundary analysis (Sections VI-VII), falsifiability discussion (Section VIII-B), artifact repo with deterministic OR-Tools experiments. Weaknesses: no baselines against real hand-written systems, no statistical treatment, macro thesis untested beyond one toy domain.

primary_link.title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents

radar.summary: Software form has undergone two paradigm shifts since its inception: Software 1.0, in which instructions determine behavior, and Software 2.0, in which data determines behavior (machine learning). This paper argues that a third shift - Software 3.0, in which context and reasoning determine behavior - is now underway, and contends that its terminal form converges to three elements: a generalized database (the unified abstraction of all persistent state and memory), a large model (the intelligence
radar.summary_zh: 本文主張軟體形態正經歷第三次重構：在 Software 3.0 中，行為由脈絡與推理決定，傳統三層架構將收斂為三要素——廣義資料庫、大型模型與代理。作者逐層論證：使用者介面層會被模型按需生成介面的能力吸收；業務邏輯層沿「可表達性×關鍵性」重新切分為模型推理、沉入儲存層的宣告式約束，以及保留為受控工具的殘餘確定性程式碼；唯有資料層升格為唯一具持久性、可稽核與交易保證的基礎設施。文中提出最小參考架構，以 Python 與 SQLite 實作排程原型：即使模擬規劃器的錯誤率高達三成，儲存層約束仍拒絕所有違規提案，維持排程可行；以 Qwen-Plus 直接排程 20 次全數違反機器互斥與先序約束，但被儲存層 100% 攔截，委派 CP-SAT 求解器工具則全數正確。論文同時劃定邊界：確定性與正確性、效能與成本、安全與法遵、可驗證性與幻覺四類限制界定其適用域，命題僅在可表達、可驗證、具外部狀態且工具完備的領域成立，並為開發者角色與資料庫產業提供可否證的預測框架。

links.title: Discrete Diffusion Inference-Time Control with Nested Sequential Monte Carlo

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: with N=4, M=8, K=4, lambda=10, NSMC and FA-NSMC reach toxicity 0.39/0.40 and PPL 42.3/42.9 vs bootstrap SMC 0.25/49.0, BoN 0.022/55.5, base MDLM 0.003/85.3.

Section 4.1: experiments use the publicly released MDLM checkpoint (12 transformer blocks, 768 hidden units, GPT-2 tokenizer, T=50 diffusion steps) on 15 prompts x 10 continuations = 150 generations, with a public RoBERTa toxicity classifier and a holdout xlmr-large classifier (footnoted HuggingFace links).

Section 2 and Figure 2: the prior 'nested SMC' weighting of Uehara et al. (2025) omits the normalization by psi_t*(x_t) implied by G*_t, and Figure 2(a) shows intermediate rewards fail to increase under this biased potential, while Figure 2(b) shows increases with the corrected potentials.

Section 4.2, Tables 3-4: ablations averaged over 10 repetitions show outer particle count N dominates performance, reconstruction count K helps most at small N, and inner proposals M saturate quickly (e.g., FA-NSMC M=16 gives Tox .74/Hold .66 vs M=1 .54/.47).

Section 5: limitations explicitly state only two reward settings on a single base checkpoint, noisy approximate x0 reconstructions, and that broader benchmarks (BOLD, TruthfulQA, HarmBench, MT-Bench) and larger models (Dream-7B, LLaDA) are left to future work.
Appendix C: derivation showing the product of optimal potentials telescopes to exp(lambda r(x0)) over a conditioning constant, establishing correctness of the proposed weighting scheme.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A language-model methodology paper on inference-time reward steering (toxicity/fluency) for pre-trained discrete diffusion LMs via nested SMC, squarely in scope (LLM alignment/safety steering, not an out-of-scope domain). Novelty is moderate: NSMC is borrowed from established computational statistics (Naesseth et al. 2015/2019a); the main new contributions are its adaptation to Feynman-Kac steering for DDLMs and a correction of a bias in Uehara et al. (2025)'s weighting that omits the psi_t*(x_t) denominator (Section 2, Figure 2a). Rigor is solid but small-scale: compute-matched comparisons, ablations over N/M/K and reward-window length, 10-repetition averages, holdout toxicity classifier, and diversity checks, yet only ~150 generations from 15 prompts, no variance/significance reporting. Evidence within scope is consistent and directionally strong (Table 1: toxicity 0.39-0.40 vs 0.25 bootstrap SMC and 0.022 BoN, with lower PPL), and the bias-correction claim is empirically supported. Generalizability is limited: one small MDLM checkpoint (12 blocks, 768 hidden), two rewards, with larger models (Dream-7B, LLaDA) and standard benchmarks (HarmBench, TruthfulQA, MT-Bench) explicitly deferred (Section 5). Reproducibility is good: full pseudocode (Algorithms 1-4), hyperparameters, public MDLM checkpoint and public HuggingFace reward/holdout classifiers; no explicit own-code release. Weighted score ~0.63.

primary_link.title: Discrete Diffusion Inference-Time Control with Nested Sequential Monte Carlo

radar.summary: We study inference-time control for text generation in discrete diffusion language models, where the goal is to steer sampling toward sequence-level rewards without retraining. Prior work in this domain has focused on particle-based methods such as best-of-$n$ sampling and bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo, which may suffer from overoptimism and weight degeneracy, respectively. We address these limitations using \emph{nested} sequential Monte Carlo methods. We formulate nested SMC (NSMC) and full
radar.summary_zh: 離散擴散語言模型（DDLM）透過反覆去噪生成文字，可雙向整合上下文，但如何在不重新訓練的前提下，於推論階段將取樣導向序列層級獎勵（如降低毒性、提升流暢度）仍是難題。既有方法中，best-of-n 取樣在罕見高獎勵區域上效力有限，bootstrap SMC 則受權重退化困擾；近期文獻雖提出「巢狀 SMC」概念，但其加權方案存在系統性偏誤。本文提出正確加權的巢狀序列蒙地卡羅（NSMC）與完全調適版 FA-NSMC，用於 Feynman–Kac 導引：對每個外部粒子以內層蒙地卡羅估計最佳提案分布與預測歸一化常數，內層權重同時用於選出子狀態與更新外層權重，並證明最佳勢函數的累乘可望遠鏡式還原終端獎勵傾斜。在 MDLM 檢查點上，以毒性與困惑度兩項 steering 任務評估，NSMC 與 FA-NSMC 一致優於 best-of-n 與 bootstrap SMC；外層粒子數 N 為主導因素，增加重建數 K 與內層提案數 M 則報酬遞減，FA-NSMC 在長獎勵視窗等困難情境最穩健。限制在於僅測試兩種獎勵與單一模型，且中間勢函數依賴近似的 x0 重建與現成獎勵模型，可能引入變異與雜訊。
radar.title: Discrete Diffusion Inference-Time Control with Nested Sequential Monte Carlo
radar.title_zh: 以巢狀序列蒙地卡羅進行離散擴散模型的推論時期控制

links.title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities

evidence: Abstract: dataset of '349 high-quality action items tied to paper differences', publicly available at github.com/microsoft/Metag-dataset under CDLA-2.0 (Section 1 footnote)

Section 3.1.6: 'Annotators agreed on the exact set of diffs 37% of the time and annotated sets had a mean Jaccard similarity of 50.1%... mean Cohen's kappa of 0.369, indicating fair agreement beyond chance'

Section 4 / Table 3 (Test): 'GPT-5.6-Sol provides the strongest overall test performance, achieving a micro-F1 of .360±.005 and a macro-F1 of .398±.018' vs BM25 micro-F1 .098 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro .261±.021
Section 6 (Limitations): 'Metag is derived exclusively from ICLR 2024' and intermediate review-stage versions 'are not always publicly available'
Appendix E: hyperparameters (LoRA r=8, alpha=16, lr 2e-5; window sweep), 'Eight Nvidia A40 GPUs', total closed-source API cost 'USD 534.57'
NeurIPS Checklist Q5: Answer [No] — 'the final data and code will be released post acceptance', contrasting with the abstract's public-availability claim
Appendix C: 'Eleven annotators... Each data sample was annotated by 2 annotators... Annotators were compensated with co-authorship of the publication'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic/LLM dataset paper: builds a benchmark for meta-review agents (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG-style traceability, NLP, datasets) with LLM-based baselines. Novelty is moderate: the task (selecting manuscript diffs implementing reviewer action items) extends ARIES with a structured-diff formulation, but it is a small-scale dataset contribution (349 samples) over one venue. Rigor is solid for a dataset paper (two-annotator protocol, honest IAA reporting, window-size and retrieval-depth sweeps, 3-run std devs), but gold labels are noisy: exact set agreement 37%, Cohen's kappa 0.369, and the intersection reconciliation may undercount relevant diffs; no significance testing; best F1 ~0.36 leaves the task far from solved. Evidence supports the model-ranking claims from Table 3, but the abstract's 'high-quality' claim sits uneasily with fair IAA. Generalizability is limited (ICLR 2024 only, accepted papers with arXiv preprints, acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility is mixed: public dataset URL and CDLA-2.0 license are stated, prompts/hyperparameters are given, but code and models are only promised post-acceptance (checklist Q5 answers [No]).

primary_link.title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities

radar.summary: AI tools increasingly support tasks across the scientific research cycle, from experiment design and manuscript preparation to peer review. At the same time, the continuing growth in conference submissions has increased the burden on meta-reviewers, who must synthesize reviewer feedback, author rebuttals, and manuscript revisions. To address this concern, this paper introduces Metag, a dataset to accelerate the development of meta-reviewing agents, specifically to identify changes made to scient
radar.summary_zh: 隨著會議投稿量激增，後設審查者必須綜整大量審查意見、作者反駁與修改稿，負擔沉重。本文提出 Metag，一個用於發展代理式後設審查能力的人工標註資料集，目標是自動辨識作者在審查—反駁過程中對論文的實際修改。每筆資料包含審查者關切事項、作者承諾的解決方式，以及對應的稿件差異。建構流程為：自 OpenReview 抓取 ICLR 2024 錄取論文的審查討論，透過 Semantic Scholar 對應 arXiv 投稿前版本與 camera-ready 版本，以 PyMuPDF 與 Git 的 diff 演算法計算 PDF 差異，再以 Gemma-3-27B-IT 萃取行動項目，最後由標註者以互動式介面將 diff 與行動項目配對，取兩位標註者交集保留，共得 349 筆高品質樣本。基準測試顯示 BM25 與 TF-IDF 等詞彙式方法表現不佳，因行動項目描述的是修改意圖而非字面重述；GPT-5.6-Sol 表現最佳，測試集 micro-F1 達 0.360、macro-F1 0.398。限制包括僅涵蓋 ICLR 2024、審查期間的中繼版本不公開，且依賴 arXiv 預印本存在。此資料集有助於提升同儕審查的可追溯性與透明度。
radar.title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities
radar.title_zh: Metag：用以建立代理式後設審查能力的資料集

links.title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP

evidence: Abstract: Aegis 'leverages the reasoning capabilities of large language models to analyze, categorize, and normalize diverse tool invocations into a unified, policy-friendly representation' for MCP resource-abuse enforcement.

Section VII-A: dataset of 937 tool definitions from 56 MCP servers in the OpenTools registry, manually labeled; distribution skewed (869 text, 38 image, 14 location, 10 video, 5 audio, 1 human), 441 resource-sensitive.
Section VII-B / Table II: 3-run mean results with Claude 4 Sonnet — modality accuracy 0.9868, parameter normalization exact match only 0.8321; no baseline systems or ablations reported.

Section VII-C: RQ2 evaluated solely on a custom CIFAR-10 FastMCP server, single get_images tool, 118 benchmark runs on a MacBook Pro M1 Max; Table III shows count=1000 abuse scenario with 196/200 failures unprotected vs 0 with Aegis.
Section VIII: authors concede 'Our evaluation serves as a proof of concept... limited in scope and coverage'; no code, dataset, or artifact availability is claimed anywhere in the paper.
Section II: related-work table of MCP defenses (MCP-Guard, MCP Guardian, MCIP, quotas, rate limiting) used to motivate 'fine-grained, parameter-specific resource controls' as the claimed delta.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic-security systems paper squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use preference (MCP tool calling, structured output, agent misbehavior) with LLMs used as the core reasoning component (Claude 4 Sonnet for ontology identification). The LLM-driven normalization of heterogeneous tool parameters into a reusable policy taxonomy is a sensible, moderately novel contribution over static quota/rate-limiting defenses. Rigor is mixed: a genuinely curated 937-tool dataset with 3-run metrics (Table II), but no baselines, no ablations on prompt components, single model, author-only ground-truth labeling, and a heavily skewed dataset (869/937 text modality, Section VII-A). Evidence for RQ2 rests on one self-built CIFAR-10 FastMCP server, one tool, one abuse scenario on a MacBook Pro (Section VII-C, Table III); the authors themselves call it a 'proof of concept... limited in scope and coverage' (Section VIII). Generalizability claims across heterogeneous servers are asserted but barely validated; no code or dataset release is stated, limiting reproducibility despite detailed prompt and benchmark descriptions.

primary_link.title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP

radar.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open source JSON-RPC protocol that standardizes how large language models (LLMs) interact with external systems through programmatic functions known as tools. Attackers or malicious agents can exploit certain modalities of these MCP tools to degrade the overall quality of service of agent-based applications. For example, an agent may request an excessively large search radius or very long videos, overloading backend systems and potentially causing slowdowns
radar.summary_zh: MCP（Model Context Protocol）已成為大型語言模型代理連接外部工具的標準介面，但攻擊者或失控的代理可透過操弄工具參數（如過大的搜尋半徑、過多高解析度圖片）造成資源耗盡與服務品質劣化。不同模態（文字、影像、視訊、位置）的濫用向量各異，參數命名又不一致，使跨異質 MCP 伺服器制定一致而精細的資源政策極為困難。本文提出 Aegis，一個以 LLM 輔助建立並執行細粒度政策的防護元件。核心是工具本體論：將工具歸類為模態與操作類型，將參數正規化為統一詞彙（如 num_records、resolution），據此產生可重複使用的政策範本，再以負載基準測試在可接受錯誤率下估出閾值。系統分兩階段運作：離線引導階段以 Claude 4 Sonnet 進行本體識別並快取；線上階段整合 Open Policy Agent 與 ContextForge AI Gateway 攔截違規請求。在 937 個工具定義上，模態與操作分類準確率逾 0.97，參數正規化較難（約 0.83）；CIFAR-10 伺服器實驗顯示，啟用 Aegis 後 200 個並發請求全數成功、吞吐量自 1.34 升至 30.03 req/s。惟目前僅為概念驗證，涵蓋範圍有限，串接式工具呼叫的保護仍待發展。
radar.title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP
radar.title_zh: Aegis：防止 MCP 跨網域資源濫用

links.title: LLMs as Acquisition Policies for Finite-Pool Materials Optimization: A Controlled Study

evidence: Section 6 / Table 2: GP-EI achieves lowest mean iterations-to-optimum on 3 of 4 tasks while every whole-pool LLM beats random selection, with means and stds over 25 initializations (random over 1000 seeds).

Section 8.2 / Figure 4: nine of ten anonymized model-protocol configurations still beat random selection; materials-aware prompting lower in eight of ten comparisons, with overlapping CIs in two tournament settings.
Section 8.1 / Figure 3: position bias quantified via KL divergence; DeepSeek-V4-Flash selections concentrate near the list start with almost no picks beyond position 100.
Appendix A (Limitations): pools are at most 921 candidates vs. real campaigns with ~10^8 combinations; whole-pool prompting impractical at scale and tournament calls grow with pool size.

Appendix B.1: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B results use proxy configurations (b=300, b=32) marked * and dagger due to inference cost; models served locally with vLLM, FP8 checkpoints, greedy decoding, thinking disabled.

Appendix C.1/C.2: generation-and-matching underperforms whole-pool and GP-EI on Matbench Steels (123.60 vs 42.72 for GP-EI with Qw27B); CoT and history-management variants excluded for cost/insufficient run length.
Section 5 / Table 1: four tasks (Kerr Rotation 921 candidates, Coercivity 921, Matbench Steels 312, Electrostrain 81) with composition-only and descriptor representations specified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled, honest study of open-weight LLMs (Gemma 4, Qwen3.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) as standalone acquisition policies for finite-pool optimization, squarely LLM-centric (prompting conditions, presentation protocols, position bias) but embedded in a materials-science domain application, which limits alignment with core NLP/LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: LLM-as-optimizer is established (OPRO, LLINBO, BORA cited), but the batch-tournament protocol and diagnostic suite (position-bias KL, UCB-coefficient fitting, anonymized-prompt ablation) are fresh contributions. Rigor is solid: 25 shared initializations, 1000 random seeds, standardized GP-EI baseline with disclosed hyperparameters, batch-size sweeps, and honest disclosure of proxy runs for the largest model. Evidence is credible and appropriately hedged (GP-EI wins 3/4 tasks; LLMs beat random everywhere), though some ablations are single-task and conclusions about 'materials priors' rest on modest mean differences with overlapping CIs in some conditions. Generalizability is explicitly limited to pools of 81-921 candidates. No explicit code release is stated, but prompts, models, checkpoints (FP8, vLLM, greedy decoding), and public datasets are documented.

primary_link.title: LLMs as Acquisition Policies for Finite-Pool Materials Optimization: A Controlled Study

radar.summary: Discovering materials with desirable properties often requires searching large candidate spaces while experimental or computational evaluations remain costly. Active learning addresses this challenge by using previous observations to select which candidate to evaluate next, typically through probabilistic surrogate models. We investigate whether open-weight large language models (LLMs) can serve as standalone acquisition policies in this setting. We evaluate five LLMs across four retrospective f
radar.summary_zh: 在材料科學的主動學習中，高斯過程（GP）搭配 EI 等獲取函數是選點的標準做法。本文探討開源權重 LLM 能否單獨作為有限候選池材料最佳化的獲取策略。研究以四個回顧式基準（Fe-Co-Ni 的 Kerr 旋轉與矯頑力、Matbench Steels 降服強度、Electrostrain 電致應變）評估五個開源模型（Gemma 4 31B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.5 系列），比較全池選擇與批次錦標賽兩種協議，並與隨機選擇及 GP-EI 對照。結果顯示 LLM 策略普遍優於隨機選擇，提供真實但變異大的獲取訊號；GP-EI 在多數任務仍較強，僅 Electrostrain 上多數 LLM 表現較佳，且模型排名跨任務不一致，與模型規模無系統性關聯。診斷實驗發現：加入材料語意脈絡的提示在多數設定有助益，匿名化特徵下 LLM 仍保有最佳化能力，顯示預訓練先驗存在；DeepSeek-V4-Flash 位置偏差最明顯，選點集中於清單開頭；UCB 係數擬合顯示 LLM 決策不像規則的 GP-EI 探索—利用策略。限制包括候選池規模遠小於實際材料探索計畫，且大型模型推論成本高昂；整體而言，LLM 獲取是可信賴的方向，但效能高度取決於任務與候選呈現方式。
radar.title: LLMs as Acquisition Policies for Finite-Pool Materials Optimization: A Controlled Study
radar.title_zh: 以 LLM 作為有限池材料最佳化的獲取策略：控制性研究

links.title: BreakGuard: Towards Detecting Dependency Breaking Changes with LLM-Generated Tests

evidence: Section IV-A Table I: dataset filtered from 571 BUMP breaking changes to 89 final instances across 25 libraries and 31 clients, with each filtering step and removal count listed.

Section V-B Table V: best configuration (GPT-4o, Class context) detects 27 of 89 (30.3%) breaking changes; Qwen3-coder detects 20 (22.5%); detections concentrate in Logging API and JSON Libraries categories.
Section V-A Table IV: best focal-method valid-test coverage is 22.4% (Qwen3-coder, Class); compilation failures average 79.7% of invalid tests, consistent with cited prior work.

Section V-C Tables VI-VII: 3,390 of 3,566 detecting tests (95.1%) end in ERROR; root causes are NoClassDefFoundError (42.5%), NoSuchMethodError (29.0%), ClassNotFoundException (28.5%); only 25 tests use value-based behavioral assertions.

Section VI-A: of 2,111 tests passing on the breaking version, 1,656 (78.4%) never loaded the broken API class; 80 of 455 loaded-but-passing tests manually inspected, revealing silent NOPLogger fallback, swallowed exceptions, and weak inputs.
Section V-D Table IX: median cost per BUMP instance ranges $0.001-$0.088, mean up to $0.90 (GPT-4o Class); OpenRouter price list dated July 26, 2026; tokens counted with model-native tokenizers.

Section VII-C and Section I: claims no prior study evaluated LLM-generated tests for detecting breaking changes from library version updates; EvoSuite/Randoop are cited as comparison points for prior LLM test-generation work but not used as baselines here.

Section VIII Threats to Validity: single-shot prompting by design (lower bound), one sample per focal method so variance unmeasured, Java/Maven-only with Spoon static analysis, static analysis may miss reflective calls.

Section X: implementation and evaluation code on GitHub; all execution data and logs on Zenodo (zenodo.org/records/15547047); BUMP instances run in provided Docker images with -pre and -breaking tags (Section IV-D).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An applied LLM-for-software-engineering study: LLM-generated unit tests (GPT-4o, Qwen3-coder-480B, GPT-OSS-120B) that detect Java dependency breaking changes, squarely matching Code & Programming and LLM preferences, though it advances LLM application rather than LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: the paper credibly claims to be the first evaluation of LLM tests for breaking-change detection (Section VII-C), but the components (LLM test generation, intention-guided prompting from Nan et al., differential execution, BUMP benchmark) are all established. Rigor is solid but incomplete: 9 model-context configurations with temperature=0, two-phase Docker execution with canary validation, transparent 571-to-89 dataset filtering (Section IV-A Table I), and a manually inspected failure sample (Section VI-A), yet there is no baseline comparison against traditional generators (EvoSuite/Randoop are cited in Section VII-C but not run), only one generation sample per prompt, and no significance testing. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent: 30.3% detection (27/89, Table V), 22.4% best focal-method coverage (Table IV), 95.1% of detections as runtime ERRORs vs only 25 behavioral value-oracle tests (Tables VI-VIII), and cost analysis (Table IX). Findings are honestly modest, with the -verbose:class analysis showing 78.4% of passing tests never loaded the broken API class (Section VI-A). Generalizability is limited to Java/Maven and acknowledged as such (Section VIII). Reproducibility is good: public GitHub code, Zenodo replication package, Dockerized benchmark, specified model configs and price date (Section X).

primary_link.title: BreakGuard: Towards Detecting Dependency Breaking Changes with LLM-Generated Tests

radar.summary: Open-source libraries play an important role in software development by providing reusable features that expedite the development process. As libraries evolve, they release new versions that add features, fix bugs, or apply security patches. In this process, they may break the contract established with their clients by introducing breaking changes (BCs) that alter the runtime behavior and break client applications. Client-side test suites often fail to detect these BCs because of limited library
radar.summary_zh: 開源函式庫升級時引入的破壞性變更常因客戶端測試覆蓋不足而未被察覺，直至上線才出錯。本文提出 BreakGuard：以靜態分析萃取客戶端每個呼叫目標函式庫的焦點方法，逐一以 LLM 生成遷移測試套件，若某測試在升級前版本通過、在破壞性版本失敗，即判定偵測到破壞性變更。研究在 BUMP 資料集的 89 個真實案例上，比較 GPT-4o、Qwen3-coder-480B 與 GPT-OSS-120B 三個模型，以及 minimal、method、class 三種上下文層級。最佳設定（GPT-4o 加 class 上下文）偵測 27/89（30.3%）的破壞性變更，每案平均成本約 0.9 美元；class 上下文藉減少編譯錯誤（為主要失敗原因，約占八成）提升有效性。失敗型態分析顯示 95.1% 的偵測為 ERROR，主因是 NoClassDefFoundError、NoSuchMethodError 等缺失類別或方法，行為型變更僅 25 個測試以值斷言捕捉，顯示 LLM 測試擅長崩潰型而弱於行為型破壞。研究也發現 LLM 常以 try-catch 吞掉異常而掩蓋破壞訊號。限制為單次生成、僅 Java/Maven 生態系，且結果具隨機性；未來可結合修復迴圈與相依圖感知的焦點方法篩選以提升偵測率。
