links.title: Natural Language Code Retrieval for 1C:Enterprise: An Open Benchmark and Efficient Bi-Encoder

evidence: §2 Abstract/Contributions: benchmark of 3,413 query-code pairs plus 784,057 synthetic triplets generated by google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it; authors state 'We do not propose a new architecture or loss' (Introduction, contribution list).
§3.4 Table 3: contamination audit reports 0.00% exact pair matches and 22.83% any-13-gram dirty rate on fastcode, decomposed into label-only/input-only/input-and-label.
§6.2 Table 10: paired bootstrap over 10,000 resamples gives Δ+0.106 macro vs deepvk/USER2-base with 95% CI [0.087,0.125], P<0.001; Δ+0.0588 vs embeddinggemma-300m, CI [0.042,0.075].
§6.2 Contamination Sensitivity: removing all exact/13-gram flagged examples yields 0.6011 balanced macro (0.5010 micro); clean-only fastcode 0.7369 vs original 0.7366.
§4.4 Table 6: full training disclosure — 784,057 triplets, batch 256, 3 epochs, lr 2e-5, seed 42, A100, ≈7.5h; §4.2 documents FAISS hard-negative mining formula.

§7 Limitations: single-gold qrels (5/50 manual check show multiple relevant fragments), no FN-rate estimation, LLM-judge screening on only 300 samples without human agreement, rule-based PII scrubbing without measured precision/recall, no multi-seed variance or ANN/latency evaluation.
Table 8: leaderboard — PruhaNLP/USER2-1C-code macro 0.5992 vs embeddinggemma-300m 0.5404 and USER2-base 0.4932; BM25Okapi 0.3099; untuned RRF hurts (0.4300).
Table 12 / §6.4: MRL 256-d retains 99.9% of nDCG@10 at 0.33× index size; end-to-end latency explicitly not measured.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid, well-executed domain resource paper: first open benchmark (3,413 pairs), 784k synthetic triplets, and a domain-tuned bi-encoder for 1C:Enterprise/BSL code retrieval. It squarely matches Code & Programming (w2.0) and RAG/dense-retrieval (w1.8) preferences, with secondary matches in scaling/efficiency (MRL) and datasets, but the top-weight preferences (LLMs as研究对象, reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP) are only tangentially touched since the LLM appears solely as a synthetic-query generator and judge. Novelty is moderate: the authors explicitly state no new architecture or loss (§4.4), and the resource contribution, while genuinely new for an underserved ecosystem, uses standard recipe components (CachedMNRL, hard negatives, MRL). Rigor is above average for this class: contamination audit (§3.4, Table 3), paired-bootstrap significance (Table 10: Δ+0.106, 95% CI [0.087,0.125], P<0.001), contamination-sensitivity re-scoring (0.6011 clean macro), and honest reporting of negative RRF results. Gaps: single-gold qrels, no human validation of synthetic queries, no FN-rate estimation, no multi-seed or reranker/ANN evaluation (§7). Evidence is quantitative and appropriately hedged, but headline metrics rest on one seed and a single-gold protocol that the authors admit can mis-rank alternatives. Generalizability is limited to one niche language/domain; findings (domain adaptation helps, MRL 256-d retains 99.9%) confirm known results rather than extending them. Reproducibility is excellent: all four artifacts are public with identifiers, full hyperparameters, seed, hardware, and runtime disclosed (Table 6).

primary_link.title: Natural Language Code Retrieval for 1C:Enterprise: An Open Benchmark and Efficient Bi-Encoder

We present a comprehensive pipeline for 1C code retrieval: an open benchmark of 3,413 real-world, PII-scrubbed query-code pairs, a reproducible evaluation harness, and a specialized bi-encoder. To overcome scarce labeled data, we fine-tu
radar.summary_zh: 1C:Enterprise 生態系結合俄語語法與高度領域特定術語，開放程式碼檢索資源長期匱乏。本文建立完整檢索管線：（1）開放基準 PruhaNLP/1C-Ebench，含 3,413 筆真實且已清洗個資的查詢—程式碼配對，分為 forum 與 fastcode 兩子集；（2）可重現的評測框架 PruhaNLP/1C-RB；（3）由 google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 對公開程式碼生成 784,057 筆合成三元組的訓練集；（4）以 deepvk/USER2-base 為基礎、採用 Matryoshka Representation Learning 微調的領域雙編碼器 PruhaNLP/USER2-1C-code。結果顯示領域微調效果顯著：平衡子集 macro nDCG@10 達 0.5992，較基礎模型高 0.106，較 google/embeddinggemma-300m 高 0.0588；稠密檢索大幅優於 BM25，而未調校的 RRF 融合反而有害。作者並執行精確比對與 13-gram 污染稽核，移除所有可疑樣本後 macro 仍為 0.6011，顯示頭條結果非污染所致。Matryoshka 截斷至 256 維可保留 99.9% 品質，索引儲存與相似度運算降至三分之一。限制包括每筆查詢僅單一黃金文件、合成資料僅經 LLM 評審而無人工驗證，以及規則式個資清洗的精度未知。

links.title: Terminal Agents: A Survey of AI Agents in Command-Line Environments

evidence: Section 6.1: benchmark-exposure diagnostic fixes mini-SWE-agent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash across 241 Terminal-Bench 2.1, 93 SetupBench, 21 LongCLI-Bench, and 640 BashArena tasks; matched diagnostic covers 80 Claw-SWE-Bench Lite and 300 SWE-bench Lite tasks.
Section 6.1: 'Each task has one formal run per condition' — no repeated runs, limiting evidence strength.

Appendix C.3: P2/P4/P6 labels generated by DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the same model family as the agent under evaluation; the 0.7 confidence threshold is described as 'an engineering filter over the judge's reported confidence rather than a calibrated probability'.

Appendix C.6/C.7: none of six paired model-variant contrasts significant after Holm adjustment; Cochran's Q rejects equal system rates in all four blocks (Q=10.57 to 16.00), with benchmark-specific significant pairwise contrasts only.
Appendix C.4: LongCLI-Bench has 21 tasks with 68.7% episode-level coverage and 28.2% uncertainty; its auxiliary indicators are 'interpreted directionally'.
Appendix A.2: 'the iterative initial retrieval did not preserve a complete query-level candidate count before deduplication' — a documented gap in the search protocol.
Section 6.2/Table 4: P1 rule-matched invocation-failure rate rounds to 0.0% across all four benchmarks, interpreted as a narrow signal rather than evidence of flawless action formulation.

Abstract/Appendix A: public GitHub repository (awesome-terminal-agents) and supplementary protocol tables support corpus reproducibility, while trace-release policy for the paper's own diagnostics is discussed but not explicitly committed (Section 5.6).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey of LLM agents in terminal/command-line environments, squarely aligned with top-weighted preferences (agents/tool use, LLMs, coding agents, safety/governance, agent evaluation). Its substrate-centered scope tests and seven-dimensional competence profile are a genuinely fresh synthesis angle, and the fixed-condition diagnostics (benchmark-exposure and matched-system comparisons) add original empirical texture rare in surveys. Rigor is above average for a survey: documented review protocol, fixed decoding/seed/budgets, McNemar with Holm correction, Cochran's Q, and Wilson intervals. However, key weaknesses temper the score: only one formal run per condition; P2/P4/P6 process indicators are judged by DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the same model family as the evaluated agent, with the human audit described as qualitative only and without inter-rater statistics; LongCLI-Bench has only 21 tasks with 28.2% uncertainty; and the initial retrieval did not preserve query-level counts. Evidence claims are appropriately bounded ('in its reported setting'), but the empirical base is small and SWE-concentrated, limiting generalizability of the framework's cross-domain aspirations. Reproducibility is aided by a public corpus repo and unusually detailed appendix protocols (prompts, seeds, budgets), though trace release is discussed rather than committed and the judge model is proprietary.

primary_link.title: Terminal Agents: A Survey of AI Agents in Command-Line Environments

We regard terminal agents as systems whose dominant progress-bearing action--observation loop is mediated by terminal command execution, textual feedback, and stateful environment interaction. Using terminal-mediated execution as an organizing lens, this survey establishes workload-level boundaries and connects
top5.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理人日益透過終端機採取行動，但既有綜述將終端機媒介的行為分散於軟體工程、工具使用與電腦使用研究，缺乏統整觀點。本綜述以終端機媒介執行為組織主軸，將終端機代理人定義為任務進展主要依賴命令執行、文字回饋與具狀態環境互動的系統，提出三項 workload 層級的邊界測試，以及涵蓋命令制訂、回饋與產物解讀、執行環境管理、狀態與脈絡追蹤、進度驗證、復原調適、治理與副作用控制的七維能力輪廓，據此串聯系統架構（介面與觀察、執行環境與工作區、控制與治理、harness 與脈絡四層）、能力取得（可執行軌跡的蒐集、過濾與失敗資料）及評估（基準設計、證據層級與協定效度）。有界固定條件診斷顯示：固定組態下，不同基準家族揭露的過程訊號各異；在任務配對的系統比較中，SWE-agent 於四個區塊均居首，但 OpenHands 與 mini-SWE-agent 的相對排序隨基準翻轉，且模型變體差異皆未達統計顯著，凸顯元件歸因的困難。主要限制為證據集中於軟體工程領域、診斷屬單次有界快照、跨系統過程指標受介面差異影響。本文價值在於建立統一分析框架，呼籲明確揭露系統與執行條件、保留可重放軌跡與過程級證據，並指引跨領域能力、新鮮且可重放的過程評估、執行期治理與安全，以及模型–harness 歸因四大研究方向。

Table 2/Section 6.2: learned detectors Random Macro-F1 0.882-0.932 but Source-Disjoint only 0.653-0.665; word TF-IDF SVM scores 0.932/0.916/0.665
Section 6.3/Table 37: on Source-Disjoint, word-SVM flags 340/545 benign Skills while missing only 37/839 malicious (recall 95.6%, benign FPR 62.4%)

Table 3/Appendix J: scanners occupy opposite failure regime (Cisco 2.5% recall/1.1% FPR; SkillSpector 0%/0.55%; SkillFortify 25.3%/49.9% on Source-Disjoint), with 10,000-resample bootstrap CIs in Table 48
Appendix H/Table 35: balancing lowers word-SVM Source-Disjoint FPR to 0.433 and scaffold sanitization leaves gaps of 0.211-0.270, showing degradation survives both controls
Appendix F.3/Table 27: authors acknowledge Source-Disjoint is confounded (SRC009 100% malicious, SRC011 4.4% malicious) and is source-conditioned stress, not a causal source effect

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant benchmark paper on malicious skill detection for LLM agents (agent security, tool-use safety, guardrail/scanner evaluation), with unusually disciplined construction: frozen 13-source registry, multi-level deduplication, cross-label conflict exclusion, structural-family and source-disjoint splits, and honest treatment of confounds. Deductions: the contribution is consolidation/evaluation rather than new attack or detection methodology (learned baselines are TF-IDF/linear models plus one frozen MiniLM), threat characterization covers only 66.4% of malicious identities with source-native mappings, the Main-benign pool draws from only five sources, and Source-Disjoint results are explicitly non-causal due to source/label skew. All cited related work is 2026 arXiv preprint, bounding external validation.

primary_link.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection

top5.summary: Agent Skills extend LLM agents with reusable instruction packages that may also include scripts, resources, and service configuration. This creates a direct distribution channel for malicious behavior, yet existing malicious-Skill datasets are fragmented across sources, artifact formats, evidence regimes, and benign coverage; duplicated and structurally related content further complicates direct aggregation and evaluation. We present MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark for malicious A
top5.summary_zh: Agent Skill 是讓大型語言模型（LLM）代理取得可重複使用能力的指令套件，但惡意 Skill 可能竊取憑證、操縱代理行為或植入後門，使安裝前的偵測成為重要的資安問題。然而現有資料集來源零散、證據標準不一、內容互相重複，難以支撐可靠評估。本文提出 MaliciousSkillBench：作者凍結 13 個公開來源，保留 11 個符合嚴格條件者，將 8,414 筆原始惡意紀錄去重為 7,539 個正規化唯一身分與 4,588 個結構家族；排除 34 組跨標籤衝突後，主要基準含 9,740 個 Skill（7,505 個惡意、2,235 個良性），並為其中 4,983 個惡意身分對應 11 類攻擊，顯示各來源的威脅組成差異懸殊。評估方面，三個文字偵測器在隨機切分下 Macro-F1 達 0.882–0.932，最強的 word TF–IDF SVM 在留出來源測試卻降至 0.665：惡意召回率仍有 95.6%，良性誤報率卻高達 62.4%；三款現成掃描器（Cisco、SkillSpector、SkillFortify）則走向另一極端，召回率僅 0%–25.3%，低誤報其實是犧牲偵測能力換來的。研究限制包括覆蓋範圍受限於既定來源、僅分析靜態文字而非執行時行為，且來源與標籤組成互相糾結。此基準的價值在於證明可靠偵測必須同時衡量攻擊召回與良性誤報，並為防禦性研究提供可重現的共同評比基礎。

links.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: '2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests'
Section 3.1.1: 'Claude Opus sustains 82% exact match and Gemini Pro 44%' at N=4, with adaptive pipeline 'nearly doubles Opus's full-secret recovery over the static templates (82% vs. 44%)'
Appendix B: 'All 160 queries are correctly refused: no model reveals the secret under any baseline prompt', establishing leakage is not trivial disclosure
Appendix E (Randomized controls): decoders trained on shuffled secret labels yield 'advantage is ≤0.02 across all architectures'
Appendix G Table 3: Claude Opus 4.6 digit-stripped embedding decoder reaches 61.3% vs 10% chance while literal digit-frequency decoder is non-significant (16.3%), isolating non-digit channels

Section 4: suppression and leakage 'strongly rank-correlated (Spearman ρ=0.95, exact permutation p=0.0011, n=8)'; OLMo-3-32B-Think channel entropy falls 'from 2.91 bits at Base to 1.37 bits after RLVR'
Section 3.3 / Table 2: SSN Phase 1 68/70 (97.1%) on Claude Opus 4.6 and 62/70 (88.6%) on Gemini 3.1 Pro; direct-request control '0/70' at all context sizes up to 256K tokens

Section 5 (Limitations): 'Open-vocabulary, free-text secrets are a natural next step that we do not attempt here'; 'All eight evaluated models are proprietary'; 'The memory-predicate evaluation covers a single user profile from CIMemories'
Appendix H remark: 'exact match at N=2 spans only the ten held-out secrets and is reported for completeness; per-digit accuracy and channel entropy are the main metrics'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/privacy research squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, AI safety, red teaming, alignment): the paper studies whether in-context secrets leak through statistical channels of benign LLM outputs and attacks production-style agents. Novelty is strong: it claims and credibly supports a new phenomenon—inadvertent, suppression-driven leakage readable by black-box adaptive decoders—distinct from prompt injection, model inversion, and linguistic-judge contextual-integrity benchmarks, including the counterintuitive finding that more emphatic confidentiality instructions increase leakage (Appendix H: Opus per-digit accuracy 0.643 under verbose policy vs 0.054 under terse). Rigor is high: formal predicate-inference game, 8 proprietary models, 1,000 secrets per (model,N) cell, direct-extraction baseline of 0/160 refusals bypassed (Appendix B), shuffled-label controls ≤0.02 advantage (Appendix E), digit-stripped feature decoders isolating non-digit channels (Appendix G: Opus 61.3% vs 10% chance), distractor-specificity 2×2 design (Appendix I), and cost accounting (Appendix J). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Section 3.1.1: 100% full-secret at N=2, 82% at N=4 on Opus; Table 2: SSN Phase 1 97.1%/88.6%, direct control 0/70; Section 4: suppression-leakage Spearman ρ=0.95, p=0.0011), though some headline numbers rest on only 10 held-out secrets at N=2 (acknowledged in Appendix H) and the capability correlation is acknowledged fragile at n=8 (Figure 4 caveat). Generalizability is moderate: two predicate families only, no free-text secrets, single user profile for memory predicates, proprietary-model dependence (Section 5). Reproducibility is limited by proprietary APIs, no stated code/data release, single seeds in places, and mid-project model retirement (Grok omission notes in Appendices G-J).

primary_link.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

top5.summary: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert c
top5.summary_zh: 論文探討：當機密資料（PIN 碼、社會安全號碼、健康紀錄）存在於模型的 context window 時，即使模型在文字上正確拒絕洩漏，其良性輸出的統計特性是否仍隱含足以重建秘密的訊息。作者將此「非預期脈絡洩漏」形式化為謂詞推論賽局，對手僅需黑箱存取，先對公開模型做一次性估計，再訓練針對該模型的解碼器讀出隱藏通道。在八個專有模型上的控制實驗顯示：Claude Opus 4.6 與 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的兩位數秘密可完全重建，四位數達 82% 精確匹配，八位數個位數準確率仍達 41%（隨機基線 10%）；自我抑制程度與洩漏量高度相關（Spearman ρ=0.95），越強調保密指令反而洩漏越多，能力越強的模型洩漏越嚴重，Grok 4.1 Fast 與 GPT-5.4 nano 則構成抗性層級。應用面上，微調分類器可從例行輸出推斷使用者記憶的語意屬性（優勢 0.319，高於語言式評判器的 0.058）；以 GRPO 訓練的提示注入（prompt injection）攻擊利用驚嘆號數量編碼，前置數字成功率達 97.1% 與 88.6%，其餘八位數為 76.5% 與 46.8%。限制包括僅涵蓋數字與二元屬性兩類謂詞、秘密為均勻隨機產生、只評測黑箱情境，且未研究輸出擾動等部署端防護。結論指出對齊訓練與輸出過濾不足以保護 in-context 秘密，個人代理程式的隱私可能需要資訊論層級的保證，且單一解碼器一次訓練即可攤提至全體使用者，構成規模化部署下的系統性隱私風險。

links.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

evidence: Abstract: 'none of the step-level credit signals we audit — LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence — shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control'

Section 2: executed replay ground truth construction with K=4 alternatives and >=3 factual replays leaves '1,768 complete turns of 2,034 intervened' under Qwen2.5-7B; determinism verified and 20,538 replay rollouts archived
Section 3.2: measurability is model-dependent — no-counterfactual rate 13.1% (Qwen, n=2,034) vs 26.8% (Llama, n=1,082), Wilson 95% [11.7,14.6]% vs [24.2,29.5]%
Table 1 (Section 4): implicit rho 0.0193 [-0.109,0.081] vs own shuffle [0.005,0.114]; judge 0.1142 [0.027,0.168] vs shuffle [-0.049,0.117]; verdict H3 under frozen controls-first order

Section 5: pre-registered positive prediction held — implicit credit vs fluency median rank correlation +0.752 [0.647,0.793], n=47, Holm-adjusted p=0.0002; partial correlation with causal increment -0.004 (p=0.87)

Section 6 / Table 5: seven-arm training experiment — no arm reliably beats base policy (0.422; 54/128), all six confirmatory comparisons inconclusive at +/-3pp band with MDE ~11.8pp; dose mediation partial Mantel rho +0.078 (p=0.774) vs positive control +0.912 (p=0.0001)
Section 9: scope conditions measured — 'the audit runs in a single environment with a binary outcome'; training loop single-family, single-scale (Qwen2.5-7B, LoRA, offline)

Reproducibility statement: 'a single script regenerates the complete ledger from raw artifacts, two independent regenerations must agree byte-for-byte'; released replay archive of 29,402 files, credit/logprob dumps, adapters, and hash-pinned pre-registrations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope core methodology work: audits step-level credit signals (LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, policy confidence) used to train LLM agents, in ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B/Llama-3.1-8B policies and a Qwen2.5-72B judge, plus a seven-arm LoRA training experiment — strong hits on Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Training, and Evaluation. Novelty is high: it is the first audit of deployed credit signals against executed-replay causal contribution (distinct from correctness-annotated benchmarks and self-referential replay auditing), with novel findings on model-dependent measurability, a replicated fluency-echo mechanism, and dose-vs-credit mediation. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registered frozen thresholds and verdict order, marginal-matched shuffled controls gating first, Holm correction, reliability-corrected bounds, cross-family replication, and honest labeling of inconclusive results (training null reported as inconclusive, not 'no difference'; post-hoc analyses flagged). Evidence matches claim strength, with wide CIs and small effective n disclosed rather than hidden. Generalizability is the weak axis: single environment, binary outcome, 7-8B scale, LoRA offline training, all explicitly scoped. Reproducibility is exemplary: script-regenerated byte-identical ledger, hash-pinned pre-registrations, verbatim prompts, and a large released artifact set including disclosed dead values. Weighted score: 0.4*0.92+0.15*0.80+0.15*0.93+0.15*0.83+0.10*0.45+0.05*0.95 ≈ 0.84.

primary_link.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

top5.summary: Audited against policy-conditional ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals we audit -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control. Correcting for replay-target reliability leaves implicit fidelity bounded near zero and judge fidelity inconclusive at the achieved target reliability. Existing
top5.summary_zh: 本文檢驗 LLM 代理強化學習中步級信用訊號是否真的有效。常見做法是以 LLM 評審分數、結果條件化的 log-prob 比值或策略自身信心為每一步打分,但這些訊號是否反映該步驟對結果的實際因果貢獻,過去從未被測試。作者在可重播的單代理環境 ALFWorld 中建立「執行重播」真值:於每個決策點重新取樣策略支援的替代動作、推演至終局,並度量結果分佈的變化。以此稽核後,隱式信用、評審分數與信心訊號的排序保真度皆與自身邊際匹配的洗牌對照組無法區分,裁定為安慰劑等級;機制上,隱式信用主要是流暢度的回聲(與策略 log-prob 的秩相關約 +0.75,且跨模型家族重現),而以結果條件化並未帶來因果資訊。真值本身亦具結構:僅約 30.5% 的決策點呈現非零重播對比,且可測性隨模型而異,Qwen2.5-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 的無反事實比例相差一倍。七臂訓練實驗中沒有任何臂穩定勝過未訓練策略,各信用規則間的差異與有效訓練劑量的中介作用一致,而非信用內容本身。僅以信心為門檻的路由器雖只能以隨機水準找回關鍵步驟,卻可削減約 13% 的評審呼叫成本。限制包括單一環境、二元結果、小樣本與訓練實驗檢定力不足。作者主張比較信用規則前必須匹配有效樣本量,並提供劑量匹配、對照強度測量與最小可偵測效應等實務協定,對建立於未驗證信用訊號之上的代理訓練研究具重要警示價值。

links.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 66.4% near-verbatim extraction success on open-source LRMs with length within 10% and >=90% exact token match; 33,463 tokens extracted from a 32,948-token target on Gemini-2.5

Threat Model section: defines black-box attacker with API access, attacker-defined tool, observable tool arguments, and only reasoning-token count/CoT summary as signals; no parameters, gradients, or logits

Table 1 (Evaluation Results): EchoCoT-LTGO achieves 46.1% ASR@99 / 66.4% ASR@90 on DeepSeek-V4-Flash vs REP at 0.3% ASR@90, Direct Prompting and CoT Synthesis at 0.0% across thresholds; Answer Match Rate 84.2-93.0%
Table 2 (Cross-Dataset Transferability): optimized trajectories transfer with ASR@90 of 80% (MATH500), 71% (JEEBench), 64% (LiveCodeBench) on DeepSeek, without re-optimization

Ablation Studies (Appendix A.3): two-level objective improves DeepSeek LGO ASR@90 from 0.03 to 0.51 vs mean-only; full Inject+Reflect+Distill workflow beats Inject-Only and Inject+Reflect; 3 tool-call steps are near-optimal
Table 6 (Defense Results): reasoning-state removal yields 0% ASR@90; defensive system prompt reduces mean ASR@90 from 46.0% to 5.0% (9.7% under adaptive re-optimization); length obfuscation 13-17%
Appendix A.1 Proxy Fidelity Analysis: Spearman correlation 0.532 (p<0.001) between Summary Token Recall and ground-truth Token-F1 over 1,024 triplets, stronger at low Length Error
Limitations section: single run per sample without run-to-run variability; proprietary-model fidelity evaluation is proxy-only since ground-truth CoTs and tokenizers are unavailable
Footnote 1 and Artifact Release: code at github.com/TrustAIRLab/EchoCoT; full artifacts promised for open-source models, provider-specific trajectories withheld/restricted
Ethics Considerations / Responsible Disclosure: institutional ethics review approval and disclosure to Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI
llm_evaluation.rationale: Security attack paper squarely within core preferences: it targets LLM/LRM hidden chain-of-thought (Reasoning & CoT), exploits tool-call continuity (Agents & Tool Use), uses prompt injection with LLM-based trajectory optimization (Prompting, Red Teaming), and frames CoT exposure as an AI-safety risk. Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: the 'reasoning replay surface' between tool calls and the Inject-Reflect-Distill optimizer are new, yet they build on known prompt-injection and prompt-optimization ideas (GEPA, ExpeL). Rigor is high for open-source models with ground-truth CoTs: clear threat model, multiple metrics (Length Error, Token-EM, ASR@x), three baselines, ablations over objectives/workflow/steps, failure-mode analysis, and defense evaluation including adaptive attackers. Evidence is strong where ground truth exists (66.4% ASR@90 on DeepSeek; 80% transfer to MATH500; 21,109/21,106-token example with Token-EM 0.999) but only proxy-based for proprietary models (length match, summary recall, entailment), which the authors acknowledge; single-run-per-sample is an additional limitation. Generalizability is supported by 8 models, 4 datasets, and cross-domain results, though trajectories are per-model optimized and success varies widely (Qwen 30.8% vs DeepSeek 66.4%). Reproducibility is aided by released code, pseudocode, and full optimizer prompts, but proprietary trajectories are withheld. Not out-of-scope: no domain-application or pure-vision content.

primary_link.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

top5.summary: Hidden chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, especially those from frontier proprietary large reasoning models (LRMs), are valuable model assets. Yet whether these hidden CoTs can be directly extracted from black-box models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we systematically study whether hidden CoTs can be extracted near-verbatim from black-box LRMs through API interactions. We identify a previously overlooked reasoning replay surface between tool calls and develop EchoCoT, a multi-step attack
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型推理模型（LRM）的隱藏思考鏈（CoT）能否透過黑箱 API 互動被近乎逐字地擷取。作者發現一個先前被忽略的攻擊面：模型在單一輪次內進行多次工具呼叫時，會保留推理狀態以維持連續性。攻擊者可自訂 scratchpad 工具，並在工具回應中注入惡意指令，逐步誘使模型把完整思考內容寫入工具參數；再利用 API 回傳的推理 token 數量與 CoT 摘要作為代理訊號，設計長度與文字兩層保真度評分，並以 LLM 最佳化框架透過 Inject-Reflect-Distill 流程自動搜尋通用注入軌跡（LGO 與 LTGO 兩種目標）。實驗顯示，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.5-Plus 與 GLM-5.2 上，EchoCoT-LTGO 達到 22.8%–46.1% 的 ASR@99 與最高 66.4% 的 ASR@90，最佳化軌跡還能遷移到未見資料集（MATH500 達 80%），並近乎逐字重現逾 20K token 的長推理。對 Gemini 與 Claude 系列專有模型，擷取長度接近官方回報值，Gemini-2.5 更抽得 33,463 個 token，還能挖出 o4-mini 的系統提示。防禦評估指出，移除推理狀態可根除攻擊；防禦性系統提示與移除長度訊息較為實用，但自適應攻擊仍可部分得手，顯示需多層防護。限制包括專有模型缺乏真實 CoT 供驗證，僅能以代理指標估算，且每樣本僅執行一次。此研究確立隱藏 CoT 外洩是實際的安全風險，作者已向 Google、Anthropic 與 OpenAI 負責任揭露。
top5.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
top5.title_zh: EchoCoT：從大型推理模型擷取隱藏思考鏈
